scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人正在大聲演講。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
請把它從袋子裡拿出來，放到我頭上。

scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人正在大聲演講。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
I've received a signal that you've arrived at your local coordinates.
Is this the location I called you to?
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
我收到訊號，顯示你已經抵達指定座標。這裡就是我叫你來的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Correct
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我們到了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得不是這裡。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That's odd, but it seems to fit with the information coming from Mini Elly right now, so let's check around.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
奇怪，迷你艾莉傳來的資訊似乎顯示這裡沒錯。我們在附近找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Does the guest see anything suspicious?
I've never seen anyone who was neither an intruder nor a guest, but I know that those masked people are suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
客人發現什麼可疑的東西了嗎？我沒見過既非入侵者也非客人的人，不過我知道那些戴面具的人很可疑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those people are residents here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些人是這裡的居民......

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Isn't that an interesting outfit?
I'll remember that.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
那身打扮真有意思。我會記住的。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
...No.
We're not talking about peace with your neighbors or anything like that.
What we need is a slightly better future.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
......不。我們談的不是與鄰國和平共處之類的事。我們需要的是一個稍微美好一些的未來。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
If this isn't repetition, what else can you call it?
How can we ignore this when it's clearly a sign of a divided country?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
如果這不叫重蹈覆轍，那又該叫什麼？國家明顯已經分裂，我們怎麼能對此視而不見？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Why did this happen?
Why can't you respect the other person?
I'm sure everyone has their own thoughts, but I'd say this.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
為什麼會變成這樣？為什麼不能尊重對方？我相信每個人都有自己的想法，但我想說的是......

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
What does it mean to you as a citizen of this country to entrust all your values to your birth lineage and commit violence against it?
What does it mean to you?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
作為這個國家的公民，把所有價值觀都寄託在血統上，還因此訴諸暴力，這對你來說意味著什麼？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Don't you think it's strange to get angry over such a story?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
你不覺得因為這種事就生氣很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
I don't wish for you to fight.
Unless we all come together, we have no future.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
我不希望你們爭鬥。只有大家團結起來，我們才有未來。

scripts.text: The speaker continued their speech without paying any attention to the voice from the audience.
scripts.translation: 發言人不理會聽眾席傳來的聲音，繼續演講。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It's interesting. There are quite a few people wearing masks. It seems like even if we all have the same face like us, we can still distinguish each other.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
真有意思，戴面具的人還不少。就算大家都長著和我們一樣的臉，似乎也能分辨彼此。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Why is this person interrupting someone who is saying the right thing?
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
為什麼要打斷那個說得有道理的人？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because I believe it's not right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因為我覺得他說得不對。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It seems like the fuss is getting louder.
Everyone seems to think they're right and don't want to listen to what anyone else has to say.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
騷動好像越來越大了。每個人都覺得自己有理，也不願聽別人說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
The noise seems to be getting louder than before.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
吵鬧聲似乎比剛才更大了。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Priest]
What should we do... Should we intervene?
scripts.translation:
[緊張的牧師]
我們該怎麼辦......要不要介入？

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The atmosphere around is hostile.
scripts.translation: 演講遲遲沒有結束，周圍的氣氛也劍拔弩張。

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The unfortunate priest is looking the other way.
scripts.translation: 演講遲遲沒有結束，可憐的牧師正把臉別向一旁。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Someone here gave a speech while wearing a mask?
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
這裡有人戴著面具演講？嗯......

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Don't get me wrong, you outsiders might not know it, but we recognize each other through this half-covered mask.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
別誤會，你們這些外來者可能不知道，我們能透過這半遮面的面具認出彼此。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
He's a brave man, no disguise.
You're probably the only one who can't tell the difference between him and me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
他可真勇敢，連偽裝都沒有。恐怕只有你分不清我和他。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Freya is love.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
芙蕾雅就是愛。

scripts.text: Where did the droopy Elly go?
scripts.translation: 蔫頭耷腦的艾莉去哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
請把它從袋子裡拿出來，放到我頭上。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Haha, the main gate is that way, adventurer.
You have to climb the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
哈哈，冒險者，正門在那邊。上樓梯就到了。

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Maintenance work, as you can see.
...But I'm feeling a little uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
如你所見，我正在維修......不過總覺得有點不安。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Hmm. You're an adventurer.
I've been hearing a strange noise coming from the holy ground recently.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
嗯，你是冒險者吧？最近我總聽見聖地裡傳來奇怪的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
I think it's because of the accident a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
我想大概和之前那場事故有關......

scripts.text: Accident?
scripts.translation: 事故？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
(In a low voice)
There was a tiny accident of mana leakage in there.
The higher-ups are trying to hush it up, but I heard the accident caused some monster emergence.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
（壓低聲音）裡面發生過一次輕微的魔力洩漏事故。上頭想把事情壓下來，不過我聽說事故引來了魔物。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
My superiors dismissed it as a hogwash,
but listen.
...Can't you hear this strange noise coming from below?
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
上頭說那是胡說八道。不過你聽，......難道沒聽見下面傳來的怪聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
If this really is a monster, it means there's a monster trapped in the holy temple, which is a big problem.
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
如果真是魔物，那就說明有魔物困在聖殿裡，這可就麻煩了。唉......

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Oh right! You can get rid of the monster for our goddess!
I'm sure the higher-ups will reprimand me for being indulgent, but I can't turn my eyes away from a monster problem!
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
對了！你可以替我們的女神除掉那些魔物！上頭肯定會責怪我多管閒事，但我不能對魔物的問題視而不見！

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
We should step up for the pope!
So? Are you up for it?
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
我們得站出來保護教皇！怎麼樣，願意幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
There would be fanatics who went mad and became monsters.
Kill ^4d4dffIsilla, Vanberk, and Hodremlin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
裡面可能有發狂變成魔物的狂信徒。消滅^4d4dff依斯拉、凡貝爾克和邪惡妖精^000000。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Grr, I can't just stand by when monsters are rampaging in there...!
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
可惡，我不能眼睜睜看著魔物在裡面肆虐......！

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Thank you for doing this.
Please be careful.
Take this ventilation shaft. It leads to the place where monsters are running amok.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
謝謝你願意幫忙。小心點，從這個通風管道進去，就能到魔物橫行的地方。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Hold on!! Hey! Can't you see the line? ^e5555eIf you're here to see ^000000Niren^000000, then follow the order!
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 站住！！ 喂！ 沒看見這裡在排隊嗎？ ^e5555e要見^000000尼倫^000000的話，就按順序來！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are really a lot of people.
But it'll be a problem if we don't meet Niren soon.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人可真多。再不快點見到尼倫就麻煩了。

scripts.text: It's said to be an urgent matter.
scripts.translation: 聽說事情很緊急。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] What? I'm in a hurry too, you know?
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 什麼？ 我也趕時間啊！

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Ugh~ Do you even know how many times I've been dispatched to stop fights just today alone?! People keep fighting left and right, and it's driving us crazy too!
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 唉～ 你知道我今天光是去制止鬥毆，就被派了多少次嗎？！到處都有人打架，我們也快受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They don't even pretend to listen when we try to stop the fights!
They've been fighting over whether they're ^e5555eimmigrants^000000 or ^e5555enatives^000000 for ages, but these days, it's really no joke!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
我們上前制止時，他們連裝作在聽都不肯！為了自己是^e5555e移民^000000還是^e5555e原住民^000000，他們爭了很久，可最近鬧得實在太過火了！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They start yEllyng about ^e5555ediscrimination^000000 against natives as soon as we say anything...
Just thinking about it makes my headache.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
我們一開口，他們就嚷嚷著原住民遭受^e5555e歧視^000000......光是想想就頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Security Officer Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[安保人員 登特]
尼爾，最近過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
尼爾，最近過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Sigh~
If only everyone would stop fighting for once...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
唉～要是大家能消停一陣，不再打架就好了......

scripts.text: [Guard Neil] Hey, cut it out! But still, you're better than me. You know as well as I do that. I'm a native.
scripts.translation: [衛兵 尼爾] 喂，夠了！ 不過你總比我強。你也知道，我是原住民。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Before I even start talking, they tell me to call another security guard from a native.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我還沒開口，他們就叫我去找另一位原住民出身的安保人員。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm tired of hearing things like 'Do you even know who I am?' when it comes to my native background.
What do they even think the security guard is for!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我受夠了那些“你知道我是誰嗎？”之類的話，尤其是他們拿我的原住民身份說事。他們到底把安保人員當什麼了！

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
To be honest, things have been really strange lately.
Even people who never caused these problems before are getting involved in fights, turning small fights into big ones.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
說實話，最近情況很不對勁。連以前從不惹事的人也捲入了鬥毆，把小衝突鬧成大亂子。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
It's been chaotic everywhere lately.
Now that I think about it, I also came to the temple yesterday.
The priest over there is the one who called me yesterday, right?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
就是啊！最近到處都亂成一團。說起來，我昨天也去了神殿。昨天叫我過去的就是那裡的牧師吧？神殿最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
Things have been chaotic everywhere lately.
Come to think of it, I was also at the temple yesterday.
Was the priest there the one who called me yesterday?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
就是啊！最近到處都亂成一團。說起來，我昨天也在神殿。那裡的牧師就是昨天叫我過去的人嗎？神殿最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ah~
Niren seems to be very busy...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
啊～尼倫好像很忙......

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Neil, did you happen to see ^e5555eMaram^000000 today?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
尼爾，你今天有看到^e5555e瑪拉姆^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Maram?
I think I saw him around the ^e5555eplaza^000000 on my way to the temple earlier...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
瑪拉姆？我剛才去神殿的路上，好像在^e5555e廣場^000000附近看到他了......

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm not sure if he's still at the plaza, but maybe we could ask the people there to find out where Maram went?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
不知道他現在還在不在廣場。要不問問那邊的人，看看瑪拉姆去了哪裡？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hmm... I see.
The task I asked to {0} earlier, my son Maram will help with that.
He knows more about this matter than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
嗯......我知道了。我先前拜託{0}處理的事情，會由我兒子瑪拉姆協助。他最瞭解這件事。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I would introduce him myself, but as you can see, I can't leave my post right now.
If you ask around ^e5555enear the plaza^000000, you should be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我本想親自介紹你們認識，但你也看到了，我現在不能離開崗位。去^e5555e廣場附近^000000打聽一下，應該就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh...
Where could High Priestess Niren have gone...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
唉......大祭司尼倫去哪兒了......

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the true faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
我們一直為信徒堅定信仰、內心平和而祈禱。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh, enough with those scripted greetings~
I saw it myself, what~
And besides, if it's nothing serious, there's no reason for the priest to be standing here like this.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
唉，別再念那些客套話了～我可是親眼看見的，真是的～再說，要不是什麼大事，牧師也沒必要一直站在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Don't we need to know the situation of the people these days so that the security guards can be prepared?
Especially since we don't know much about the situation of people coming to the temple.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
安保人員不是得了解大家最近的情況，才能做好準備嗎？尤其是我們對來神殿的人瞭解不多。

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Give us some information~
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
給我們點訊息吧～

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
The temple is a place for praying for Priest Freya.
With a calm heart...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
神殿是供人向芙蕾雅祈禱的地方。請懷著平靜的心......

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I saw it yesterday.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Here, in the middle of people fighting each other, this priest with half a mask off...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我昨天看見了。<FONT SIZE = 14>就在這裡，人們打成一團時，那位牧師的半張面具掉了下來......</FONT>

scripts.text: [Priest Freya] Oh no!!! Wait a moment! Stop right there!!!
scripts.translation: [牧師 芙蕾雅] 糟了！！！ 請等一下！ 站住！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
<FONT SIZE = 10>Sigh...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
<FONT SIZE = 10>唉......</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Actually...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
其實......

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It's true that there have been more people causing problems at the temple lately.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
最近神殿裡惹事的人確實變多了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Mostly, they're people venting personal grievances rather than raising official complaints, causing disturbances or shouting at the entrance of the temple.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
大多是有人來發洩私怨，而非正式投訴，他們在神殿入口鬧事、叫嚷。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hold on...
Could we hear more details about this?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
請等一下......能詳細說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
High Priestess Niren!!!!
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
大祭司尼倫！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Ah, well...
It's been common for people with personal grievances to come to the temple and shout, and we've been trying to calm them down and send them away,
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
啊，是這樣的......最近常有人帶著私怨來神殿大喊大叫。我們一直試著安撫他們，再請他們離開，

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But recently, there have been more incidents of physical fights among the people visiting the temple...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
可最近，來神殿的人彼此動手的情況越來越多了......

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Physical fights in the sacred temple...
Was there no way to resolve their grievances through dialogue?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
神聖的神殿裡竟然發生鬥毆......難道不能通過對話化解他們的矛盾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Some people, even though we try to reconcile their opinions, accuse us of being heretics and cause disturbances, while others ask how long we will tolerate these heretics. It's not easy for us to resolve these situations.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
我們試著調解，有些人卻指責我們是異端，甚至鬧事；還有人質問我們要容忍異端到什麼時候。這些事很難處理。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But since they are complaining like that, it seems like they can't complain to Niren directly and take their anger out on the temple.
Because they know how important Niren values harmony
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
他們既然這麼抱怨，看來是沒法直接向尼倫傾訴，只好把怒氣發洩在神殿上。畢竟他們知道尼倫有多重視和睦。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sigh...
Heretics...
It seems that our efforts to eliminate discrimination haven't reached their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
唉......異端......看來消除歧視的努力並沒有觸及他們的內心。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Moreover, causing fights even at the temple is not an issue we can easily overlook.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
而且，連神殿裡都發生鬥毆，這絕不是能輕易放任不管的事。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I've heard some disagreements to some extent, but... I may have been wrong to think that they would naturally resolve if we lived together, got to know each other, and understood each other.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我聽說過一些分歧......但我以為只要大家一起生活、彼此瞭解，就能自然化解矛盾。看來是我錯了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Even though the hardliners have stepped back, it's not easy for the hearts of those who supported them to change all at once.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
即使強硬派已經退讓，他們的支持者也不可能一下子改變想法。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sadly, that's true.
The time we waited for self-healing has turned into the result of festering wounds.
Now, even dialogue for reconciliation won't be easy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
很遺憾，確實如此。我們寄望問題自行好轉，結果卻讓傷口越潰越深。如今想靠對話和解也不容易了......

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 10>We need some kind of catalyst...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
<FONT SIZE = 10>我們需要某種契機......</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
High Priestess Niren.
How about this adventurer here as a catalyst?
They're a complete outsider.
Well... wouldn't it be possible to at least start a conversation?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
大祭司尼倫，不如讓這位冒險者做個契機？他們完全是局外人。嗯......說不定至少能讓雙方談起來？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Anyway, they came here to see you because they have something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
況且，他們是有事要告訴您才來的。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh my...!
{0}!!!
I didn't even notice that {1} was here because I've been so distracted.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哎呀！{0}！！！我心不在焉，竟沒注意到{1}來了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
As you can see, we're currently swamped with internal issues regarding ^e5555eRachel^000000.
But what is it that you want to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
如你所見，我們正忙著處理^e5555e拉赫^000000的內部問題。你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text: About the intruder.
scripts.translation: 關於入侵者。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah...
<FONT SIZE = 10>It's a bit difficult to discuss that here.</FONT>
Please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
啊......<FONT SIZE = 10>在這裡談這件事不太方便。</FONT>請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It seems High Priestess Niren was looking for you. Did you not meet him?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
大祭司尼倫好像在找您。您沒見到她嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}, please follow me this way.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
{0}，請往這邊來。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the sincere faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
我們一直為信徒虔誠的信仰與內心的平靜祈禱。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It seems there won't be anyone listening here.
^e5555eEspecially on sensitive matters^000000 like this,
I apologize for having to discuss it in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
看來這裡不會有人偷聽。^e5555e尤其是這種敏感的事^000000......抱歉，只能在這種地方和你談。

scripts.text: Explain about the intruder's identity.
scripts.translation: 說明入侵者的身份。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 14>That's possible!!!</FONT>
^e5555eHeart Hunters^000000 are already targeting ^e5555eYmir's Heart fragments^000000, so we can't afford to ignore this!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
<FONT SIZE = 14>確有可能！！！</FONT>^e5555e心之獵手^000000已經盯上了^e5555e伊米爾之心碎片^000000，絕不能對此掉以輕心！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
They infiltrated so easily...
We need to immediately ^e5555eStrengthen the security near the Heart Vault^000000 and actively cooperate with ^e5555eRebEllyon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
他們竟然這麼輕易就潛入了......我們得立刻^e5555e加強心之寶庫附近的戒備^000000，積極與^e5555e叛逆艾利昂^000000合作。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
But no matter how much we reinforce the security near the Heart Vault, with the recent tense atmosphere among the residents, it's actually an ideal situation for intruders to run rampant.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
不過，居民之間最近氣氛緊張。無論怎麼加強心之寶庫附近的戒備，這種局面都會讓入侵者有機可乘。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'll focus on reinforcing the security for now, so could I ask you, {0}, to ^e5555eMediate among the residents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我會先負責加強戒備。{0}，可以請你去^e5555e調解居民之間的矛盾^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
No...
Rather than mediating, just listening to their stories and relaying them would be enough.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
不......與其說是調解，不如說是聽聽他們的想法，再轉告給我就好。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
When making a decision that I thought would make many people happy, I failed to properly consider the feelings of those who didn't support that choice.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我做出自以為能讓許多人滿意的決定時，沒有好好顧及那些反對者的感受。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It's not realistic to expect everyone to get along overnight.
Just...
If we can understand what the grievances are...
I believe we can start over.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
不可能指望大家一夜之間就和睦相處。只要......能弄清他們的不滿是什麼......我相信就能重新開始。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Right now, it seems like nobody is willing to listen, but like Dent said, perhaps an outsider like {0} might be able to help with the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
現在似乎沒人願意傾聽，不過正如登特所說，像{0}這樣的局外人或許能幫大家開啟話匣子。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Human relationships are complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人際關係真複雜。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Haha... indeed.
Shall we head back to the entrance of the temple for now?
^e5555eWe need to check with the security^000000 team as well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哈哈......確實。我們先回神殿入口吧？^e5555e還得和安保人員確認情況^000000......

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Right now, it seems like nobody is willing to listen, but like Dent said, perhaps an outsider like {0} might be able to help with the conversation.
scripts.translation:

現在似乎沒人願意傾聽，不過正如登特所說，像{0}這樣的局外人或許能幫大家開啟話匣子。

Shall we head back to the entrance of the temple for now?
^e5555eWe need to check with the security^000000 team as well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們先回神殿入口吧？^e5555e還得和安保人員確認情況^000000......

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm a bit busy right now...
Sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我現在有點忙......抱歉。

scripts.text: Ask if they've seen Maram.
scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
What?
I don't know!
Why would I know where that guy is.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
什麼？不知道！我怎麼會知道那傢伙在哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Come to think of it, you!
You're a new face around here...
scripts.translation:
[村民]
說起來，你是新面孔啊......

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Why are you looking for him?
Is there something suspicious going on?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你找他幹什麼？有什麼可疑的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
They're not very friendly.
Since they don't seem like they'll tell us where Maram is, let's ask someone else.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
他們不太友善。看來也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪兒，去問問別人吧。

scripts.text:

他們不太友善。看來也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪兒，去問問別人吧。

scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...

[Villager]
I'm not sure?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
But who are you?
Why are you looking for Maram?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
不過，你是誰？為什麼要找瑪拉姆？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
How do you know Maram?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你和瑪拉姆是什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This person doesn't seem like they'll tell us where Maram is either.
Let's ask someone else.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
看來這個人也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪兒。再去問問別人吧。

scripts.translation:

看來這個人也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪兒。再去問問別人吧。

scripts.text:

...
Ask if they've seen Maram.
scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're looking for Maram, they mentioned having an appointment nearby.
They passed by here, so if you go ^e5555eUpwards^000000 from here, you might meet them.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你在找瑪拉姆的話，他說過要在附近赴約。他剛才從這邊經過，往^e5555e上方^000000走的話，或許能遇到他。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're looking for Maram, they mentioned having an appointment nearby.
They passed by here, so if you go ^e5555eUpwards^000000 from here, you might meet them.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你在找瑪拉姆的話，他說過要在附近赴約。他剛才從這邊經過，往^e5555e上方^000000走的話，或許能遇到他。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
These days, the atmosphere in Rachel seems a bit gloomy.
Is there something going on?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
最近拉赫的氣氛有些陰沉。發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I wonder when Miriam will arrive~
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
米莉亞姆什麼時候才來呢～

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
I believe it's our first meeting. Is this your first time in Rachel?
May the blessings of Freyja be with you, traveler.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好。我們應該是第一次見面吧？你是初次來拉赫嗎？願芙蕾雅保佑你，旅行者。

scripts.text: Deliver Niren's message.
scripts.translation: 轉達尼倫的口信

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
If it's a task entrusted by my mother, then I must do my best to help!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊！既然是母親託付的任務，我一定會盡力幫忙！！！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But we don't know much about the situation here. How can we mediate between people?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
可是我們不太瞭解這裡的情況，要怎麼調解居民之間的矛盾呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From my perspective...
Before mediating between people, I hope you understand the situation faced by the natives and our Gray Children.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
依我看......在調解之前，希望你先了解原住民和我們這些灰色孩子的處境。

scripts.text: Who are the Gray Children?
scripts.translation: 灰色孩子是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Rachel...
It's a city with a beautiful temple now, but it used to be a ^e5555eBarren Wasteland^000000 where the natives lived.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
拉赫......如今是座擁有美麗神殿的城市，但過去這裡曾是原住民居住的^e5555e貧瘠荒地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But one day, ^e5555eFreyja's Disciples^000000 suddenly came and pushed the natives aside, building the temple.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
有一天，^e5555e芙蕾雅的信徒^000000突然來到這裡，排擠原住民，並建起了神殿。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people who followed the temple to settle down here tried to live together with the newcomers, but ^e5555emany couldn't bear it and left^000000 or... some ^e5555esuffered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
一些追隨神殿遷居到這裡的人試著與新來者共處，但^e5555e許多人忍受不了而離開了^000000，另一些人則^e5555e受盡苦難^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would have been good if those were just things of the past... but they've ^e5555econtinued until now^000000.
As a result, there are ^e5555echildren who have lost their place to go^000000, and I am one of them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
要是這一切都已成為過去就好了......可它們^e5555e一直延續至今^000000。於是有些^e5555e孩子無家可歸^000000，我就是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
My adoptive mother, who felt sorry for us, adopted me. And since she became a high-ranking priestess, she has been leading the way in ^e5555eadopting us into the homes of wealthy immigrants^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
養母憐惜我們，收養了我。她成為高階女祭司後，一直帶頭^e5555e讓富裕的移民家庭收養我們^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people found this unacceptable and ^e5555ediscriminated against us^000000, calling us the Gray Children. But my mother hoped that we would become bridges between immigrants and natives.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
有些人無法接受這件事，^e5555e歧視我們^000000，還稱我們為灰色孩子。但母親希望我們能成為移民與原住民之間的橋梁。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>We couldn't fit in anywhere properly, just remained as an outsiders</FONT>.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我們哪裡都融不進去，只能一直像局外人一樣</FONT>。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would be better to hear such stories ^e5555edirectly from people^000000, but...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
最好能^e5555e直接聽當事人講述^000000這些事，不過......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I have an ^e5555eimportant appointment with a friend^000000 right now, so could you please allow me to meet my friend and explain the situation later?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我現在和朋友有個^e5555e重要的約會^000000。能不能先讓我去見朋友，之後再向你說明情況？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The time we agreed to meet...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們約好的時間......

scripts.text:
[???]
It's already been 5 minutes, hasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[???]
已經過五分鐘了吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555eMiriam!</FONT>
Since when have you been here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555e米莉亞姆！</FONT>你什麼時候來的？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
But more importantly...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
不過，更重要的是......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!
This is my ^e5555eFriend Miriam^000000.
Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?
They've come to see me at my mother's request.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊！這位是我的^e5555e朋友米莉亞姆^000000。米莉亞姆，這位是{0}，還有......艾莉？他們是受我母親所託來找我的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!
This is my ^e5555eFriend Miriam^000000.
Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?
They've come to see me at my mother's request.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊！這位是我的^e5555e朋友米莉亞姆^000000。米莉亞姆，這位是{0}，還有......艾莉？他們是受我母親所託來找我的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'm sorry, {0} but could we leave after I quickly buy something?
It'll be quick if I just place the order.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
抱歉，{0}，我能先去買點東西再走嗎？只要下單，很快就好。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Buying the item isn't as easy as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
買東西比我想的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
{0}, you are here.
We've gathered the necessary personnel, although we're a bit short.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，{0}，你來了。雖然人手還差一點，不過需要的人已經到齊了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
When Miriam returns... Oh!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
等米莉亞姆回來......哦！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh!
It's Lord Niren's son!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哦！是尼倫大人的兒子！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, you're the ones who came looking for my mother last time.
Tamarin, Mark, and Maggi, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，你們就是上次來找我母親的人吧。塔馬林、馬克和瑪姬，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Maram.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
瑪拉姆。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Miriam, you're back?
Did you find the clothes?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
米莉亞姆，你回來了？衣服找到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I brought some, but...
Is this enough?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我帶來了一些......這些夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hahaha!</FONT>
That outfit, could it be...
It's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>哈哈哈！</FONT>這套衣服，難道是......太合適了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Now that we've gathered all the necessary personnel and prepared the clothes, let me explain the plan.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
人手和衣服都準備好了，我來說明計劃。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
We'll wear the clothes brought by Miriam and head to the top of this exotic town to move the goods.
I can't disclose the destination yet, so just follow me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們穿上米莉亞姆帶來的衣服，到這座異國城鎮的高處去搬運貨物。目的地暫時不能透露，跟著我走就行。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
{0}, please go to the ^e5555estore where you bought the items^000000 and inform them that you will be leaving soon.
The others will change into the clothes with me and head to the entrance of the village first.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，請去^e5555e你買東西的商店^000000，告訴他們我們馬上出發。其他人先和我換好衣服，到村口集合。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Now that all the necessary personnel are gathered and the clothes are ready, let me explain the plan.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
人手和衣服都準備好了，我來說明計劃。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
We'll ^e5555eput on the clothes Miriam brought and pretend to be a foreign merchant^000000, then move the goods.
I can't disclose the destination yet, so just follow me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們穿上米莉亞姆帶來的衣服，^e5555e假扮成外地商人^000000去搬運貨物。目的地暫時不能透露，跟著我走就行。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
{0}, could you please go to the shop where you bought the items earlier and inform them that we'll be leaving soon?
The others will change into the clothes with me and head to the entrance of the village first.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，請去剛才買東西的商店，告訴他們我們馬上出發。其他人先和我換好衣服，到村口集合。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
{0}, thanks to you, it seems like things are going quite smoothly!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，多虧了你，事情進展得很順利！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
{0}, thanks to you, it seems like things are going quite smoothly!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，多虧了你，事情進展得很順利！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
Merchant Sreen.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好，商人斯林。

scripts.text: [Merchant Sreen] What are you here for! We have nothing to sell to you, get out from here!
scripts.translation: [商人 斯林] 你們來幹什麼！ 沒東西賣給你們，滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Please don't say that.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
請別這麼說。

scripts.text: [Merchant Sreen] Just because of Niren, I won't forcibly chase you away!
scripts.translation: [商人 斯林] 要不是看在尼倫的面子上，我早就把你們趕走了！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Stop it.</FONT>
Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>別說了。</FONT>我們回去吧。

scripts.text: [Miriam] I apologize. Merchant Sreen.
scripts.translation: [米莉亞姆] 我很抱歉。商人斯林。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But Miriam...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
可是，米莉亞姆......

scripts.text: [Miriam] Let's go!
scripts.translation: [米莉亞姆] 走吧！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You were so confident, but ended up looking embarrassed from the start.
Shall we try ^e5555eanother store^000000 then?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
剛才還那麼有信心，結果一開口就碰了壁。要不去^e5555e另一家店^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sreen]
Hmm... Have you come from another region?
scripts.translation:
[商人 斯林]
嗯......你們是從別的地方來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
Mr. Sannat.
Is Mrs. Sannat doing well too?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好，桑納特先生。桑納特夫人最近也好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah...
Okay...
What's the matter?
Maram.
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊......嗯......有什麼事嗎，瑪拉姆？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
...

[Maram]
I'm interested in buying some of the items listed here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我想買一些清單上的商品。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah... um...
I'm sorry, but we don't have much stock at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊......那個......抱歉，我們現在庫存不多。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then, could you please check the list and see if there are any items are available?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麻煩你看看清單，確認一下哪些商品還有貨，可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Um...
I'm sorry, but the items we have here are all low in stock...
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
嗯......抱歉，我們這兒的商品庫存都不多......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's alright, even if they're a bit low in stock.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒關係，庫存少一點也可以。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
抱歉......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then, what about bread and meat...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麵包和肉呢......

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah...
<FONT SIZE = 10>Those are already reserved...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊......<FONT SIZE = 10>那些已經有人預訂了......</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Maram]
...

[Maram]
Alright... I'm sorry.
Then, next time...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
好吧......抱歉。那下次再來......

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
<FONT SIZE = 10>Okay...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
<FONT SIZE = 10>好吧......</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:

抱歉......

scripts.translation:
