scripts.text:
[Maram]
...

[Maram]
Yes... I'm sorry.
Then, next time...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
好吧......抱歉。那下次再來......

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
<FONT SIZE = 10>Alright...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
<FONT SIZE = 10>好吧......</FONT>

scripts.text: Eat the food Maram ordered.
scripts.translation: 吃掉瑪拉姆點的食物

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Oh? Hey, {0}! Nice to see you!
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 哦？嘿，{0}！好久不見！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
What a coincidence to meet here!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
真巧，居然在這裡碰到你！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Is the food here really good?
I tried it when I visited Rachel before and it was so delicious that I always make sure to visit this place whenever I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
這裡的東西好吃嗎？我之前來拉赫時吃過一次，味道特別好。每次來我都會特地來這家店。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Excuse me, could I have one dumpling, please?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
<FONT SIZE = 14>不好意思，請給我一個餃子。</FONT>

scripts.text: Ask what they're doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他們在做什麼

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Are you eating dumplings? Oh! Are you here in Rachel?
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 你在吃餃子嗎？哦！你也在拉赫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Well... I can't go into details, but I received a request, and after meeting with Niren, I suddenly needed extra guards, so I brought Duran and Alph with me.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯......詳情不方便說。我接了項委託，和尼倫會面後突然需要增派衛兵，所以就帶上了杜蘭和阿爾夫。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
So we're waiting for them, and if we have to wait too long, we might consider moving on to the next area...
But we'll see.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我們正在等他們。如果等太久，也許就先去下一個地方......到時再看吧。

scripts.text: Request assistance with the merchant disguise.
scripts.translation: 請求協助偽裝成商人

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Oh! That sounds like a good idea. Let's go find Mark and Maggie and head over together. They're probably shopping near the square.
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 哦！好主意。我們去找馬克和瑪姬，一起過去吧。他們應該在廣場附近逛。

scripts.text: Eat the food Maram ordered.
scripts.translation: 吃掉瑪拉姆點的食物

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Once you finish the dumplings, let's find Mark and Maggie and go together.
They're probably shopping near the square.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
吃完餃子後，我們去找馬克和瑪姬，一起過去吧。他們應該在廣場附近逛。

scripts.text: - The dumplings look delicious. -
scripts.translation: - 餃子看起來真好吃。 -

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello.
{0}.

[Maggi]
Oh... Hello...

[Tamarin]
Mark, Maggi, are you done with your business?
{0} introduced you to a job, right?
We're going to meet the client now, so let's go together.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
馬克、瑪姬，事情辦完了嗎？{0}給你們介紹了工作，對吧？我們現在要去見委託人，一起走吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh...
I found the book Alph requested.
But I couldn't find the snacks that Dew asked for.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
哦......我找到阿爾夫要的書了，但沒找到露想要的零食。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then we can leave now.
Let's head to the meeting place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那我們現在就出發，去約好的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh...
I found the book Alph requested.
But I couldn't find the snacks that Dew asked for.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
哦......我找到阿爾夫要的書了，但沒找到露想要的零食。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then we can leave now.
Let's head to the meeting place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那我們現在就出發，去約好的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello
{0}.

[Maggi]
Oh... Hello...

[Merchant Rencia]
Then please check if the ordered items are correct...
scripts.translation:
[商人 倫西亞]
那麼，請確認一下訂購的商品是否正確......

scripts.text: Hand over the check.
scripts.translation: 遞上清單

scripts.text:
[Merchant Rencia]
Ah~
The amount is just right!
Thank you!
Please use our service again next time~!
scripts.translation:
[商人 倫西亞]
啊～數量正好！謝謝惠顧！下次也歡迎光臨～！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Before you leave {0}, let's ^e5555echeck the path outside the door^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，離開之前，我們先^e5555e檢查門外的道路^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Before you leave {0}, let's ^e5555echeck the path outside the door^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
{0}，離開之前，我們先^e5555e檢查門外的道路^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
From now on, please escort {0} along with Miriam and Tamarin to ^e5555eOz Gorge^000000 located to the west.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的瑪拉姆]
接下來，請和米莉亞姆、塔馬林一起護送{0}前往西邊的^e5555e歐茲峽谷^000000。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
Considering the circumstances, I don't think we can take all these people with us, so I'll send them back and follow afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的瑪拉姆]
眼下這種情況，我想不能帶這麼多人一起走。我先送他們回去，之後再跟上。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
To avoid revealing our destination, it's best to move to a different location and send the people back.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的瑪拉姆]
為了不暴露目的地，最好換個地方把他們送回去。

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
The wind is rough...
[Maram] Ah! Finally, I'm out!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 啊！終於出來了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
If you head a bit ^e5555ewest^000000 from here, you'll find the entrance to the ^e5555evillage^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
從這裡往^e5555e西邊^000000走一小段，就能找到^e5555e村莊^000000入口。

scripts.text: Village?
scripts.translation: 村莊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It's more like a ^e5555ehideout^000000 where people who fled from Rachel hide rather than a village.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
與其說是村莊，不如說是拉赫逃難者的^e5555e藏身處^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It's better to see it for yourself than to hear me explain.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
與其聽我解釋，不如親自去看看。

scripts.text:
[Camper]
Hoooray~~~
Sometimes, camping like this isn't so bad~~~
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
耶～～～偶爾這樣露營也挺不錯的～～～

scripts.text: [Maram] It's me! Me!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 是我！我啊！

scripts.text:
[Camper]
You?
Do we know each other?
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
你？我們認識嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Is this the reaction when you bring an ^e5555eoutsider^000000?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
帶了個^e5555e外人^000000進來，就得到這種反應嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah...

[Imril]
Then I'll go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我先過去了。

scripts.text: [Maram] Oops!! Imril, wait a moment!!!!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 糟了！！伊姆里爾，等一下！！！！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah...

[Imril]
Then I'll go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我先過去了。

scripts.text: [Maram] Oops!! Imril, wait a moment!!!!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 糟了！！伊姆里爾，等一下！！！！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Suad is late...
What if she doesn't come at all?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
蘇阿德怎麼還沒來......他不會不來了吧？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We should return to Rachel.
If trust is already broken, ^e5555ewe might not be able to enter the village again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我們還是回拉赫吧。信任已經被破壞了，^e5555e我們恐怕再也進不了村子了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But if we continue like this, the people in the village will only suffer more.
If necessary, even the help of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
可再這樣下去，村裡的人只會越來越苦。如果有必要，就連外人的幫助也......

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
你不明白。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
...

[Maram]
I also... want to understand... you all...

[Miriam]
...

[Suad]
To bring an outsider without any consultation...
Consider yourself fortunate that I came to hear your last excuse, considering our past relationship.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
連商量都不商量就帶外人來......看在過去的情分上，我還願意聽你最後一次解釋，你就知足吧。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Suad!
Bringing an outsider to the village entrance without saying a word was reckless of me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
蘇阿德！我沒打招呼就把外人帶到村口，確實太魯莽了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But these individuals are trustworthy enough for Mother to entrust important tasks to them!
There's no need to worry; nothing bad will happen!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
可是這些人很可靠，母親才會把重要任務交給他們！別擔心，不會出事的！

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Is Niren giving you that much trust to handle tasks?
What does it matter if you have Niren's trust?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
尼倫這麼信任你，把任務交給你？就算有尼倫的信任又怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Niren doesn't even know that you're delivering goods here.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
<FONT SIZE = 14>尼倫根本不知道你把貨送到這裡來。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's...

[Miriam]
Stop mocking Suad.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
別挖苦蘇阿德。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I'm not mocking.
I'm just stating the truth...
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我沒挖苦他，只是在說事實......

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
If it's the truth, ^e5555ethen in Rachel, we won't have anyone to sell goods to us anymore,^000000 and we'll all starve to death like this.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
既然是事實，^e5555e那我們在拉赫就再也買不到物資，最後會全都餓死。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You can buy goods from Veins or other villages, but ^e5555ethe number of people who can pass through Oz Labyrinth is decreasing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們還能從維納斯或其他村莊買物資，可^e5555e能穿過歐茲迷宮的人越來越少了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
For now, ^e5555eif you have combat skills, you can pass by killing monsters,^000000 but later it might not be about combat skills; ^e5555ethe entire maze might be locked in lava.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
眼下^e5555e只要會戰鬥，就能擊敗魔物穿過迷宮，^000000可往後也許不是戰鬥能力的問題了；^e5555e整個迷宮都可能被熔岩封鎖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
By then, the people who could help wouldn't even be able to come this far.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
到那時，能幫忙的人連這裡都來不了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
And if only ^e5555emediation between the natives and immigrants requested by Mother could be achieved, we could cross Oz's Gorge again with a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
而且，只要能實現母親所希望的^e5555e原住民與移民和解，大家就能再次架起橋梁，穿過歐茲峽谷！

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Mediation? It seems like Niren is having another dreamy idea.
Just like when the ^e5555egray children^000000 appeared.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
和解？尼倫又在做不切實際的夢了。就像當年^e5555e灰色孩子^000000出現的時候一樣。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
But thanks to that, we were able to avoid hunger, and now we can help the children in the village.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
可也正因為有了灰色孩子，我們才沒有捱餓，現在還能幫助村裡的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Fine.
Then let's give them a chance.
Just like Niren gave us a chance.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
好吧，那就給他們一次機會，就像尼倫當年給我們機會一樣。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Really?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Seriously?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
當真？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What is it?
That reaction.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
怎麼了？你們這是什麼反應？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No~ No~
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒～沒什麼～謝謝你～

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then let's go to the ^e5555eVillage^000000 before Suad changes his mind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
趁蘇阿德還沒反悔，我們快去^e5555e村莊^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's discuss the details inside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
進去再談具體安排。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then let's hurry and go to the ^e5555evillage^000000 before Suad changes his mind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
趁蘇阿德還沒反悔，我們快點去^e5555e村莊^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's discuss the details inside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
進去再談具體安排。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hoo~
Shall we try lighting a campfire or something?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呼～要不要試著生個篝火什麼的？

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hey!</FONT>
You really came in, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
<FONT SIZE = 14>嘿！</FONT>你還真進來了啊？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
I did convey the message.
But ^e5555eSuad^000000 won't allow outsiders to enter the village!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我確實把訊息傳到了。不過^e5555e蘇阿德^000000不準外人進村！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
That probably indicates that the village situation isn't that good.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
看來村裡的情況確實不太好。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's difficult to be self-sufficient in this environment.
Even the trees are as hard as rocks.
Or perhaps they're not trees, but rocks?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
在這種環境下很難自給自足。連樹都硬得像石頭。或者它們根本不是樹，而是石頭？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I think the situation will improve if we can receive a little help from the outside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
要是能得到外界一點幫助，我想情況會好轉的。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
That would be good if it happens.
Suad may not have said it, but he must have been thinking about it for quite some time.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
要真能這樣就好了。蘇阿德雖然沒說出口，但這件事他肯定考慮很久了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
And it seems that {0}'s help with purchasing items was effective!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
看來{0}幫忙採購物資確實起了作用！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eThey may say that entry is only permitted when acquiring supplies^000000, but once they realize that you're ^e5555esomeone trustworthy^000000, they might feel more at ease.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
^e5555e他們可能會說只有採購物資時才准入村，^000000但等他們知道你是^e5555e值得信任的人^000000，或許就能放心一些。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, shall we start by talking to ^e5555ethe villagers^000000 for now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麼，我們先去和^e5555e村民們^000000聊聊吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eListening to the stories^000000 of the people and getting to know them might reveal ^e5555ethe key to what my mother entrusted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
^e5555e聽聽大家的經歷^000000，瞭解他們的處境，或許就能找到^e5555e母親託付之事的關鍵^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Thanks to you, I was able to safely pass through ^e5555eOz Labyrinth^000000.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
多虧了你，我才能平安穿過^e5555e歐茲迷宮^000000。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
In the past, as long as I was careful, traveling alone wasn't a big issue. But these days, it's getting harder to go alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
以前只要小心些，一個人旅行也不算難。可最近獨自上路越來越不容易了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Considering our village's current situation, I can't always have an escort, and besides, it's risky to attract attention by traveling in a group.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
考慮到村裡的情況，我也不能總有人護送。而且結伴出行太惹眼，也很危險。

scripts.text: [Imril] It would be great if we could investigate deeper into Oz Labyrinth. Status of the lava... Distribution of monsters...
scripts.translation: [伊姆里爾] 要是能深入調查歐茲迷宮就好了。熔岩的情況......魔物的分佈......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Adventurer, since you're strong, would you accompany me to ^e5555eOz Labyrinth when you have some free time^000000?
It might be a shameless request, but it's not every day that I have the chance to meet someone as strong as an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯......冒險者，你身手很好。有空時能陪我去^e5555e歐茲迷宮^000000嗎？這請求也許有些冒昧，但能遇到像你這麼強的人可不容易。

scripts.text: Depart now!
scripts.translation: 現在出發！

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 以後再說......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Alright!
If you're busy right now, I guess there's nothing to be done.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
好吧！你現在有事的話，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If you have time later, will you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
之後有空的話，願意陪我去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Wow!
Really?
You're willingly accepting my request like this? I'm touched!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
哇！真的嗎？你這麼爽快地答應了我的請求，真讓人感動！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then let's meet at ^e5555eOz Labyrinth entrance^000000 first!
You remember the way, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我們先在^e5555e歐茲迷宮入口^000000碰面！你還記得怎麼走吧？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The monsters that were moving or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to completely eliminate them.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
搬運物資或處理熔岩的魔物都很礙事。要是能把它們徹底除掉就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ah...
My skin feels prickly.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
啊......皮膚刺刺的。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where's the fool who dared to venture deep into the maze with such attire?
Be grateful you're not roasted alive!
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
那個穿成這樣還敢深入迷宮的傻瓜呢？沒被烤熟就該謝天謝地了！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, no matter what you say!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
反正不管你說什麼都......！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, ^e5555eOz Labyrinth situation is getting worse^000000.
^e5555eThe lava area is expanding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
總之，^e5555e歐茲迷宮的狀況越來越糟^000000。^e5555e熔岩區域正在擴大^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
At this rate, there won't be much time left to navigate through Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
照這樣下去，我們能在歐茲迷宮裡通行的時間就不多了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Indeed, if the lava has spread to that extent, we need a solution as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
確實，熔岩都擴散到這種程度了，必須儘快想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
For now...
To send workers, we need to reduce the number of monsters in Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
眼下得先減少歐茲迷宮裡的魔物，才能派工人進去。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou receive a favorable evaluation about you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Monsters that were moving luggage or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to eliminate them completely.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
搬運物資或處理熔岩的魔物都很礙事。要是能把它們徹底除掉就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
What do you say, adventurer?
^e5555eInterested in monster extermination^000000?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
冒險者，你覺得呢？^e5555e想不想參加討伐魔物的工作^000000？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
今天做得很好，謝謝你。明天也能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮一樓擊敗約20只{0}。^000000就算只減少一些魔物，也能大大方便穿越迷宮的旅人。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop here.
scripts.translation: 到此為止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
怎麼啦～你有事要忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful on your way back~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那回去的路上小心～

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮一樓擊敗約20只{0}。^000000就算只減少一些魔物，也能大大方便穿越迷宮的旅人。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
已經完成了嗎？真可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
This is still too dangerous, so ^ff0000wait until you're around level 200^000000 to try again!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
現在去還是太危險了，^ff0000等你大約達到200級再來試試吧^000000！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
今天做得很好，謝謝你。明天也能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮二樓擊敗約20只^000000{0}。只要魔物少一些，就能幫到穿過迷宮的商人。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful and go there~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那就小心地過去吧～

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮二樓擊敗約20只^000000{0}。只要魔物少一些，就能幫到穿過迷宮的商人。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
已經完成了嗎？真可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
怎麼啦～你有事要忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
The tournament is about to begin.
It's not a small-scale meeting that happens frequently; it's a tournament where trustworthy people from all around participate!
scripts.translation:
[村裡的男孩]
比賽馬上就要開始了。這可不是平時那種小聚會，而是各地可靠的人都會參加的錦標賽！

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
<NAVI>[Over there]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is where you should go. There's a spot for the adventurer too.
Of course, now that you're an adventurer, you're someone we can trust.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的男孩]
你要去的地方就在<NAVI>[那邊]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。那裡也給冒險者留了位置。當然，冒險者也是值得信賴的人。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
The meeting is about to start! Not just any meeting, but a competition!
<NAVI>[People]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> They're gathered together. Adventurers, go quickly!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
聚會馬上開始了！這可不是普通聚會，而是比賽！大家都聚在<NAVI>[那邊]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>了。冒險者，快過去吧！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
In our village, meetings are held frequently. Everyone gathers to share their opinions at those times.
But competitions are different! It's a really important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
我們村裡常常開會，大家會聚在一起交換意見。但比賽可不一樣！這是非常重要的活動！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Of course, not just anyone can participate.
They said only trustworthy friends from the village can join.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
當然不是誰都能參加。他們說只有村裡信得過的朋友才能加入。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Can adventurers participate in the event too?
Well, that's up to you, the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
冒險者也能參加活動嗎？那就看你自己啦，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
You have arrived. The business of 'Bearded Jack' is a hardware store.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
你到了。“大鬍子傑克”經營的是一家五金店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
歡迎光臨。有什麼可以幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
When it comes to kitchen knives and pots, there's no place like our shop in Rachel.
Take your time looking around.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
說到廚刀和鍋具，拉赫沒有比我們店更好的地方了。慢慢挑吧。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Uh, we came looking for something a little different.
What was that, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呃，我們想找點不太一樣的東西。冒險者，你說的是什麼來著？

scripts.text: Smelly Sock
scripts.translation: 臭襪子

scripts.text: Smelly Dandelion
scripts.translation: 臭蒲公英

scripts.text: Scented Sock
scripts.translation: 香襪子

scripts.text: Scented Dandelion
scripts.translation: 香蒲公英

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Hmm, I don't think that was it.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
嗯，我想應該不是這個。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Why would you find such dirty things in our store?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
你們為什麼要在我們店裡找這種髒東西？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, look who's finally arrived.
Did you come to check out the place where the fragrant dandelions bloom?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
喲，你總算來了。是想去看看香蒲公英盛開的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Go to Veins. You'll find me there.
In a corner of Veins Village, there's a weapon merchant that not many people know about.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
去維納斯找我吧。在維納斯村的角落裡，有個鮮為人知的武器商人。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
If anyone asks who recommended you, just say it's Jack's recommendation, of course.
They're probably just doing business for a short time so they can hit and run quickly. so if you're too late, they won't deal with you
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
要是有人問是誰介紹的，就說是傑克推薦的。他們大概只做一陣子生意，賣完就撤。去晚了可就不做你的生意了。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, after connecting to <NAVI>[Weapon Shop]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> it's not under my jurisdiction anymore.
Well then, give it your best shot.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
既然已經聯絡上<NAVI>[武器店]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，之後就不歸我管了。那就祝你順利。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Um, I don't think it was.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
嗯，我覺得不是這個。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
No, our store is a hardware store, not a laundry.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
不對，我們這裡是五金店，不是洗衣店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, <NAVI>[Weapon Merchant]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is not under my jurisdiction since you linked it.
Then do your best.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
既然已經聯絡上<NAVI>[武器商人]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，之後就不歸我管了。祝你順利。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. This is 'Bearded Jack' hardware store.
We sell very well-made kitchen knives and pots.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
歡迎光臨，這裡是“大鬍子傑克”五金店。我們賣做工精良的廚刀和鍋具。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
My name? Of course, it's Bearded Jack.
This store is all mine!
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子傑克]
我叫什麼？當然是大鬍子傑克。這家店可是我的！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello~
Are you in business?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好～你們營業嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
We're closed.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
打烊了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Don't be like that. I came here because Jack introduced me, saying there are smelly dandelions here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
別這樣嘛。傑克說這裡有臭蒲公英，所以我才來的。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Who is it, Dandelion, who is it!
hich jerk came up with such a strange password!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
誰啊？蒲公英？到底是誰！哪個混蛋想出這麼奇怪的暗號？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, your name is... So, it was Dandelion.
For something related to security, it's quite simple, isn't it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，你的名字是......所以你叫蒲公英。拿這種事當暗號也太簡單了吧。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Anyway, what's going on!
If you came to buy weapons, just take what you need without hesitation.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
不管了，你們有什麼事！要買武器就別客氣，想拿什麼儘管拿。

scripts.text: I came here to buy some weapons...
scripts.translation: 我來買些武器......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right? What the adventurer is saying is correct.
Rather than coming to buy one or two weapons, it's more like a bulk purchase, shall we say?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
對吧，冒險者說得沒錯。與其說買一兩件武器，不如說是要大量採購。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Bulk purchase? How much are you planning to buy?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
大量採購？你打算買多少？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Well, roughly this much?
Is this amount acceptable at this store?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
大概這麼多。你們店裡接得下這筆生意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Gulp, th-that much? Are you suggesting war?
W-well, if you give me a little time, it seems possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
咕......這、這麼多？你們是要開戰嗎？好、好吧，給我一點時間的話，應該辦得到。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What should we do? We don't have much time.
I hope we can find it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
怎麼辦？我們時間不多，希望能儘快找到貨。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Call your schedule. I'll try to accommodate as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
說個時間吧，我會盡量儘快安排。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's good too, but how about connecting us directly with the supplier?
We'll take care of the intermediary fees without any inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那也行。不過，能不能直接介紹我們認識供應商？中間費用我們可以處理，彼此都方便。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Hey! Who's revealing the background while doing business!
Enough, go back, go back!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
喂！做生意時誰會把幕後情況說出來！夠了，回去，快回去！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hey, who are you kidding? I already know everything. Selling this at such a special price is just a flashy business strategy, right?
Anyway, we're not going to have a long-term business relationship, are we?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
別裝了，我都知道。用這麼低的價格賣貨，不過是個吸引眼球的生意伎倆，對吧？反正我們也不會長期合作，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, I'm just asking for a bit of information from your end.
Whether it's our urgent situation or the guy taking off the intermediary fee, either works. Isn't it a win-win?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
所以我只是想向你打聽一點訊息。我們急著要貨，也能替你省下中間費用，這不是雙贏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Mmm... Alright. But absolutely do not leak it.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
嗯......好吧。不過絕對不能洩露出去。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Such obvious words.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
這話說得可真直白。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
It's the Thor Volcano. Deep inside, there's a secret base, and the weapons come from there.
I'm letting you know because once their stock there runs out, the deal is going to be cut off anyway.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
索爾火山。深處有個秘密基地，武器就是從那裡運來的。反正那裡的庫存一旦賣光，這筆生意也就結束了，我才告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From the way you're talking, it seems like you'll cut ties soon, huh?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
聽你的口氣，看來你們很快就要斷掉這條線了？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，別再套話了，剩下的自己去查。既然得到了想要的訊息，就付中介費走人。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thor Volcano's secret base... this smells very suspicious.
I have a feeling this might be our final destination, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
索爾火山的秘密基地......聽起來很可疑。我覺得那裡可能就是我們的最終目的地，你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at <NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們在<NAVI>[索爾火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>碰面。記得做好準備！別直接進軍事基地，從那裡的三點鐘方向過來，我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，別再套話了，剩下的自己去查。既然得到了想要的訊息，就付中介費走人。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at<NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們在<NAVI>[索爾火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>碰面。記得做好準備！別直接進軍事基地，從那裡的三點鐘方向過來，我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Over here! Follow me!
Here's a <NAVI>[shortcut]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that will take you around a bit, but it'll keep you out of sight.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
這邊！跟我來！這裡有條<NAVI>[捷徑]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，會稍微繞點路，但能避開別人的視線。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh? Suad! Miriam and Maram are here too.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
哦？蘇阿德！米莉亞姆和瑪拉姆也來了。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's going on, everyone? If it's about the weapons, I've already said everything before.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
大家這是怎麼了？如果是武器的事，我之前已經說清楚了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Is there something else that needs to be said besides that?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
除了這件事，還有什麼好說的？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Hey~ that's scary~ Why all of a sudden? Bringing in strangers too. Is there something to be afraid of?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
哎呀～真嚇人～怎麼突然帶著陌生人來了？有什麼好怕的？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What nonsense is this? I'm more afraid of you guys! How can you attack the upper ranks?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
胡說什麼？我才更怕你們！你們怎麼能襲擊上級？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh, that? You don't have to praise me.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
哦，那件事啊？不用特地誇我。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Really~Ah?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真的嗎～啊？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We came to hear the reason why you attacked the innocent upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我們是來問你們為何襲擊那些無辜的上層人士。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's this about? You've all gathered here over something trivial?
scripts.translation:
[坤]
這是怎麼回事？大家為這點小事都聚到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Something trivial? Because of what you've done, we're being branded as rebels. You've given them an excuse to attack us!
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
小事？因為你們的所作所為，我們被當成了叛徒。你們這是給了他們攻擊我們的藉口！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
If they attack us, we'll just counterattack. What's there to worry about? We have weapons now too, you know?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
他們敢打過來，我們就還擊，有什麼好擔心的？我們現在也有武器了！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Do you know who we robbed? If you knew, you'd thank us. It wasn't an innocent upper rank, you know?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
你知道我們搶的是誰嗎？知道的話你就會感謝我們。那可不是什麼無辜的上層人士！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Do you know what it's called when you attack and rob the upper ranks regardless of innocence? It's called robbery.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
不管對方是否無辜，襲擊並搶劫上層人士，這種行為就叫搶劫。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
No, this is too much. Robbery? We targeted Ahmad's upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
不，這也太過分了。搶劫？我們針對的是艾哈邁德手下的上層人士。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
If it's Ahmad...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
如果是艾哈邁德......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Isn't it Suad's?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那不是蘇阿德的繼父嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Yeah! They treated us like trash and even ignored their own sons!
scripts.translation:
[坤]
沒錯！他們把我們當垃圾，連自己的兒子都不放在眼裡！

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
They were sucking people like us dry!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
他們一直在榨乾我們這些人！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Isn't it a good thing that we sought revenge on Suad and secured the necessary supplies?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
向蘇阿德報仇，還拿到了需要的物資，這不是好事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Exactly!! You suffered a lot because of your father. You came here because of him.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
就是！！你因為父親吃了那麼多苦，才會來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Simply because you're indigenous, he not only refused to acknowledge you as a capable son but also subjected you to abuse. In fact, he probably never even acknowledged you as his son.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
就因為你是原住民，他不但不承認你是個有本事的兒子，還虐待你。說不定他根本沒把你當兒子看過。

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Is there anyone here who doesn't know Suad's story??
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
還有誰不知道蘇阿德的遭遇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
You always imagined it in your heart, right? You didn't deserve such treatment. You wanted revenge against your stepfather.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
你心裡一直這麼想，對吧？你本不該受這種對待，也一直想向繼父報仇。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Say something, Suad.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
蘇阿德，你說句話啊。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
...Sigh... Alright, I understand... Just... Let's be careful next time. I understand why you did what you did, but we could end up in even bigger trouble...
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
......唉......好吧，我明白了......只是......下次謹慎些。我理解你們為什麼這麼做，但我們可能會惹上更大的麻煩......

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Is that the end of it?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
蘇阿德？這就算了？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I may not know much about this kind of thing, but from my limited perspective, won't they continue like this in the future? Shouldn't we arm ourselves just in case?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我不太懂這些事，不過照我看來，他們以後可能還會這麼做。我們是不是該做好武裝自衛的準備？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Given the shortage of supplies in the village, that's true. It's becoming increasingly difficult for trade.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
村裡物資短缺，貿易也越來越難，這話倒沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
And as I mentioned before, being armed is necessary. We'll need to find new sources while keeping what we've already acquired. That's why I wanted to discuss it with you all
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
正如我之前所說，武裝起來是有必要的。我們得保住現有物資，同時尋找新的來源，所以才想和大家商量。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Tell us. Are you completely unaware of this decision? Can you honestly say you have no involvement in this matter?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
蘇阿德？說清楚。你真的完全不知道這個決定嗎？你能坦白說這件事與你毫無關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Wait, wait. I need some time to gather my thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
等等，等等。讓我整理一下思緒。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The damage... is too great.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
損失......太慘重了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Moreover, with the bloodshed that occurred, rumors of a native uprising will spread in no time. It's already a bad situation with the headquarters attack incident.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
而且發生了流血事件，原住民起義的謠言很快就會傳開。總部遇襲一事已經讓局勢很糟了。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Don't worry about public opinion. Let us handle the recovery.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
輿論方面不用擔心，善後工作交給我們。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It turns out that recent events were all part of a scheme.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
看來最近發生的事都是一場陰謀。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It was our oversight not to examine the suspicious movements within the temple more closely.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我們沒有仔細調查神殿內的可疑動向，這是我們的疏忽。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Let's save self-blame for later and focus on resolving the situation on both sides for now.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
自責的事以後再說，現在先想辦法平息雙方的局勢。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Are we sure about the involvement of the Youth Amal Vice-Chancellor?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
青年阿瑪爾的副議長也參與其中，這點能確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
After the setback, my deputy, who had been languishing, suddenly regained vigor and became enthusiastic. Since then, tensions between the natives and immigrants of Arunafeltz have gradually escalated.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
受挫後，一直消沉的副手突然振作起來，變得幹勁十足。從那之後，阿魯納菲茲的原住民和移民之間的衝突就逐漸加劇了。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That aligns roughly with the time when the Heart Hunters escaped from the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
這大致和心之獵手從宅邸逃脫的時間吻合。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It seems certain that they conspired together after all.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
看來他們果然合謀了。

scripts.text: Because I even witnessed it.
scripts.translation: 因為我親眼看見了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
One thing that's troubling is that the Vice-Chancellor of Youth Amal wouldn't be unaware of the value of the Imir's Heart Fragment. Simply causing conflict by infiltrating the organization wouldn't have been enough to easily betray it...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
令人擔心的是，青年阿瑪爾的副議長不可能不知道伊米爾之心碎片的價值。僅僅潛入組織、製造衝突，不足以讓他輕易背叛組織......

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Did they agree to receive something more and hand it over?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
他們是不是答應收下更有價值的東西，再把碎片交出去？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'm not sure, but my deputy... No, I need to go and confirm it myself.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我不確定。不過我的副手......不，我得親自去確認。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where are you going? Do you have any idea where to start looking?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
你要去哪裡？知道該從哪裡查起嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
There's a summer villa on the outskirts of Rachel. Recently, my deputy has been frequenting that place for medical treatment. If he's colluding with those mad scientists to plan something, that's probably where he'd be.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
拉赫郊外有棟避暑別墅。最近我的副手常去那裡療養。要是他和那些瘋狂科學家勾結著策劃什麼，那裡很可能就是他們的據點。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
We'll need to do some tracking.
scripts.translation:
[迷你艾莉]
看來得追蹤調查了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Tracking down the person who stole the Heart Fragment should be left to Miriam. I hope the adventurer will accompany her.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
竊取心之碎片的人就交給米莉亞姆追查吧。希望冒險者能陪她一起去。

scripts.text: Understood.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
We'll stay here to attend to the injured and identify any remaining stragglers who might still be around. We also need to consider public opinion.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我們會留在這裡照顧傷員，並確認附近是否還有漏網之魚。輿論方面也得考慮。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We need to return to the forest and handle the aftermath there as well.
Miriam, adventurer. Then I entrust you with tracking.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我們也得回森林處理那邊的善後。米莉亞姆、冒險者，追查的事就拜託你們了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Let's go, adventurer. Before heading to the villa, there's someone who will accompany us. Let's meet at <NAVI>[������ �̷�]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
走吧，冒險者。去別墅之前還有個人要和我們同行。我們在<NAVI>[歐茲迷宮]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>碰面。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We agreed to meet Miriam at <NAVI>[Maze of Oz]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們約好在<NAVI>[歐茲迷宮]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>和米莉亞姆見面。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
The situation here is not so good these days.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
最近這附近的情況不太好。

scripts.text:
Arrived at the meeting place.
It seems like the others haven't arrived yet.
Let's wait.
scripts.translation: 你已到達約定地點。其他人似乎還沒到，先等等吧。

scripts.text: Were you waiting for Miriam?
scripts.translation: 你在等米莉亞姆嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I asked for my mother's permission and came out for a moment.
I'm in the middle of handling the protest so I have to go back soon but...
Where is Miriam?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我向母親請示後，暫時出來了一會兒。我還在處理抗議活動，很快就得回去......米莉亞姆呢？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
There she comes.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
她來了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Sorry for being late. I took some time to find someone.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
抱歉來晚了，我花了點時間找人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
This is Ira.
She's a child who often brings my father's books, but she needs help to enter the villa.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
這位是艾拉。她常替我父親送書，不過這次得有人幫她進入別墅。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What, why is Ira here?
Is she related to this matter?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
咦，艾拉怎麼也來了？她和這件事有關嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Long time no see, Maramoppa.
I came to repay a favor to Miriam unnie while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
好久不見，瑪拉姆歐帕。我也正好趁這個機會幫米莉亞姆歐尼一個忙。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
You said there's something to see at the villa?
I've been pushing Sir Amal's wheelchair around, so I've been everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
你說別墅裡有東西要看？我最近一直推著阿瑪爾大人的輪椅四處走，那裡我都熟。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Coincidentally, I have the keys for the servants. I haven't returned them yet because I've been accompanying Sir Amal recently.
Even recently, I haven't returned them as I've been out with Sir Amal.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
正好我還留著僕人用的鑰匙。最近我一直陪著阿瑪爾大人，所以還沒還回去。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
And about that villa.
Sometimes we lend it to the priests.
That's what happened this time too.
But it's a bit strange.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
說到那棟別墅，有時我們會借給牧師住，這次也是如此。不過這回有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Strange?
It would be good if you could be specific.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
奇怪？能具體說說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
They said some priests would be staying for a while, but it feels like a lie...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
他們說有幾位牧師要住一陣子，可我覺得這像是在撒謊......

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like Sir Amal is operating another secret group.
Last time, he said he'd wage war but got pushed out of the temple, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
阿瑪爾大人好像又在暗中組織人手。上次他說要發動戰爭，結果被趕出了神殿，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like he hasn't given up yet.
This time, there seem to be more dangerous people staying at the villa than last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
看來他還沒放棄。這次住在別墅裡的人，好像比上次更危險。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
I don't care who, but I wish someone would stop him.
The atmosphere is not good either.
If there's a war, we, the indigenous people, will be the ones caught in the crossfire.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
誰去阻止他都好，我只希望有人能出手。現在的氣氛也很糟。要是打起來，我們原住民肯定會被捲進戰火。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Well... no, it won't be a war.
You can relax, it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
嗯......不會打起來的。放心，沒事。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Sister! How can you be so calm?
Do you know how scary it was for me to manage the villa?!
Especially with that strange woman there...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
歐尼！你怎麼還能這麼冷靜？你知道我管理別墅時有多害怕嗎？！尤其是裡面還有那個奇怪的女人......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hahaha....
Alright, calm down, Ira.
We're gathered here to figure that out now.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哈哈......好了，艾拉，冷靜點。我們現在聚在這裡，就是要查清楚這件事。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
For that reason, we're planning to enter the villa where aggressive guests are staying.
Since they seem to be the same people we encountered at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
所以我們打算潛入有激進分子住宿的別墅。他們看起來就是我們在神殿遇到的那夥人。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I understand what you mean.
Honestly, I'd like to go with you.
But there are still things I need to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我明白你的意思。說實話，我也想一起去，但還有些事得處理。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Yeah. I hurriedly asked for permission and left for a moment.
I still need to handle the protest and do some coordination work.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒錯。我剛才是匆忙請示後才出來的，還得處理抗議活動、協調各方。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Sorry, but Suadand I won't be able to go with you..
Can you understand?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
抱歉，我和蘇阿德不能陪你們去。你能理解嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Of course.
It's better for you to handle matters among yourselves.
I'll rely on the people of the Wolf Village.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
當然，你們留在這裡處理自己的事務更合適。我會請狼村的人幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Then, {0}, will you scout the villa with us?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
那麼，{0}，你願意和我們一起去別墅偵察嗎？

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Thank you for understanding.
If you safely enter the villa, we'll bring Ira with us.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
謝謝你理解。等你們順利進入別墅，我們就帶艾拉過去。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Thank you.
Then, Ira. Will you send us to the villa?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
謝謝。艾拉，你能送我們去別墅嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Of course.
Just talk to me when you're ready.
I'll send you right away.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
當然可以。準備好後告訴我，我馬上送你們過去。

scripts.text:
You can enter the MD Memorial's villa story mode.
Adventurers who have already completed it can only enter to accompany fellow adventurers.
Would you like to enter together for your companion?
scripts.translation: 可以進入記憶迷宮“別墅”的劇情模式。已完成該副本的冒險者只能陪同其他冒險者進入。要和同伴一起進去嗎？

scripts.text: Enter the {0}
scripts.translation: 進入{0}

scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000
Accompanying is not currently possible. Please check if your accompanying party member has applied for MD.
scripts.translation: 目前無法進行陪同。請確認同行隊員是否已申請進入記憶迷宮。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000只有隊伍成員才能進入記憶迷宮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Temple Knight]
The Sanctuary Sethrumnir.
The general chapel is not here, so please go back.
scripts.translation:
[神殿騎士]
這裡是聖所塞特魯姆尼爾。普通禮拜堂不在這裡，請回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Phew... It's hot!
It used to be a cool cave...
Now, just standing still feels like sweat is pouring down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
呼......好熱！這裡以前明明是涼爽的洞窟......現在站著不動都像在淌汗。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If we stay too long, I might get dizzy, so let's explore quickly.
For now, this path is an ^e5555eexternal path^000000, so we just need to walk straight.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
待太久我可能會頭暈，我們快點探索吧。眼前這條是^e5555e外側通道^000000，沿路直走就行。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Someone left their luggage behind.
Sometimes when facing monsters or feeling too exhausted to carry items, people hide their luggage like this and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
有人把行李落在這裡了。遇到魔物或累得搬不動東西時，有人會把行李藏在這裡再繼續趕路。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
While it's important to move items, life is precious.
Since we're close to the entrance here, it's convenient to retrieve the items later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
搬運物資固然重要，但生命更寶貴。這裡離入口近，之後回來取也方便。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's leave this luggage for now and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
先把行李留在這裡，繼續往前走吧。

scripts.text: - A box has been left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 有人把箱子留在這裡了。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The path here is rough, so be careful.
You might slip and hurt your ankle if you're not careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這段路很難走，小心點。一個不留神就可能滑倒，扭傷腳踝。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's go down straight from here.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
從這裡直接往下走吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hoo!
It's hot!
Steam is escaping from the cracked crevice.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
呼！好熱！蒸汽正從裂縫裡冒出來。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Fortunately, the ground seems okay for now, but steam rising indicates that the ground deep below has heated up, so we might not be able to go much further before lava starts flowing.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
幸好地面暫時還沒問題，不過冒出蒸汽說明深處的地面已經升溫。再往前走不遠，熔岩可能就會流出來。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It's really serious that it's starting to heat up near the main path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
連主路附近都開始升溫，情況相當嚴重......

scripts.text: [???] Imril!!
scripts.translation: [???] 伊姆里爾！！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you okay, Paul?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
保羅，你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Haha...
I got hit by hot steam while running away from monsters.
I let my guard down on the path I always took.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
哈哈......我逃離魔物時被熱蒸汽燙傷了。連平時常走的路都大意了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I'm not sure where my belongings went either.
Getting hurt and losing my belongings, it's miserable...
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
我也不知道自己的東西掉在哪裡了。受了傷還丟了東西，真倒霉......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Don't say that, your life is more important than your belongings.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
別這麼說，生命比行李重要。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Yeah...
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
是啊......謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
I have some potions here, so drink this and return to the village first.
You can find your belongings later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我這裡有些藥水，你先喝下去回村休息。東西之後再找。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
No, keep it!
We can't waste the village's valuable resources like this.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不用，留著吧！不能這樣浪費村裡寶貴的資源。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
休息一會兒就回村裡塗藥膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不過，我恢復時不想被魔物襲擊。能幫我^e5555e清理附近的魔物^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
休息一會兒就回村裡塗藥膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不過，我恢復時不想被魔物襲擊。能幫我^e5555e清理附近的魔物^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Phew~
Thanks!
I'm feeling a bit better now and can move.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
呼～謝謝！我感覺好多了，已經能走動了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
那我慢慢回村了。調查迷宮固然重要，也要注意身體。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
知道了。保重，保羅。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯......各處冒出的蒸汽確實是個大問題，不只是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
旅人很少會繼續往下走，但要是被魔物追趕，可能會慌不擇路......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我們先^e5555e再往下走一點^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
那我慢慢回村了。調查迷宮固然重要，也要注意身體。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
知道了。保重，保羅。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯......各處冒出的蒸汽確實是個大問題，不只是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
旅人很少會繼續往下走，但要是被魔物追趕，可能會慌不擇路......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我們先^e5555e再往下走一點^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
There's some luggage here too...
Could this be the luggage Paul lost?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這裡也有行李......會不會是保羅丟的？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's just remember the location for now and retrieve it later.
We still need to check ^e5555efurther down^000000.
This way...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
先記下位置，以後再回來拿。我們還得去^e5555e更深處^000000看看。走這邊......

scripts.text: - The box is left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 這個箱子無人看管。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ugh...
The heat is already unbearable.
It's even more dangerous down here, so we really need to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
唉......熱得實在受不了。下面更危險，一定要小心。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
To be honest, unless you're as strong as an adventurer, coming this far is as good as a death sentence.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
說實話，若沒有冒險者那樣的實力，走到這裡基本就等於送死。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But since I'm here with you, I'll venture further down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
不過既然有你同行，我就繼續往下走吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It seems like the monsters down here have slightly changed their form just from coming down a bit further.
Even this level of change could pose a risk to adventurers, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
再往下走一段，魔物的外形似乎就有些變化了。即使是這麼輕微的變化，也可能威脅到冒險者，你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Since it's too dangerous here, let's just take a quick look around and then head back to town.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這裡太危險了，我們簡單檢視一下週圍就回村吧。

scripts.text: [Imril] Elder!!!! You're safe!!!
scripts.translation: [伊姆里爾] 長老！！！！您沒事吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
No.
Who is this?
Isn't this Imril?
Why did you come to such a dangerous place?
scripts.translation:
[長老]
沒事。咦，這不是伊姆里爾嗎？你怎麼跑到這麼危險的地方來了？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
No, why are you really here, Elder.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
不對，長老，您怎麼會在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
The maze master is in the maze, where else would I be.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
我可是迷宮大師，不在迷宮裡還能在哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But this place is too dangerous with monsters...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
可是這裡魔物橫行，實在太危險了......

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Well, it's not only here, so don't worry.
With all the noise the monsters are making these days, I thought there might be someone in danger and came down to check.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
這裡還好，別擔心。最近魔物鬧得厲害，我擔心有人遇險，就下來看看。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
I've told Suad that the lava has reached this far, and below here, the ground has already melted a lot, making it even more dangerous, so don't go down.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
我已經告訴蘇阿德，熔岩蔓延到這裡了。再往下地面已經融化得很嚴重，更加危險，千萬別下去。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
If it were an adventurer next to you, it might be okay, but it's too dangerous for you.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
旁邊那位冒險者或許沒問題，但你可不能再往下走了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Please take care of yourself, Elder.
Hurry back to the village.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
明白了。長老，您也多保重，快回村吧。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
哎呀～迷宮大師不在迷宮裡，誰來管理迷宮呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, stubbornness...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
真是固執......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As Inspirational said, I don't think I can handle going further down, so let's go back to the ^e5555evillage^000000.
I feel like my skin is burning even now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
正如英斯皮雷申所說，我覺得沒法再往下走了。我們回^e5555e村莊^000000吧，我現在就覺得皮膚火辣辣的。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze Master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
哎呀～迷宮大師不在迷宮裡，誰來管理迷宮呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, you're so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
真是固執......

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As the elder said, I don't think I can go down any further, so let's go back to ^e5555eVillage^00000.
Even now, my skin feels like it's going to burn.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
長老說得對，我覺得不能再往下走了。我們回^e5555e村莊^00000吧。我現在就覺得皮膚火辣辣的。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at him breathing. Isn't our little pup just adorable?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，瞧它呼吸的樣子。我們的小狗崽真可愛！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hey, buddy, it's time for you to learn a foreign language too...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
嘿，夥計，你也該學門外語了......

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at this! Look at the way they're breathing. They're a genius at inhaling and exhaling! A true genius!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，快看！瞧它們呼吸的樣子，吸氣吐氣都這麼有天賦，真是天才！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello! Scania!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好，斯堪尼亞！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Maram? When did you come? You came earlier than expected?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
瑪拉姆？你什麼時候來的？比我想的早啊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thanks to the adventurer's help, I came a little faster this time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
多虧冒險者幫忙，這次我提前到了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Is this the newcomer who just arrived?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
這就是剛來的新人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, that's not it. He is not from around here. He is from a completely different place. He helped with purchasing goods this time, and they've transported them all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦，不是。他不是本地人，來自很遠的地方。這次他幫忙採購物資，還一路把東西運到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hmm... An adventurer...? So, they're an outsider? Are we sure about your identity? What if we search through everything he have?
Or perhaps we could let slip some information over there? If not, what if they try to claim our land like those immigrants?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
嗯......冒險者？也就是說是外人？我們確定他的身份嗎？要不要把他的東西都搜一遍？或者讓他不小心透露點訊息？萬一他像那些移民一樣來搶我們的土地呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No, not him! He have nothing but kind words for everyone they meet! They're not that kind of person at all. Why would you compare him to those troublemakers?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不，他不是那種人！他對遇到的每個人都很友善，怎麼能把他和那些惹事的人相提並論？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you think someone's intentions are written on their face? Whether they're a thief or a military member, that's something we'll find out over time!
Isha brought back a wolf cub, and now, Marem, are you bringing back people?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你以為看臉就能看出一個人的心思嗎？他是盜賊還是軍人，還得慢慢觀察！伊莎才帶回來一隻狼崽，現在瑪拉姆你又帶了個人回來？

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person, though.
scripts.translation: 我可不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, of course, what comes out of their mouth isn't the truth. It's just talk, that's all.
By the way, a wolf cub? What wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦，當然，不能只聽一個人怎麼說，嘴上說說誰都會。對了，狼崽？什麼狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh! Isha brought back a Baby Grey Wolf from the forest not too long ago! She won't even listen when we tell her to take it back to the woods!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哦！不久前伊莎從森林裡帶回來一隻小灰狼！我們叫她把狼崽送回樹林，她就是不聽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you know what that means? It's already causing trouble for our sheep! Even now, it's behaving like that. What will happen when it gets bigger? It will definitely harm our sheep!
So, why don't you go and try saying it once! I won't listen to what you say!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你知道這意味著什麼嗎？它已經開始禍害我們的羊了！現在就這樣，長大了還得了？肯定會傷到羊！你去勸勸她吧！反正我不會聽你說的！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh? That's actually a great suggestion. It would be a very constructive conversation. But what should I do? I have to tidy up the stuff I brought.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦？這主意倒不錯，正好可以好好談談。不過我還得整理剛帶來的東西，怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, of course! Adventurer! Would you care to go? Explore this place, take in the sights, and perhaps make a lasting impression on the locals as well.
Since we'll be staying here for a while anyway, right? Everyone here is as friendly and kind-hearted as I am, so you won't encounter any hostility.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，對了！冒險者，要不要去看看？四處探索、欣賞風景，也給村民們留下個好印象。反正我們會在這裡住一陣子，對吧？這裡的人都和我一樣熱情友善，你不會碰壁的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right, Scania?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
是吧，斯堪尼亞？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
......

[Maram]
Just go and check whether what Aisha brought back is a real wolf cub or just a puppy that looks like a wolf.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
去確認一下艾莎帶回來的究竟是狼崽，還是長得像狼的小狗。

scripts.text: What about verifying it?
scripts.translation: 要去確認一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh... well, I haven't really thought that far. But wouldn't it be troublesome if it's really a wolf cub? Even a puppy would be a hassle in that case.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦......我還沒想那麼遠。不過要真是狼崽，確實會很麻煩吧？即使只是小狗，也挺讓人為難的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let me explain for our newly arrived adventurer. Here, the land is such that there aren't many animals suitable for raising.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我先給剛來的冒險者解釋一下。這裡的環境不適合飼養很多種動物。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Mostly, Skania takes care of the sheep and chickens. There are hardly any cattle or pigs that can adapt to such places. Therefore, livestock is really precious here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
平時主要由斯堪尼亞照看羊和雞。這裡幾乎養不了適應環境的牛或豬，所以牲畜非常珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But what if what Aisha is carrying is indeed a wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
可要是艾莎帶回來的是狼崽呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The mother is coming to find her cub!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
狼媽媽會來找自己的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Even if the mother doesn't come looking for it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
要是狼媽媽不來呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The cub will grow up and start harming the livestock!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
狼崽長大以後就會傷害牲畜！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Did you hear?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你聽見了吧？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Where did Aisha live again? Ah, right! <NAVI>[Upper Side]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, if you go there, you'll find Aisha's house.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
艾莎住在哪兒來著？啊，對了！去<NAVI>[上方]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就能找到她家。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But there's no point in saying it, right? If I persuade you, it might change your mind about me too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
反正說了也沒用吧？我要是勸你，說不定你對我的看法也會變。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Adventurer, then, please go and return safely! I'll take my leave for now too!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
冒險者，那就拜託你了，一定要平安回來！我也先告辭了！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, no matter how many times I say it to you, it won't make a difference, will it? If I persuade you, it might change my opinion of you too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，不管我跟你說多少次都沒用吧？我要是勸你，說不定我對你的看法也會改變。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for a hundred days won't help? If you convince me, I'll change my opinion of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，勸上一百天也沒用嗎？你要是說服了我，我就改變對你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Woof woof. Today's walk is over now. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
汪汪。今天散步就到這裡吧，我累了。

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
哈啊——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I can't let you go alone. How can I send you to such a dangerous place alone? Of course, I know you can handle a walk by yourself, but I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我不能讓你一個人去啊！怎麼能讓你獨自去那麼危險的地方？我知道你自己能應付，但還是擔心。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Aisha? Why are you here? Did you come to return the wolf?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
艾莎？你怎麼來了？是來送狼崽回去的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
No, it's not like that. You brought the wolf... with you? In front of the sheep? Are you out of your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
不對，不是那樣。你把狼帶來了？還帶到羊群面前？你瘋了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Why on earth are you trying to raise a wolf? Do you need a dog? Then get a dog.
No, I'll just become the dog. I'll mess up your house too and occasionally bite you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你幹嘛非要養狼？想養狗的話就養狗啊。不如我來當狗好了，我會把你家弄得亂七八糟，還會時不時咬你。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, I heard your wishes loud and clear. So, did you even send a person to me? Are you treating me like some kind of a contractor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亞，你的話我都聽見了。你甚至派人來找我？你把我當成什麼委託人了嗎，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Despite all your efforts, so what? This person has already sided with me! Hahaha! Come on, show me that face of despair!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你費盡心思又怎麼樣？這位已經站在我這邊了！哈哈哈！來，讓我看看你絕望的表情！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
What? Adventurer? You betrayed me? How could you do that? Betrayal at first sight, isn't that too much? I should have known. Outsiders like you can't be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
什麼？冒險者，你背叛我了？怎麼能這樣？剛見面就背叛，也太過分了吧！我早該知道，外人根本不可信。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, have you ever been to the Ice Caves? Is the blood flowing in your veins colder than the frozen water there? You cold-blooded one!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亞，你去過冰洞嗎？你血管裡的血比那裡的冰水還冷嗎？你這個冷血的傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How can you even suggest sending this small and fragile little creature back to such a dangerous place? Its mother is dead, and it can't survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你怎麼能把這麼弱小的孩子送回那麼危險的地方？它的母親已經死了，它自己活不下去。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Its mother... is gone?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
它的母親......死了？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I said that, didn't I? I told you a hundred times. You didn't listen again, did you? You just believe what you want to believe, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不是說過了嗎？都告訴你一百遍了，你又沒聽吧？你只相信自己想相信的，對不對？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't know about you, but I can't bear to send this small and fragile young wolf back to the market.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你怎麼想我不管，但我不忍心把這麼弱小的幼狼送回去。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But if that wolf grows up, our sheep...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
可是等狼長大了，我們的羊......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't worry about that. Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
那不用擔心。冒險者？

scripts.text: Oh, do I need to talk about it?
scripts.translation: 哦，需要我來說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You won't listen to me anyway. You never listen to me when I talk, and you only believe what other people say.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
反正你也不會聽我的。我說的話你從來不聽，只相信別人說的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This wolf cub will be fine if it is trained. If it grows up with other friends from a young age, it will not harm them and will instead protect the sheep.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要好好訓練，這隻狼崽就不會有事。從小和夥伴們一起長大的話，它不會傷害大家，反而會保護羊群。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Did you hear me? Where is your refutation? Come on, smart genius! Sit down! Hands up!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
聽見了嗎？怎麼不反駁？來啊，聰明的大天才！坐下！舉手！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's true. But... but I don't know how long it will last... I don't know if it will be able to suppress its wild nature...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你說得沒錯。可是......我不知道能堅持多久，也不知道它能不能壓住野性......

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But most of all, I don't think you'll be able to train it that patiently.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
而且，我不覺得你能那麼有耐心地訓練它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll help you with any nervousness so you can be fully trained. I'll take him for walks so we can bond.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會幫忙緩解你的顧慮，讓它接受充分訓練。我也會帶它散步，和它培養感情。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
可是......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You said it was hard to keep chasing after the cub when he went for walks alone. Isn't this a good thing?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你不是說它自己散步時很難追上嗎？這樣不是正好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Are you sure you can take care of our wolf cub? I'm worried about him being outside with all the dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你確定能照顧好我們的狼崽嗎？外面魔物那麼危險，我很擔心它。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
See those calluses on your hands, Adventurer? You said Maram brought him here, so he must be trustworthy. He's a veteran we trained in minutes!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
冒險者，看看你手上的繭！既然瑪拉姆把他帶來，肯定信得過。他可是我們幾分鐘就訓練出來的老兵！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, well... I can't help coming all the way here, so can I ask you a favor? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀......既然你都特地跑來了，能不能幫我一個忙？呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You're so excited, like you've been waiting for this moment. Aren't you taking it too cold?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你興奮得好像盼這一天很久了。是不是對這件事太冷淡了？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh no~ You're so~ desperately~ asking!! So, I can't help but...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀～你這麼～拼命地～請求我！！那我也只能......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Anyway... I need to talk to the villagers about the cub. Our little one is safe! Let's go, little cub!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
總之......我得去和村民們談談狼崽的事。小傢伙已經安全了！走吧！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh... suddenly became a temporary shepherd, huh...? Thank you. I had a lot to do. What can I do to help?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哦......突然就成了臨時牧羊人啊......？謝謝你，我還有好多事要忙。該怎麼幫你呢？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah, right! Outsiders often like these sorts of things. Do you like it, adventurer? Even if you don't, you can exchange it for something you like with someone who does. Take it with you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
啊，對了！外地人好像都喜歡這種東西。冒險者，你喜歡嗎？不喜歡的話，也能拿去和喜歡的人交換。收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好，那散步時見。
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好，那散步時見。
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Please wait the end of the quest delay.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
請等任務冷卻時間結束。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，辛苦了。我想小狗也很滿足。用餐時間愉快嗎？那明天再來吧！
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，辛苦了。我想小狗也很滿足。用餐時間愉快嗎？那明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
There are a few places the dog likes, and I will guide you. You only need to deal with dangerous monsters nearby.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
小狗喜歡幾個地方，我帶你去。你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's a pain in the ass because ashrings rush in. Please take care of the surrounding ashrings. I usually catch 20 eagles a day. Then please.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
灰燼靈不斷衝過來，真煩人。幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我平時一天能抓二十隻鷹。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, I came on time for our walk. But Aisha didn't show up...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，我準時來散步了，可艾莎沒來......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Ta-da! We're here!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
鏘鏘！我們到了！

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!!
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪！！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, I'll take you for a walk. Really... do I have to go too? Can I trust you to handle it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好吧，我帶你去散步。真是的......我也得去嗎？交給你一個人行不行？

scripts.text: Alright then.
scripts.translation: 好吧。

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天有點忙。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah... I see... You're busy. Well, then there's nothing to be done about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
啊......這樣啊......你有事要忙，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, come on, look at my disappointed face. There's nothing I can do. Today, come with me. Well then, goodbye, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，看看我這失望的表情！沒辦法，今天就跟我來吧。再見啦，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
If you're worried, you can come along.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
要是擔心的話，你也可以一起來。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
h, no. Alright then, I'll leave it to you. Take care, pup. If you're worried or don't like it, let me know and come home. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
啊，不......好吧，那就交給你了。小傢伙，要小心。要是不放心或不喜歡，就告訴我，回家來，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yahaaaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
哈啊啊啊——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. He can find and eat on his own, so just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。它會自己找東西吃，你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
灰燼靈總是成群湧來，真讓人頭疼......幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我們平時一天大約會抓二十隻，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. Just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。你只要處理附近危險的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
灰燼靈總是成群湧來，真讓人頭疼......幫忙處理附近的灰燼靈吧。我們平時一天大約會抓二十隻，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
We need to show Scania that our Boksil is safe and reliable!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
得讓斯堪尼亞知道，我們家福實很安全、很可靠！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you want to see wolf cub poop? How cute is it? Oh, but don't touch it.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
想看狼崽拉便便嗎？多可愛呀！不過別碰哦。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil~ Let's live together forever with me. If someone comes to harm you, I will personally bury them in the Oz Maze. So don't worry, Wolf Cub~ Just trust me and let's live happily.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實～以後永遠和我在一起吧。誰敢傷害你，我就親手把他埋在歐茲迷宮裡。所以別擔心，小狼崽～相信我，我們會幸福地生活下去。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
No, Boksil. Calm down a bit. Oh dear. What will happen if you still act unfamiliar? No, I'm not saying anything to you... Let's get closer, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
不，福實，冷靜一點。哎呀，你還是這麼認生可怎麼辦？不，我不是在說你......我們再親近一點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roaarrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
嗷嗚——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand, I understand. You need some time alone. Honestly, I feel the same way. In the end, we're all alone in this world. So let's live well on our own while still living together.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我知道，我知道。你想一個人待會兒。說實話，我也一樣。畢竟這世上終究只能靠自己。所以我們就各自過好生活，同時住在一起吧。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrrrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
嗷嗚——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Why? What did I do...... Huh? Who are you? I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
為什麼？我做錯什麼了......咦？你是誰？我好像沒見過你。

scripts.text: So this is the wolf cub?
scripts.translation: 所以這就是狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't get too close to my wolf cub. Put your hands down. Turn around and disappear.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
別靠近我的狼崽。把手放下，轉身離開。

scripts.text: I'm not a bad guy...
scripts.translation: 我不是壞人......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't call anyone a bad people. Anyone who tells me to abandon my wolf cub is a villain. And I show no mercy to villains.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不會隨便說誰是壞人。但凡叫我拋棄狼崽的人都是惡人，我絕不會對惡人手下留情。

scripts.text: How long have you been here?
scripts.translation: 你在這裡多久了？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I can't disclose that as it's personal information. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
這是個人隱私，我不能告訴你。你為什麼問？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, this wolf cub, I don't think he's trained yet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，這隻狼崽好像還沒受過訓練。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
... No, that's. She's about a month old now. There's no way she can train while she's still a baby.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
......不是那樣的。她才一個月大，還是幼崽，怎麼可能接受訓練呢？

scripts.text: Actually, I'm here to...
scripts.translation: 其實，我是來......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
What? I knew it! Get at least 10 paces away from my wolf cub right now. Don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
什麼？我就知道！馬上離我的狼崽至少十步遠，不準再靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not here to take her, I am here to check on here... If she separated from the pack, we have to put them back, and we have to be prepared for the mother wolf to come looking for them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來帶走她的，只是想看看情況......如果她和狼群走散了，就得把她送回去，還得提防狼媽媽找來。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She's not stray out of the pack, she was picked up next to next to its dying mother wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
她不是和狼群走散的，是在垂死的狼媽媽身邊被發現的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops. It's probably nervous about being separated from his mother and living in a strange place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀。她和媽媽分開，又到了陌生的地方，可能因此很不安。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Are you sure you're not here to take her away, then why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
既然你不是來帶走她的，那你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did come to persuade after confirming whether it was indeed a wolf cub...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我確實是先來確認她是不是狼崽，然後才打算勸你的......

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I knew it! Sent by Scania, right? Why are you meddling with other people's pets? Our wolf cub isn't dangerous, so go back. There's nothing more to see.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我就知道！是斯堪尼亞派你來的吧？為什麼要管別人的寵物？福實一點也不危險，回去吧，沒什麼好看的。

scripts.text: As long as you're careful, there's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation: 只要小心一點，就不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you really think so? Do you really think our wolf cub could be a potential threat? Look at how small and cute she is...
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你真這麼覺得？你真的認為我們的狼崽可能有危險嗎？看看她，多小多可愛......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might have thought so under normal circumstances, but... if she doesn't have a mother, at least there wouldn't be any reason for wolves to come here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
換作平時你或許會這麼想......不過，如果她沒有母親，狼群至少就沒有理由找來了。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand what you're saying! But stupid Scania doesn't know that! Even a complete stranger like you understands my heart so well!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我明白你的意思！可愚蠢的斯堪尼亞不懂！連你這個陌生人都這麼理解我的心情！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moreover, this motherless wolf cub wouldn't be able to survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，這隻失去母親的狼崽也沒法獨自活下去。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
That's right! That cold-hearted one has turned ice-cold right down to the head.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
沒錯！那個冷血的傢伙簡直從頭到腳都凍成冰了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, for Boksil to live in the village, she needs training. She must learn how to interact with others without causing harm and how to get along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，想讓福實留在村裡，就得訓練她。要教她如何與大家相處、避免傷人。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She is still so young...?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
她還這麼小......？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It should be done when she's young. If we start training it from a young age, there won't be any of the concerns the villagers have.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就該趁她還小的時候開始訓練。這樣村民們擔心的問題就不會發生了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firm tone, immediate response, and sufficient praise will be enough for it to understand well. Wolves are smart, you know. What does wolf cub like the most?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要語氣堅定、及時回應，再多給些鼓勵，她就能聽懂。狼很聰明的。狼崽最喜歡什麼？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Hm... Meat? But there isn't any right now. Do adventurers have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
嗯......肉？可是現在沒有。冒險者，你有帶嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh...! There's no meat to give as a snack, meat... I need to bring some meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊......得拿肉當零食喂她才行。我得去準備些肉。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How are you supposed to train with meat? You only need one?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
用肉怎麼訓練？只要一塊就夠了嗎？

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Oh, don't touch our Boksil! She doesn't like it!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
啊，別碰福實！她不喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Didn't you say you needed a chunk of meat? is not it?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你不是說要一塊肉嗎？對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~ I am {1}. Your name is Boksil, right? Nice to meet you. Are you feeling anxious in this unfamiliar place? I know exactly how you feel, I know everything about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好～我是{1}。你叫福實，對吧？很高興認識你。在陌生的地方是不是有點不安？我懂你的感受，我什麼都知道。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrr---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
嗷嗚——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But it's okay. Everything's fine. There's no one here who would harm our Boksil. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒事，一切都好。這裡沒人會傷害福實，放心吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now we're all living together. With a warm shelter and delicious food to eat.
Then we need to establish some rules. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在大家住在一起，有溫暖的窩，也有好吃的東西。接下來我們得定些規矩，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof?
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I feel like I'm talking to a child.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
感覺像是在跟小孩子說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, look. Meat. Does Boksil like meat? Grilled, raw, or boiled? You've never tried grilled? That's okay, you'll have plenty of opportunities to try it in the future.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，是肉。福實喜歡吃肉嗎？烤的、生的還是煮的？沒吃過烤肉？沒關係，以後有的是機會嘗。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's do it right.
Boksil, sit down!
Wait!
Well done. Here is your meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們來好好訓練吧。福實，坐下！等一下！做得好，給你肉吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see? If she follows instructions like this, please give her a lot of praise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看到了嗎？她這樣聽從指令時，要好好表揚她。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Mom, Mom. Isn't our child a real genius?
Our Boksil did a great job!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
媽媽，媽媽！我們的孩子是不是天才？福實做得太棒了！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We need to keep doing this until she gets used to it. Repetitive training is important. Just keep doing it like you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要一直練到她習慣為止。重複訓練很重要，像剛才那樣繼續就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boksil, sit.
Hand.
Wait. Now, try it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
福實，坐下。握手。等一下......現在你自己試試。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil, sit!
Hand!
Wow, that's really amazing.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實，坐下！握手！哇，真厲害。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Training these kinds of domestic animals varies. Making them feel secure in this place and building a good bond with them will help them settle in well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
訓練這類家畜各有方法。讓她在這裡感到安心，並和她建立良好的關係，會幫助她適應環境。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And if they also interact with other friends and spend time together from a young age, they should get along well without any major issues.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果她從小就和其他夥伴相處、一起生活，應該也能融洽相處，不會出什麼大問題。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do people recognize that?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
大家會相信嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You just need to show them what you've done. It shows that Boksil is ready to live as a member of this village.
Let's go back to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and show off our wonderful and majestic Boksil.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
把訓練成果展示給大家看就行。這能證明福實已經準備好成為村裡的一員。我們回<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，讓大家看看可愛又威風的福實吧。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil is cute. But we're going to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right? Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實很可愛。不過我們要去<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧？別忘了。

scripts.translation:

- 太多了。 -
