scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Why are you eavesdropping on other people's conversations?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
你為什麼偷聽別人說話？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Uh, once again at the village meeting, all they did was talk nonsense, that old man.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
唉，今天村民會議上那個老頭又在胡說八道。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
That old man? Ah, the one whose name cannot be mentioned?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
那個老頭？啊，就是不能提名字的那位？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I mean, I can't mention it.
I heard he was someone important in Rahel, said to have some influence in the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
我不是說不能提名字嘛。我聽說他以前是拉赫的重要人物，在灰狼森林也頗有影響力。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
That old man, whether it's Ahap or Ahab!
He doesn't act like that when he's in Rachel~ He must have messed up~
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那個老頭，到底叫阿哈普還是阿哈布！他在拉赫時可不是這副樣子～一定是搞砸了～

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If that's the case, why bother coming here instead of staying in Rachel?
I really don't understand!
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
既然這樣，幹嘛不待在拉赫，非要跑來這裡？真搞不懂！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Does she still not realize she's in Rachel?
Even sleeping in a drafty tent, hasn't she woken up from her dream yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
她還沒發現自己在拉赫嗎？睡在漏風的帳篷裡，居然還沒從夢裡醒來？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If you want to dream, do it alone.
Why bother others with your troubles?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
想做夢就自己做，幹嘛拿自己的煩惱去麻煩別人？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Who do you think you are, eavesdropping on our conversation?
Are you the Ahab old man's spy?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
你以為自己是誰，竟敢偷聽我們說話？是阿哈布老頭派來的眼線嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
You're not even smart enough to cultivate weeds like Ahab.
So, who are you? Eavesdropping on others' gossip. Shameful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你連阿哈布那樣種雜草的本事都沒有。你到底是誰？偷聽別人閒聊，真不知羞恥。

scripts.text: Just a passing traveler.
scripts.translation: 我只是路過的旅人。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Liar. Where's a passing traveler in this Gray Wolf Forest?
They must be related to us somehow.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
騙子。灰狼森林哪會有路過的旅人？你肯定和我們有關係。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If you won't speak, we'll have to use force to make you.
Are you really just going to keep lying?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
你要是不肯說，我們就只好動手逼你說了。你還要繼續撒謊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Calm down, Redcell. Even if Zlan is not a passing traveler, there could still be someone here we don't know about but wouldn't be out of place.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
冷靜點，紅血球。就算茲蘭不是路過的旅人，這裡也可能有我們不認識、但確實屬於這裡的人。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Who would that be?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那會是誰？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Now that Ahab is starting to listen to people... He doesn't seem like such a bad person after all.
Yeah, that's just how adults communicate.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
現在阿哈布開始聽別人說話了......看來他也沒那麼壞嘛。嗯，大人就是該這麼溝通。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
It's a relief that they don't end up causing too much trouble by just blocking each other's ears and shouting
Thanks to you. I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
幸好他們沒有互相堵住耳朵大喊大叫，鬧出更大的亂子。謝謝你，真是幫大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
You're back? What did Ahab say?
What? He said he'll start listening to others now?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
你回來了？阿哈布怎麼說？什麼？他說以後會開始聽別人說話？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I guess he hasn't been listening until now.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
看來他以前根本沒在聽。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
Hmph... Don't tease, Zlan.
What matters now is that he's decided to do it properly.
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
哼......別取笑我，茲蘭。現在重要的是他決定認真去做了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Ya, ya.
Why did Dah... I mean, Ahab change his mind?
You must have convinced him, being a high-ranking or well-connected person.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
是啊，是啊。達......我是說阿哈布，為什麼改變主意了？你一定是位高權重或人脈廣，才能說服他吧。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Thanks to you, we don't have to kick people out of here anymore.
Even though he said he'd do it, it was still uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
多虧了你，我們不用再把人趕出村子了。雖說他說會處理，但我們還是一直很不安。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
I may not be a representative at the village meetings... but we'll show some courtesy.
We're lucky to have someone like you.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
我雖然不是村民會議的代表......但還是會表達謝意。能有你這樣的人真是我們的幸運。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
I may not be a representative at the village meetings... but we'll show some courtesy.
We're lucky to have someone like you.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
我雖然不是村民會議的代表......但還是會表達謝意。能有你這樣的人真是我們的幸運。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Now that Ahab is starting to listen to people... He doesn't seem like such a bad person after all.
Yeah, that's just how adults communicate.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
現在阿哈布開始聽別人說話了......看來他也沒那麼壞嘛。嗯，大人就是該這麼溝通。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
It's a relief that they don't end up causing too much trouble by just blocking each other's ears and shouting
Thanks to you. I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
幸好他們沒有互相堵著耳朵大喊大叫，鬧出更大的亂子。多虧了你，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I hope you'll leave if you don't intend to follow the rules of this forest.
You're no different. Rules are meant to be followed.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
如果你不打算遵守森林的規矩，就請離開。你也沒什麼不同，規矩就是要遵守的。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
The same goes for manners. A society without manners and rules? Barbaric.
I don't want to be in a state of wilderness!
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
禮貌也是如此。沒有禮貌和規矩的社會只會變得野蠻。我可不想生活在蠻荒之地！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Ah, it's troubling. There's a bothersome issue.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
唉，真讓人頭疼。有件麻煩事。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It's a problem with relationships, so I don't want to talk to someone I don't know...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這是人際關係方面的問題，我不想跟陌生人說......

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Would it make sense to speak if it's an important guest?
Since we can't even know about the affairs of the leaders here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
要是重要人物來聽我們說，又有什麼用呢？我們連這裡的領導們在做什麼都不知道。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Is that true?
...Well, if it's a secret to us, then maybe they won't tell us.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
是嗎？......既然他們對我們保密，大概也不會告訴我們吧。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If they're really important, then listen to us.
If not? They're probably still someone important. Listen.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
要是真重要，就該聽聽我們的意見。不重要的話？那他們大概還是重要人物，也得聽。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
That elder... no, that's just a nickname we use among ourselves.
How can we help that Mr. Ahap?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
那個長老......不，那只是我們私下起的綽號。我們能為阿哈普先生做些什麼？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
He's a really bothersome old man, that guy!
He always interrupts village meetings and talks nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那老頭真煩人！總在村民會議上插嘴，說些不著邊際的話。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
He doesn't listen to others and just keeps rambling on, and it's not even useful.
He insists he's an elder, so we should listen to him, but it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
他從不聽別人說，只顧自己嘮叨，而且一點用都沒有。還仗著自己是長老，要求大家聽他的，真讓人惱火。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I heard he used to boss around the immigrants and live off them.
Thinking he can tell the natives what to do based on his past is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
聽說他過去總指使移民，還靠他們過活。憑著過去的身份就想指揮原住民，真可笑。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
I just want to chase him away if I can.
Maybe if we gather our opinions and assert ourselves strongly.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我真想把他趕走。要不我們先統一意見，再強硬地表明立場？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Hey, even if that's true, it's not right.
This is where people with nowhere else to go gather.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
喂，就算他說的是真的，這樣做也不對。這裡收留的都是無處可去的人。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If we drive him away, he'll have nowhere to go.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
要是把他趕走，他就無家可歸了。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
But do we have to put up with that charade forever?
I have nowhere else to go either, so can I just start acting however I want?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
可我們要永遠忍受這種鬧劇嗎？我也無處可去，難道就能想幹什麼就幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
If you do that, then we'll both be charades. I can't stand it...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你要是那樣做，我們也就成鬧劇的一部分了。我可受不了......

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Hey, you there, high and mighty! You seem really interested in our affairs, still listening?
Even if you're not high and mighty, it doesn't matter. Someone with a broad reach!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
喂，那位高高在上的人！你似乎很關心我們的事，還在聽嗎？就算你不是什麼大人物，只要見識廣、門路多也行！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
People rarely change... was I witnessing one of those rare changes?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
人很少會改變......我剛才是不是親眼見證了這種罕見的改變？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It might still need more time, but Mr. Ahap, until now, seems like he could be a good neighbor.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
也許還需要更多時間，不過阿哈普先生現在看起來已經能當個好鄰居了。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
In our village, only important people don't participate in village management meetings.
Of course, the decisions themselves are made by the important people, but still...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們村裡只有重要人物不參加村民管理會議。當然，最後還是由他們做決定，不過......

scripts.text:
[Karr]
So, there's no one who interferes with the meetings just because they attend.
Except for that Mr. Ahap.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以大家不會只因為某人參加會議，就干涉會議。只有阿哈普先生例外。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
I don't like that attitude, not at all...
The longer it goes on, the worse the impact will be.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我一點也不喜歡那種態度......拖得越久，影響就越糟。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Mr. Ahab, you seem to be becoming more bearable to be around.
There's still a lot to watch out for, but compared to before, you're much better now.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
阿哈布先生，你現在似乎沒那麼難相處了。還有很多地方得留意，不過你比以前好多了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Watching someone change is a sacred moment.
I should also try harder to behave like a human.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
看著一個人改變，真是神聖的時刻。我也該努力表現得像個正常人。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Make that old Mr. Ahab into a person.
Shouldn't a person look like a person and act like a person...?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
把那個老阿哈布改造成一個正常人吧。一個人不就該有人的樣子、做人的事嗎......？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Is it too much criticism? ...Well, I'll admit it's a bit much.
But after working together, you'll see for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
我是不是批評得太過了？......好吧，確實有點。不過一起做事之後，你就會明白。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Have you heard everything up to now?
You're the only one who can help us solve this suffering.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
你都聽到了吧？只有你能幫我們擺脫這種苦惱。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Since there's really no solution, if it doesn't work out, I'll suggest expulsion from the village by gathering opinions.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
看來確實沒別的辦法。要是不行，我就提議收集大家的意見，把他趕出村子。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Geez, let's put that off for later...
But in the end, that'll probably be the last solution.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
哎呀，先把這個放一放吧......不過說到底，那大概會是最後的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It's not just us who are bothered, so if we propose it, it'll be accepted.
Everyone attending the village meeting is in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
不只是我們覺得困擾，所以只要提出來，大家都會同意。參加村民會議的人都受夠了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
But! Let's leave that for later.
Help me a bit before the end comes. Bro.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
不過，先別急著這麼做。在最後一步之前，先幫幫我吧，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
We can't communicate with that old man.
Why don't you go and talk to him?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們沒法和那老頭溝通。你去跟他談談怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Wow, that sounds great. Go and talk to him, find out why he's like that, if it's possible for him not to be like that.
It's a real lifetime request.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
好主意！去問問他為什麼會這樣，看看能不能讓他改一改。這可是我畢生的願望。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Do it as a lifetime request. I'm saving it for when I get a lover.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那就把它當成畢生願望吧，留著等我有戀人時再用。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Yeah, that's fine. I won't be dating anyone.
So that's my lifelong wish. Make that old grump into a person.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
好啊，反正我也不會和誰交往。這就是我的畢生願望：把那個老頑固變成正常人。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It seems like your wish is getting bigger.
Anyway, please do it. Go and talk to Mr. Ahap.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你的願望好像越來越大了。總之，拜託你去和阿哈普先生談談。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Someone who can't understand a word! Someone stupid! Someone who makes you say things again! Someone who shows emotions in their work!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
一個聽不懂人話的傢伙！一個笨蛋！一個讓人反覆解釋的傢伙！一個工作時還把情緒帶進去的傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Someone who hides their mistakes and then can't undo them! Someone who can't take responsibility for their own actions!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
還會隱瞞錯誤，最後又無法挽回！根本不肯為自己的行為負責！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
It's just disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
真是噁心！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Why do so many people hate you like this?
No, I hate just one person... Just one person!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
為什麼那麼多人討厭你？不，我只討厭一個人......就一個！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, someone new. Are you a resident here?
Heh heh, it's natural for those in power to have trouble remembering everyone. You'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
哦，新面孔啊。你是這裡的居民嗎？嘿嘿，有地位的人記不住所有人也很正常，你以後會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Who am I? Why, I'm none other than Ahab, of course.
I'm the one who goes all the way to the council that decides everything in the village, that's me.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我是誰？我當然就是阿哈布。我可是能一路走進決定村裡一切事務的議事會的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I, I'm also trying my best.
So please don't chase me away.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我、我也在盡力。請別把我趕走。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
If I get chased away from here, I have nowhere else to go.
So I've been trying to do my best in my own way. But if everyone dislikes me.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
要是被趕出這裡，我就無處可去了。所以我一直用自己的方式努力。可是如果大家都討厭我......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Tsk tsk, alright, let's hear about manners, Ahab.
If you keep babbling nonsense, I won't forgive you!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
嘖嘖，好吧，來談談禮貌吧，阿哈布。你要是再胡說八道，我可不會放過你！

scripts.text: Do you know that people dislike you, Ahab?
scripts.translation: 你知道大家都討厭你嗎，阿哈布？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ah... I know! So what!
Is it my fault? They mock the elders for being old!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
啊......我知道！那又怎樣！是我的錯嗎？他們不過是嘲笑長老年紀大！

scripts.text: That's not the issue.
scripts.translation: 這不是重點。

scripts.text: It's your problem, Ahab.
scripts.translation: 問題出在你身上，阿哈布。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
What do you mean I have a problem!
I don't have any problems!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我有什麼問題！我才沒問題！

scripts.text: You're considering sending me away from here.
scripts.translation: 大家正在考慮把你趕走。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
What, what did you say? That's not possible!
I have nowhere else to go but here.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
什、什麼？你說什麼？不可能！我除了這裡無處可去。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
In Rachel... everything was going well...
Among the locals, it was a pride that no one was as successful as me.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
在拉赫......一切都很順利......當地人都以我最有出息為榮。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
But due to a misunderstanding with the immigrant boss...
I lost all my wealth and had nowhere else to go, so I came here.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
可我和移民老闆產生誤會......失去了全部財產，也無處可去，只好來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hey. How can I avoid being sent away from here?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
喂，我怎樣才能不被趕走？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I know it. That I have no power here.
Huh? I have no power or money now. What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我知道自己在這裡沒有權勢。咦？我現在既沒權也沒錢，怎麼辦才好？

scripts.text: You don't need power and money.
scripts.translation: 權勢和金錢都不是必要的。

scripts.text: Treat people with respect.
scripts.translation: 待人有禮。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hmm, I'm doing my best.
I give advice to young people and attend village meetings to voice my opinions.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
嗯，我一直在努力。我給年輕人提建議，也參加村民會議發表意見。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Is my effort wrong?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
難道我的努力不對嗎？

scripts.text: Don't think of yourself as superior.
scripts.translation: 別覺得自己高人一等。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
But I'm an adult! Is it wrong for an adult to expect to be treated as an adult?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
可我已經是成年人了！成年人想得到成年人的尊重，有錯嗎？

scripts.text: Then, perhaps you should leave....
scripts.translation: 那你或許該離開這裡......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hmm, hmm... What should I do!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
嗯，嗯......我該怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Don't shout first.
scripts.translation: 別一上來就大喊大叫。

scripts.text: Unsolicited advice about the situation is just nagging.
scripts.translation: 別人沒問就對他們的處境指手畫腳，只會讓人覺得你在嘮叨。

scripts.text: Listen to what others have to say.
scripts.translation: 聽聽別人怎麼說。

scripts.text: Try to learn about this place.
scripts.translation: 試著瞭解這裡的情況。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ah... I see. Since I've listened to your advice.
I didn't even raise my voice, did I?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
啊......我明白了。我聽了你的建議，也沒有提高嗓門，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I'll try to listen to your advice.
So... please don't chase me away from here.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我會試著聽你的建議。所以......請別把我趕走。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I just wanted to get along well with the young people...
Was that so upsetting? It's a bit bitter....
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我只是想和年輕人好好相處......這有那麼讓人難受嗎？真有點苦澀......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Anyway, thanks for coming to talk instead of immediately chasing me away.
Tell <NAVI>[Other People]<INFO>wolfvill,85,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that I'll try to do better now....
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
總之，謝謝你願意來跟我談，而不是立刻把我趕走。請告訴<NAVI>[其他人]<INFO>wolfvill,85,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，我以後會努力做得更好......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, did you buy the cucumber sauce? Let me see. 
You bought the right one.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
哦，你買了黃瓜醬嗎？讓我看看。嗯，買對了。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
So, where should we try to eat?
I haven't had a proper meal in that watered-down place for a while, I'm quite hungry.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
那我們去哪兒吃呢？我好久沒在那家清淡的店裡好好吃飯了，現在餓得很。

scripts.text: But first, let's talk...
scripts.translation: 不過我們先談談......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, you impudent young one!
When an elder is about to eat, one must wait politely until the end!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
哦，你這無禮的小子！長老要用餐時，你就該有禮貌地等到他吃完！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
In Rachel, if there were someone like you, they would've scolded us for not learning anything!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
在拉赫，要是有你這樣的人，肯定會罵我們什麼都沒學會！

scripts.text: This is about manners, Ahab.
scripts.translation: 這是在說禮貌，阿哈布。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ahab? Ahab? No, are you boasting because you ran an errand now!
If you run an errand twice, then, oh, you'll become best buddies with them and have dinner!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
阿哈布？阿哈布？怎麼，跑了一趟腿就開始炫耀了？要是再跑一次腿，你們就能成好朋友，還能一起吃晚飯了！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Alright, let's hear your precious words then!
......While we eat!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
好吧，那就聽聽你寶貴的意見吧！......邊吃邊聽！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Why aren't you going already? Can't you understand my words?
Sigh, the young ones here just can't learn any manners.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
你怎麼還不走？聽不懂我說的話嗎？唉，這些年輕人就是不懂禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hurry up and go to <NAVI>[Munomart]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and buy cucumber sauce!
What, do I have to give you money? Hurry up and go!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
快去<NAVI>[穆諾瑪特]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>買黃瓜醬！怎麼，還要我給你錢嗎？快去！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, someone new. Are you a resident here?
Heh heh, it's natural for those in power to have trouble remembering everyone. You'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
哦，新面孔啊。你是這裡的居民嗎？嘿嘿，身居高位的人記不住所有人也很正常，你以後會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Right, while you're here, could you do me a favor?
It's not difficult. It's a simple task that even a fool could do.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
對了，既然你在這兒，能幫我個忙嗎？不難，連傻瓜都能辦到。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
It's just that someone like me has different values of time available to them.
Of course, I'm expensive. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
像我這樣的人，時間可是很寶貴的。當然，我的出場費也不低。哈哈！

scripts.text: I'll run the errand for you.
scripts.translation: 我幫你跑腿。

scripts.text: I'm not here for that kind of thing.
scripts.translation: 我不是來做這種事的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, how noble of you.
Yes, a young person should have a bit of nobility.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
哦，真高尚啊。年輕人就該有點高尚情操。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
You see, there's a delicious sauce that I must have with my meals.
Without it, it feels like I haven't eaten anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我吃飯時一定要配一種美味的醬。沒有它，就像什麼都沒吃一樣......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
So, go to Rachel and buy some sauce.
If you ask for cucumber sauce at Munomart, they'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
去拉赫買些醬吧。在穆諾瑪特問黃瓜醬，他們就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hurry, or it'll go bad. Just get one bottle from <NAVI>[Munomart]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
Freshness is key to good taste.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
快點，醬會變質的。去<NAVI>[穆諾瑪特]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>買一瓶就好。味道好不好，關鍵在新鮮。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
At the meeting, I try to be humble.
Then the young men's eyes became softer...
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
我在會議上儘量表現得謙遜些，年輕人的眼神也柔和了......

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I think it might be a little to say that it's not a change, but an attitude, and the world is changing. There is no one who doesn't change.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈布]
與其說這是改變，不如說是態度變了，世界也在變化。沒有人一成不變。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Welcome, this is Munomart grocery store.
What ingredients are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
歡迎光臨穆諾瑪特雜貨店。您想找什麼食材？

scripts.text: Obirerger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧比勒格醬

scripts.text: Obiger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧比格醬

scripts.text: Oiger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧伊格醬

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Hmm? We don't have that sauce.
I've never even heard of a sauce with that name before.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
嗯？我們沒有那種醬。我從沒聽說過這個名字的醬。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Ah, Oiger Sauce! Let me see... Here it is.
This sauce contains cucumber and yogurt, so it's very refreshing. It tastes great when spread on bread.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
啊，奧伊格醬！我看看......找到了。這種醬加了黃瓜和酸奶，清爽可口，抹在麵包上特別好吃。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
How many would you like? One? Here you go.
Store it in a cool place and consume it quickly after opening the seal.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您要幾瓶？一瓶嗎？給您。請放在陰涼處，開封后儘快食用。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Welcome, this is Munomart grocery store.
It's Rachel's best grocery store, yes.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
歡迎光臨穆諾瑪特雜貨店。沒錯，這可是拉赫最好的雜貨店。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Most restaurants use our ingredients.
Just take them home, heat them up, cook them, and voila! You'll have a great meal in no time!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
大多數餐廳都用我們店的食材。帶回家加熱或烹飪一下，美味的一餐馬上就有了！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I assume you must be a new villager around here. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
你應該是附近新來的村民吧？你是誰？

scripts.text: Scholar, what are you doing?
scripts.translation: 學者，你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Oh, oh oh.
...Do I seem like a scholar to you?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
哦，哦哦......在你看來，我像個學者嗎？

scripts.text: You're not a scholar?
scripts.translation: 你不是學者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
No! I used to be a scholar. Long time ago.
I'm pleased that someone from outside immediately recognizes me as a Scholar.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
不，我以前是學者，那是很久以前的事了。真高興有外鄉人一眼就認出我曾是學者。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Hmm, hmm. What are you asking about what I'm doing.
I'm organizing the collected stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
嗯，你問我在做什麼啊？我在整理收集來的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
It's about gathering the myths and folk tales handed down to us.
It's also about preserving the precious cultural heritage of indigenous people.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我在收集流傳下來的神話和民間故事，也想儲存原住民珍貴的文化遺產。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
To ensure that these stories are not lost and can be passed down to future generations, we'll publish them as books.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
為了不讓這些故事失傳、能傳給後代，我們打算把它們編成書出版。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
It seems like you're interested.
...Are you interested in this work?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
看起來你很感興趣......想參與這項工作嗎？

scripts.text: Interested.
scripts.translation: 感興趣

scripts.text: Not interested.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
So, your interest means you're willing to help?
Extra hands are always welcome. I would be glad if you could assist.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
你感興趣，也願意幫忙嗎？多個人手總是好的。願意協助的話，我會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Do you know how to write? Excellent.
Please gather stories from the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
你會寫字嗎？太好了。請去收集村民們的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I've promised to listen to the stories of one child, one young person, and one grandmother from the village.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我答應過要聽村裡一個孩子、一位年輕人和一位老奶奶講故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
They say it's a long story, so we may not finish in one day. We'll need your patience.
Here, I'll give you a notebook for gathering stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
聽說故事很長，一天可能聽不完，得請你耐心幫忙。這本筆記本給你，用來記錄故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
The child's name is Dinar. The young person is a woman named Amira.
After that, you can go to Grandma Shania and write down her story.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
孩子叫迪納爾，年輕女子叫阿米拉。之後再去找莎妮娜奶奶，記錄她的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We've made a promise to listen to stories from one child, one young person, and one grandmother in the village.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我們答應過要聽村裡一個孩子、一位年輕人和一位老奶奶講故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Since it's a long story and can't be heard all in one day, we'll need your patience to help us through it.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
故事很長，一天聽不完，還得請你耐心協助。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
The child's name is Dinar. The young woman is called Amira.
Next, go to Grandma Shanina's place, listen to her story, and write it down.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
孩子叫迪納爾，年輕女子叫阿米拉。接下來去找莎妮娜奶奶，聽她講故事並記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, did you come to tell stories to Granny Shannina?
I'm excited to hear what stories they are. Please show me the notebook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，你們是來給莎妮娜奶奶講故事的嗎？我很期待聽聽是什麼故事。把筆記本給我看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Is this the story Amira told you?
It's really diverse and wonderful! I also remember hearing stories about these gods when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這是阿米拉講給你聽的故事嗎？內容真豐富，也很精彩！我小時候也聽過這些神明的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
But the names of the animal gods in this story are similar to the ones I heard when I was young, but a little different.
Hmm, I'll need to do some research.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
不過，這個故事裡的動物神明名字和我小時候聽到的很相似，又有些不同。嗯，我得研究一下。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
These are great stories that fuel my research interests!
Please continue to record Amira's stories for me in the future.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這些故事真能激發我的研究興趣！以後也請繼續幫我記錄阿米拉講的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and record the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
麻煩你明天再來，記錄故事的下一段。謝謝，這是今天的報酬。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and record the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
麻煩你明天再來，記錄故事的下一段。謝謝，這是今天的報酬。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
As much as I'd like to hear all the stories today...
Both of you, the adventurer and the people would tire out.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我也很想今天就聽完所有故事......但你們和村民都會累的。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Take a good rest for the remaining day, and please come back after dawn.
During that time, I'll organize and analyze the stories you've gathered.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
今天剩下的時間好好休息，天亮後再來吧。這段時間我會整理、分析你們收集來的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We appreciated your last visit.
Today, we would also like to record our conversation.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
感謝你們上次來訪。今天也請繼續幫忙記錄我們的談話。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, please go to Grandma Shanina and listen to her story, then write it down.
Here are some blank notebooks for you.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，請去找莎妮娜奶奶聽她講故事，再記錄下來。這些空白筆記本給你們。

scripts.text: I'll go.
scripts.translation: 我去吧。

scripts.text: It's difficult right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在不方便。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Ah, is it difficult right now? It's okay, we can do it later.
Just remember, this work requires patience and persistence.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
現在不方便嗎？沒關係，之後再做也行。記住，這項工作需要耐心和毅力。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We're already colleagues on the same path, aren't we?
If it's tough, you can take a break. As long as we keep moving forward steadily.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我們已經是志同道合的夥伴了，對吧？累了就休息，只要穩步前進就好。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Thank you for always being willing to help.
I will repay this kindness by making a good storybook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
謝謝你一直願意幫忙。我會把這些故事編成一本好書，報答你的好意。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Oh, of course, I'll make sure you're paid for your work today too.
That's important too, isn't it? I understand.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
當然，今天的工作也會付給你報酬。這也很重要，對吧？我明白的。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, did you bring stories from Shannina Grandma?
I'm excited to hear what kind of stories they are. Please show me the notebook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，你們帶回莎妮娜奶奶的故事了嗎？我很期待聽聽，把筆記本給我看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Amira's stories include many myths familiar to me as well.
They are stories that all indigenous people here have heard and grown up with.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
阿米拉講的故事裡有很多我熟悉的神話，是這裡的原住民從小聽到大的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Of course, there are some differences from the myths I know...
But researching those differences and commonalities is precisely my job, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
當然，和我所知的神話還是有些不同......不過研究這些差異與共通之處，正是我的工作，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
These are stories that fuel my research curiosity!
I hope you continue to transcribe Amira's stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這些故事真能激發我的研究熱情！希望你們繼續記錄阿米拉講的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and transcribe the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
麻煩你明天再來，記錄故事的下一段。謝謝，這是今天的報酬。
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and transcribe the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
麻煩你明天再來，記錄故事的下一段。謝謝，這是今天的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, please go to Grandma Shani's house and listen to her story and write it down.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，請去莎妮娜奶奶家聽她講故事，並記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
You've come to listen to my story, right?
Oh, that's right. I promised Granny Gudra!
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
你是來聽我講故事的吧？啊，對了，我答應過古德拉奶奶！

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Hmm, hmm. I'll tell you once, so write it down carefully.
This is something I really experienced.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
嗯嗯，我只講一遍，你要仔細記好。這可是我親身經歷的事。

scripts.text: Not just a rumor?
scripts.translation: 這不只是傳聞？

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
What's a rumor? Anyway, please pay attention!
Long ago, when I was still young.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
傳聞是什麼？總之仔細聽！那是很久以前，我還小的時候......

scripts.text: You're still young now...
scripts.translation: 你現在也還小啊......

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Oh, you keep interrupting!
Among the gray wolves in the Gray Wolf Forest, there was one that seemed like the leader...
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
哎呀，你老是打斷我！灰狼森林的灰狼群裡，有一隻像是首領的......

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
You've come to listen to my story again today!
Aunt Gudra said she'll turn it into a book later.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
你今天又來聽我的故事啦！古德拉阿姨說以後會把故事寫成書。

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Hmm..., where did we leave off last time?
Did we stop in the middle of the scene where the dragon and the fairy have their final showdown?
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
嗯......上次講到哪兒了？是巨龍和妖精最後決戰到一半的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
As the dragon summoned the giant tower of metal for the last time, the fairy confronted it by summoning the giant spirit of fire...
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
巨龍最後一次召喚出巨大的金屬塔，妖精則召喚出巨大的火焰精靈與之對抗......

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
I really enjoy reading interesting stories.
Reading and imagining the next story is even better!
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
我真喜歡讀有趣的故事。讀著讀著，想像接下來會發生什麼更有意思！

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
The characters, they come alive in my mind.
I just need to watch them like watching a play.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
那些角色會在我腦海裡活過來，我只要像看戲一樣看著他們就好。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Are you the one who came after being asked by Sister Gudra?
She made a strange request. She wants to hear an old... story that I know.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
你是受古德拉姐姐所託來的嗎？她提了個奇怪的請求，想聽我講一個......古老的故事。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Anyway, I promised to tell the story I heard from our grandfather before we came to the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
總之，我答應講一個故事。那是我們來灰狼森林之前，從祖父那裡聽來的。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Are you ready to listen? Alright, I'll tell you slowly.
There are far more gods in the world than we know...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
準備好聽了嗎？那我慢慢講。這個世界上的神明，遠比我們知道的多得多......

scripts.text:
[Amira]
You've come for Sister Gudra's errand again today.
What does she want to use these stories for?
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
你今天又來幫古德拉姐姐跑腿了。她想拿這些故事做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Anyway, I'll tell you the next story.
This is also a story our grandfather told us, some gods are still...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
總之，我來講下一個故事。這也是祖父告訴我們的故事。有些神明至今仍然......

scripts.text:
[Amira]
...So, um, what was the name? I don't remember well, but anyway, the important thing is...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
......那個名字叫什麼來著？我記不太清了，不過重點是......

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Our grandfather said so. It's important not to forget our gods.
That's why he's telling me all these stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
祖父說，不能忘記我們的神明很重要。所以他才給我講這些故事。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
I've heard so many stories, but now there are some that I've forgotten...
If Sister Gudra turns them into a book, I won't forget them anymore.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
我聽過很多故事，可有些現在已經忘了......要是古德拉姐姐把它們寫成書，我就再也不會忘記了。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Ah, Grodra's errand? You came to hear an old tale, didn't you?
I'll tell you a story. It's a very old story, not everyone's cup of tea, perhaps, but it's one my grandmother used to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
啊，是古德拉托你來的吧？你是來聽古老傳說的，對嗎？我給你講個故事吧。這故事非常古老，也許不是人人都喜歡聽，但以前我祖母常講給我聽。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Worried it won't be entertaining? Don't worry. It'll be a pleasant distraction.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
擔心故事不好聽？別擔心，可以當作一段輕鬆的消遣。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
So, long long ago. In a time long past, there lived a blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
那是很久很久以前，在遙遠的過去，住著一位鐵匠......

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Here you are again for Gudra's errand. Quite diligent, aren't you.
You said the stories I tell are alright, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
你又來幫古德拉跑腿了，真勤快。你說過我講的故事還不錯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
I'm glad if it helps Gudra.
How far did we get in the story? Is it time for a new tale today?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
能幫上古德拉的忙，我很高興。故事講到哪兒了？今天要開始講新故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Oh, the last story wasn't finished yet, was it? My memory's a bit foggy.
Did I mention the blacksmith riding an owl down from the sky?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
哦，上次的故事還沒講完吧？我記性不太好了......我說到鐵匠騎著貓頭鷹從天而降了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Right, my memory serves me well.
Then please tell the next part. The pitiful nymph...
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
對，我記得沒錯。那就接著講下一段吧。可憐的水妖......

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
There's not much excitement in my life now, but telling old tales to young children is enjoyable.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
我現在的生活沒什麼新鮮事，不過給孩子們講古老的傳說倒挺有意思。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
I'm very grateful to have someone to listen. Blessings upon them.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
很感謝有人願意聽我講故事。願神明保佑他們。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Outsiders are coming in and out from here.
If you're just snooping around out of curiosity, I can't let you in.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
最近有不少外人進進出出。如果你只是好奇來探聽訊息，我不能放你進去。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go in front of the temple, there will probably be devotees out there for good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
I beg you.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿前面的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句好話，再買下來。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
We've heard that you've been poking your nose into our business....
I also heard that they will teach you how to do it easily.
Can you help me too?
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
聽說你最近一直在幫我們......我也聽說他們會教你怎麼輕鬆辦成這事。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Budan]
As you can see, we can't easily get to Rachel.
So this is something I really want you to help me with, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
如你所見，我們很難去拉赫。所以這件事我真的想請你幫忙，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
I want you to get me some things that can only be made in Rachel's Temple of Sessrumnir.
As you can see, there is no easy access to clean water in the area due to volcanic ash and sand in the area around Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我想請你幫忙買些只有拉赫的塞斯魯姆尼爾神殿才有的東西。拉赫附近有火山灰和沙塵，像這裡一樣很難取得乾淨的水。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
So I developed a water purification artefact...
This thing really absorbs the dirt in the water through some unknown magical process.
Even all kinds of miscellaneous magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
所以我做了一種淨水聖物......它能用某種未知的魔法淨化水裡的汙物，甚至吸收各種雜亂的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Even the sulfur spring water, which contains the mysterious magic of this forest, can be turned into drinking water.
But the magic doesn't last long... so you have to buy it when you need it.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
即使是帶有森林神秘魔力的硫磺泉水，也能淨化成飲用水。不過魔力維持不了多久......所以需要時得現買。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
You get the idea.
Can I ask for help?
Even if we go anyway... they won't sell it to us.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
你明白了吧？能幫我這個忙嗎？就算我們自己去，他們也不會賣給我們。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Pretend to be a merchant who stopped by Rachel and quietly buy one, and put it in the water tank over there.
Then you will get completely purified, clean water.
You just need to bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
假裝成路過拉赫的商人，悄悄買一個，放進那邊的水槽裡。水就會被徹底淨化，之後把淨化好的水帶給我就行。

scripts.text: It won't be difficult
scripts.translation: 這不難

scripts.text: It will be difficult
scripts.translation: 這有點困難

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you're busy, so be it then.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
你要是忙，那就算了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
It was a long story, but thank you for the short answer.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我說了那麼多，謝謝你只用簡短的話回答。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go to a temple, there will probably be worshippers out doing good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句，再買下來。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go to a temple, there will probably be worshippers out doing good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句，再買下來。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThe villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dffconference.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Budan]
We've had some good water for a while.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
這陣子總算有乾淨水喝了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
I've got plenty of drinking water for a while.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我暫時攢夠飲用水了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go to a temple, there will probably be worshippers out doing good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句，再買下來。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go in front of the temple, there will probably be devotees out there for good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
I beg you.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿前面的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句再買下來，拜託你了。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
[Budan]
Thank you for helping me secure drinking water. Then I will boil this and prepare a meal.
If you have time to stay here tomorrow, may I ask for another route to Rachel?
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000
[布丹]
謝謝你幫我弄到了飲用水。我這就把水燒開，準備飯菜。你明天還會待在這裡嗎？能再幫我想辦法去一趟拉赫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Thank you for helping me secure drinking water. Then I will boil this and prepare a meal.
If you have time to stay here tomorrow, may I ask for another route to Rachel?
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
謝謝你幫我弄到了飲用水。我這就把水燒開，準備飯菜。你明天還會待在這裡嗎？能再幫我想辦法去一趟拉赫嗎？

scripts.text: I do
scripts.translation: 我有空

scripts.text: I think I will be busy tomorrow
scripts.translation: 我明天可能會很忙

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Is your answer quick?
Sorry for the long journey. But I want to feed my kids something safe. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
你答得真爽快。抱歉讓你跑這麼遠，不過我想讓孩子們吃上安全的食物。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Adventurer, you're back.
Do you have time to go to Rachel?
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
冒險者，你回來了。你有空去一趟拉赫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Pretend to be a merchant who stopped by Rachel and quietly buy one, and put it in the water tank over there.
Then you will get completely purified, clean water.
You just need to bring it to me.
scripts.translation:

假裝成路過拉赫的商人，悄悄買一個，放進那邊的水槽裡。水就會被徹底淨化，之後把淨化好的水帶給我就行。

scripts.text: It will be difficult

scripts.translation:

你要是忙，那就算了。

scripts.text:

It was a long story, but thank you for the short answer.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我說了那麼多，謝謝你只用簡短的話回答。

scripts.text:

If you go to a temple, there will probably be worshippers out doing good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
去神殿的話，那天應該會有信徒在那裡行善。跟他們說幾句，再買下來。拜託你了。

scripts.text: - You can't proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
May you be safe~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
願你平安～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Today's we have holy water purification relic~!
Come early before they're all sold out~!
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
今天有聖水淨化聖物出售～！趁賣完之前快來買～！

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Huh?
How may I help you, outsider?
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
咦？外鄉人，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: I need it to go to the top
scripts.translation: 我想買上層用的東西

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Alas, you've heard the rumors~
I'll explain briefly~
It is a consecrated holy purification relic that purifies a large amount of contaminated water at once.
This is it~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
哎呀，你聽說過了吧～我簡單說明一下～這是經過祝聖的淨水聖物，一次能淨化大量受汙染的水。就是這個～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
It's made in the temple~
Now that the waterways are well-maintained, it's not in such high demand~
I'm only making a small amount~
The ingredients are hard to find~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
這是神殿製作的～現在水道維護得不錯，需求沒那麼大～所以我只做少量～原料也很難找～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
I need it in a few days, so I can't buy it in bulk~
But~ there's only so much water you can purify in a single use~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
我幾天後就要用，所以沒法大量購買～而且～每次能淨化的水量也有限～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
If you run out of water on the way to your destination, and you have a suitable hydration station, you can use the item~
It's better than carrying water~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
如果去目的地的路上缺水，只要附近有合適的取水處，就能用這個淨化水～比隨身帶水方便～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
But you have to boil the water once~
Some people say it smells~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
不過，水還得煮沸一次～有人說會有股味道～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
It's 550 Zeny.~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
550澤尼～

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Don't buy
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Buy what you need~
May the goddess Freyja bless you~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
買你需要的吧～願女神芙蕾雅保佑你～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
你的澤尼不夠。

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Here is the item~
May the goddess Freyja bless you.
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
給你聖物～願女神芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
It is a holy relic for the essence of today's fish~
Hurry up before it's sold out~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
這是今天漁獲的聖物～趁賣完前快買～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Ah, the last time you went to the top, didn't you?
You came back sooner than expected. It seems that business is going well~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
啊，你上次說要去上面來著？這麼快就回來了，看來事情辦得挺順利～

scripts.text: Buy a relic
scripts.translation: 買聖物

scripts.text: Listen to an explanation
scripts.translation: 聽聽說明

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
This is 550 Jenny~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
這個要550澤尼～

scripts.text: buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: don't buy
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
你的澤尼不夠。

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
The stuff is here~
May Goddess Freya bless you~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
東西給你～願女神芙蕾雅保佑你～

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Today's holy water purification relic has just been released~
Just one in front of each person. Now, come quickly~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
今日份的聖水淨化聖物剛剛上架～每人限購一個，快來買～

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
I thought it was relatively clean water, but when I put a holy object in it, it glowed brightly and gave me a somewhat sacred feeling.
As the light subsides, the water looks clean.
scripts.translation: 我以為這水已經挺乾淨了，可把聖物放進去後，它突然發出耀眼的光，給人一種神聖的感覺。光芒消散後，水看起來乾淨多了。

scripts.text: I'll put it in a bucket and take it to Budan.
scripts.translation: 我把水裝進桶裡，帶給布丹。

scripts.text:
This is a water container for drinking water used throughout the village.
One side contains clean water, the other relatively clean water.
scripts.translation: 這是全村共用的飲用水槽。一側裝著乾淨水，另一側裝著比較乾淨的水。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAlthough it looks fine, there is a worn-out carriage wheel..^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff看起來沒什麼問題，但車輪已經磨損了......^000000

scripts.text: I attempt maintenance work
scripts.translation: 嘗試維修

scripts.text: I stop the maintenance work
scripts.translation: 停止維修

scripts.text: ^0000ffLet's revisit this when it comes to mind later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff等想起來再來處理吧。^000000

scripts.text: Materials suitable for reinforcing the carriage wheel <ITEM>[Tough Vines]<INFO>7197</INFO></ITEM> unavailable.
scripts.translation: 缺少加固車輪所需的材料 <ITEM>[強韌蔓藤]<INFO>7197</INFO></ITEM>。

scripts.text: ^0000ffRepair successful!^000000
^0000ffIt doesn't seem to have been properly reinforced yet. The material hasn't disappeared, so let's keep trying^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff好像還沒完全加固好。材料沒有消耗，可以再試一次。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffCamille's body is trembling thinly with the excitement after the battle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff戰鬥過後，卡米爾興奮得微微顫抖。^000000

scripts.text: You had pretty good movement
scripts.translation: 你的動作還不錯。

scripts.text: That was terrible. Don't touch a sword again
scripts.translation: 太糟糕了，別再碰劍了。

scripts.text: Why did you abandon the carriage and come this far??
scripts.translation: 你為什麼丟下馬車跑到這裡來了？

scripts.text: Isn't it just an accident? Apologizing might be unnecessary....
scripts.translation: 這只是場意外吧？或許沒必要道歉......

scripts.text: You're being too harsh on the trade manager.
scripts.translation: 你對貿易管理員太苛刻了。

scripts.text: I'm not going to argue with you anymore. Just do what you think is best..
scripts.translation: 我不想再和你爭了。你覺得該怎麼辦就怎麼辦吧。

scripts.text: Should we run away?
scripts.translation: 我們要逃跑嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt seems like you're not in a state to listen to the conversation properly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你現在似乎沒法好好聽人說話。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I can't have made the wrong choice in coming here...?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我來到這裡，應該沒有選錯吧......？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
We can get most things here, but not steel. I'd like to ask for a small favor. Just 3...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡大部分東西都買得到，唯獨沒有鋼材。我想請你幫個小忙，只要3塊......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Steel!! Steel, when will it come! ... oh it's here. You're here, Adventurer. It's heavy, isn't it? Give it to me. I can't let you hold it for another second, you're a precious person. Thank you. You've done a good job.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
鋼材！！鋼材什麼時候才到！......啊，送來了。冒險者，你來了。很重吧？快給我，我不能讓你再多拿一秒，你可是貴客。謝謝你，辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
When the clinic is completed, we'll engrave your name on the foundation stone so that your name will live on in the lives of future newborns.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
診所建成後，我會把你的名字刻在奠基石上，讓未來的新生兒也記住你。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Although time passes and the building disappears, the adventurer's will will remain forever.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
即使歲月流逝，建築終會消失，冒險者的心意卻會永遠留下。

scripts.text: No, it's not necessary...

[Ezekiel]
With this steel, I'll now build a clinic that would withstand any kind of weather, and will stand up to any elements.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
有了這些鋼材，我就能建一座堅固的診所，讓它經受住各種天氣和自然環境的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Wait, what are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
等等，你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Are you saying you're going to build a Clinic? Now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你是說現在要建診所？

scripts.text: Calm down, old man...
scripts.translation: 老人家，冷靜點......

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What do you mean by Calm down? We're having an ice-cold, rational conversation. Now!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
冷靜什麼？我們現在正在進行一場冷靜、理性的談話！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Why are you doing this? Are you being territorial about the newcomers?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你為什麼要阻止我？是因為排斥新來的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh my, we're not those kind of people.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哎呀，我們可不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Then why are you so opposed to it?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
那你為什麼這麼反對？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The comfortable life you want is a trap. Something foreign, something comfortable. Those things will ruin us.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你想要的舒適生活就是陷阱。外來的東西、舒適的東西，都會毀了我們。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Comfortable housing, thriving schools, clean clinics. Why shouldn't we have them? We've avoided discrimination, not convenience.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
舒適的房子、興旺的學校、乾淨的診所，我們為什麼不能擁有？我們拒絕的是歧視，不是便利。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I live here anyway, what's the harm in having better facilities?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
反正我也住在這裡，改善設施又有什麼壞處？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, I guess that's what the newcomers want?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不，這些大概就是新來的人想要的吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Accustoming your body to comfort makes an uncomfortable life unbearable. Live with satisfaction within the minimum life they provide.
They say that if you protest, they will take this away too.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
習慣了舒適，就會受不了艱苦的生活。只要在他們給的最低限度生活裡知足就行。聽說你們一抗議，他們連這點東西也會收走。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
How long do you think we're going to live here, never mind take our land back!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
更別說奪回土地了，你覺得我們還要在這裡住多久？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What you have now is enough, what more do you need?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你現在有的已經夠多了，還想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm not doing this because I'm ungrateful. They say that they are not bringing it here because this it's too foreign for them. Technology and facilities have developed over time, but you just don't understand it!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我不是不知感恩。他們說這些東西對他們來說太陌生，所以不願帶到這裡來。技術和設施一直在進步，可你就是不明白！

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Oh my, I think I'm dying. Help...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
哎呀，我好像快不行了。救命......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ezekiel!!! Something is wrong!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
以西結！！！出事了！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Maram? What is it? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
瑪拉姆？怎麼了，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
If I die... put my accumulated wealth...! With me. Did you get it?! It's unfair! Maram, make sure you guard my grave well! Don't let a single penny be stolen!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
我要是死了......就把我攢下的財富......都埋進墳墓裡。聽見沒？！太不公平了！瑪拉姆，好好守住我的墳墓！一分錢也別讓人偷走！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No, you won't die. Don't be ominous.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不會死的，別說這種不吉利的話。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What's wrong with Joel?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
喬爾怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
There's been an accident while moving the luggage. I need to get it taken care of quickly. Can you do that, Ezekiel?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
搬執行李時出了事故，得趕緊處理。以西結，你能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh my, how come? I can't use one leg at all and I'm still fine.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哎呀，怎麼會這樣？我一條腿都不能動了，不也還好好的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Let me see. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
讓我看看。嗯......

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Let's move it to my house quickly. I may not be able to use my legs, but I need to at least apply some medicine to prevent them from rotting.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
快把他抬到我家去。我腿腳不方便，但至少能給他上點藥，免得傷口惡化。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Do I have to cut my legs off like Mr. White Pine over here? I can't do that... I just bought a new pair of work boots...!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
我也得像那邊的白松先生一樣把腿砍掉嗎？我可做不到......我才買了雙新工作靴啊！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Are your boots a problem now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這時候還惦記你的靴子？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
... That's right, Maram. I have a favor to ask. Can you find someone who is missing a left leg but has a healthy right leg? I guess I'll have to sell him my right boot.
Sir, please make this as smooth as possible.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
......是啊，瑪拉姆，我想拜託你一件事。能不能找個左腿不方便、右腿還健全的人？我把右靴賣給他好了。先生，麻煩你儘量處理得順利些。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm not going to cutting your leg off, I can heal it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我不會砍你的腿，我能治好它。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? With a leg that is shaped like that?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？那條腿都變成那樣了？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
How do you fix a leg like that...! Let's cut it off and put some medicine on it to stop it from getting infected! Don't waste time by holding it...!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那種腿怎麼治得好......！趕緊砍掉，再上藥防止感染！別抱著它浪費時間了......！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm saying I can do it because I can do it. Everybody, get out of the way.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我說能治就能治。大家讓開。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You'll have to trust him. Ezekiel may not look like much in your eyes, but he's pretty good, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你得相信他。以西結看起來也許不怎麼樣，但本事很不錯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, the time is...!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不，來不及了......！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ahhh... If only we had the right equipment... I could have done it faster... I can't help it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
啊......要是有合適的器材，我就能更快治好......沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Aaaaaah!!! I'm dying!!!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
啊啊啊！！！我要死了！！！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, how's it going, can I start my construction?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，情況怎麼樣？我能開始建造了嗎？

scripts.text: About that...
scripts.translation: 關於這件事......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm trying to keep it out of the way so it doesn't affect anything else, but I guess that doesn't work either.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我試著把工程安排在不妨礙其他人的地方，可看來還是不行。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
But I can't give up, and I'm glad you're willing to come back and talk about it, but before then, I need to get a group of like-minded people together and get ready to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
但我不能放棄。很高興你願意回來談這件事，不過在那之前，我得先召集一些志同道合的人，準備好說服大家。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I thought about doing what they said, but I can't. I don't know what else to do, but this is something I need to do.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我想過照他們說的做，可我辦不到。我也不知道還能怎麼辦，但這件事我必須做。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Speaking of which, Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
對了，冒險者，我有件事想請你幫忙。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
You can get most things here, but not Steel. Because of how difficult it is to bring it in, not to mention you need a lot of facilities to make Steel. So, Would it be okay if you bring me 3 of them? just 3...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡大部分東西都買得到，唯獨沒有鋼材。運輸鋼材很困難，製造它又需要很多裝置。能幫我帶三塊來嗎？只要三塊......

scripts.text: I'll bring it to you.
scripts.translation: 我會帶給你。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Thank you for your generosity. I'm glad you're so sympathetic to my cause and willing to help... I'll go get ready for construction.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
謝謝你願意幫忙。我很感激你理解我的想法......我先去準備建造的事。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Please convince <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>that we need this facility.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
請說服<NAVI>[那位先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，讓他明白我們需要這項設施。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ezekiel, you didn't come here to live a life of riches. You came here to do a job!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
以西結，你來這裡不是為了過富裕的生活，而是來完成工作的！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but to live here as myself is to really live. I am an eternal stranger here, am I not?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，在這裡做自己才算真正活著。可我永遠是這裡的外人，不是嗎？

scripts.text: That person...?

[Maram]
Shhh- wait a minute, listen to what he's saying, he sounds like he's saying something.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
噓，等一下，聽聽他說什麼。他好像有話要說。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but I'm just as much an outsider here as I am there. Isn't that the same? Shouldn't I be more comfortable?
Maybe I should just give up and go home.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，我在這裡和在那邊一樣，都是個局外人。這不都一樣嗎？我不是應該過得自在些嗎？也許我該放棄，回家算了。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but that's what I initially aimed for. Finding my roots...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，可這正是我最初想做的事......尋找自己的根......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ezekiel! How have you been? Why are you muttering to yourself like that?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
以西結！最近怎麼樣？你怎麼一個人在這兒自言自語？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Maram? Maram?? That's great. You know what, listen to me. You're busy? You're busy, but listen. Who am I going to tell this to? I don't even know anybody yet. So listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
瑪拉姆？瑪拉姆？太好了！聽我說。你很忙？我知道你忙，可還是聽我說吧。我還能跟誰說呢？我還不認識什麼人。先聽我說......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I told you I was going to build a clinic here. When I came here, there was no decent clinic, so I build one.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我說過要在這裡建一所診所。我剛來時，這裡連像樣的診所都沒有，所以我就打算建一所。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's right. That's why I got a lot of things to fill it with this time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
是啊，所以這次我帶了很多東西來添置裝置。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I did that, but as soon as I started digging, the elders here stopped me. They say we should live in harmony with nature as we have done up until now, but they look at me as some sort of environmental destroyer. Am I that kind of person?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
可我剛開始挖，長老們就來阻止。他們說應該像過去那樣與自然和諧共處，卻把我當成破壞環境的人。我真是那種人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Is it really that destructive to nature and the environment to just build a more hygienic, more modern clinic, which would allow for a faster response in an emergency?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
只為了建一座更衛生、更現代、能在緊急情況下及時救治病人的診所，就會對自然和環境造成那麼大破壞嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No. You aren't that kind of person. Everyone else, but never you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不會。你不是那種人。別人或許是，但你絕不是。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Isn't that right? And you've gotten me to the point where... I'm not doing anything right now because I'm thinking, Am I really a bad person?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
對吧？可現在我卻開始懷疑自己是不是壞人，什麼也做不了......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
If that's the case, you should talk to Suad. That's not fair. We're all trying to live together. The clinic isn't against nature. Oh, come on.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
既然這樣，就該去找蘇阿德談談。這不公平，大家都在努力一起生活。診所並不違背自然。唉......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well... I talked to Suad... but he said there was nothing he could do and that he couldn't do what he wanted either.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我和蘇阿德談過了......他說他無能為力，也不能隨心所欲地做事。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I told him that we need a clinic, but we can't just push it through because the elderly people who have lived here for a long time are against it, so we have to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我告訴他我們需要診所，可不能強行推進，因為在這裡生活多年的長者們反對，所以得先說服他們。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From the sounds of it, so does he. We can't ignore the opinions of the elders, after all, and it's not like Suad's the kind of guy who'd bend over backwards to do so.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
聽起來他也這麼想。畢竟不能無視長者們的意見，蘇阿德也不是會強行做這件事的人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
So... I'm... going back to Rachel... What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
所以......我......準備回拉赫了......你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What, you came this far and you're going back?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
什麼？都走到這一步了，你還要回去？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, I didn't set out to go back... It's just that people are like that, they come here to have a better life, and if it's the same here or there, why wouldn't they want to stay where it's easier...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我不是特意想回去......只是人們來這裡是為了過上更好的生活。如果這裡和拉赫沒什麼兩樣，為什麼不留在生活更輕鬆的地方呢......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
So what I'm saying is... I'm trying to figure it out. When did I say I would just cut it and go back? Can you please not listen to me however you want?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我的意思是......我還在想辦法。我什麼時候說過要放棄回去？能不能別自作主張地理解我的話？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hmmm... but the clinic is a necessity as far as I'm concerned, and if I can make the case...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
嗯......可在我看來，診所確實是必需的。如果能說服大家......

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's right! I think the adventurer might be able to help us out. You know, this adventurer is really good at talking, don't you think his face makes him believable? This is just the kind of prize that grown-ups like.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
對了！冒險者也許能幫我們。你看，他很會說話，而且看起來就很可信，不是長輩們喜歡的那種人選嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
He has a big heart, and he helped us buy and transport supplies.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
他心地善良，還幫我們採購和運送物資。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
He's a nice guy. He's a good man, yes, but...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
他是個好人，確實很好......可是......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
...Is that really the kind of person who gets the favor of the adults? They're so... so... stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
......這樣的人真能得到長輩們的支援嗎？他們實在......太固執了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You have to make the most of it. Even if I can't persuade you, what else is there to do but listen to more nagging? Is that the adventurer going to listen to that instead?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你得把握機會。就算我說不動他們，難道你要讓冒險者去聽那些嘮叨嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well... Can I ask you a favor?
Adventurer, do me a favor, we really need a modern clinic here, even if it's not as big as the one from Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
嗯......能拜託你一件事嗎？冒險者，我們真的需要一間現代化診所，就算沒有拉赫那間那麼大也行。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Where I am now, if I get hurt or sick, I have to rely on folk remedies from the past.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我現在住的地方，受傷或生病時只能靠過去的民間療法。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I have some medicines and medical supplies from Rachel, but they are scarce, and I'm not in the right place to use them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我從拉赫帶來了一些藥品和醫療用品，但數量有限，而且這裡也不適合使用。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
But there's nothing I can do to convince the naysayers, so I'm going to ask an adventurer <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我實在說服不了反對的人，所以想請冒險者<NAVI>[先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>替我去說服他們。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Please do, and in the meantime, I'll go meet some other people.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
拜託你了。我趁這段時間去見見其他人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
How about this? Don't push yourself for a while, eat good food, think good thoughts, and rest well, and you'll be able to walk or run lightly.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這樣吧，暫時別勉強自己，多吃點好東西、想些開心的事，好好休息，就能輕鬆走路甚至跑起來。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Am I alive?? Am I alive?? Is my leg okay??
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
我還活著嗎？？還活著嗎？？我的腿沒事吧？？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Uh, since you say it is, it must be, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呃，你說沒事，那應該就是沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Thank you so much!! You saved my boots! What's your name? I'll be good to you in the future. You're my savior. I never forget his saviors. For life.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
太感謝了！！你保住了我的靴子！你叫什麼名字？以後我一定會好好報答你。你是我的救命恩人，我一輩子都不會忘記！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
So, how did you save the leg?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那麼，你是怎麼保住他的腿的？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Because that's what I learned. If the clinic had been properly equipped, we could have treated him more completely and accelerated his recovery.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這是我學過的醫術。要是診所裝置齊全，我們就能治得更徹底，也能讓他恢復得更快。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm... Is that what everyone does these days?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯......現在都是這麼治的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yeah, it's not going to cost you your leg, as long as you treat it right.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是啊，只要處理得當，他的腿就能保住。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You can do that faster and more appropriately if you have a clinic, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
有了診所，就能更快、更妥善地治療，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes...? Isn't that right...?

[Old Man]
Hmm... That's the way it is these days, isn't it, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯......現在的醫療就是這樣，對吧，冒險者？

scripts.text: That's the way it is these days.
scripts.translation: 現在就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Like I said, it's not the technology of the foreigns, it's the technology and facilities of the advanced era.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
正如我說的，這不是外來技術，而是新時代的技術和設施。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm, I don't think this is something you should just blindly oppose.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，我覺得這事不該一味反對。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Right? That's my opinion too. It's about saving people. If we do it our way, we can save something from death.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
對吧？我也這麼想。關鍵是救人。用這種方法，至少能把一些人從死亡邊緣救回來。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm... How long would it take to build that clinic?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯......建好那座診所需要多久？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Eh...? Well, it depends on labor and capital.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
呃......這得看人手和資金。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll help you as much as we can. Let's build it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們會盡量幫忙。就建起來吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Instead, it should fit in with the way of life here, it should fit in with the place.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不過，診所得符合這裡的生活方式，也要和這片地方相稱。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I see... I understand it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我明白了......我會照辦。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Wow, you guys thought of everything. This is exactly what I need, and I'm all for it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哇，你們考慮得真周到。這正合我意，我完全贊成。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Is there anything else we need here?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這裡還有什麼需要的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What, you're accepting more than clinics?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
怎麼，除了診所，你們還想要別的？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Didn't that make you think? You have to go with the flow. You can't be stubborn forever.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這還不夠說明問題嗎？得順應變化，不能一直固執下去。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I mean, we're not going to live the way we do now, even if we do reclaim our land. We already live differently than we used to.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我的意思是，就算我們奪回土地，也不會再過以前那樣的生活了。我們的生活早就變了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey, young man, if there's anything else that's important or necessary, let me know and we'll give it some thought.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
年輕人，要是還有什麼重要或必要的東西，就告訴我們，我們會考慮。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I will. I'll build the clinic as close to this place as possible, as you said.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我會的。我會照你說的，儘量讓診所融入這裡。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Yeah. You know we're not going to live here forever, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是啊。你知道我們不會永遠住在這裡吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes, that's exactly what I thought.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
知道，這也是我的想法。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, we'll take our leave. Thank you for your time today.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那我們先告辭了。謝謝你今天抽空。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's see!!!
Whoa- that's a relief, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
來看看！！！哇～總算鬆了口氣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yeah, it's there... right? But it's so abrupt that it's a little baffling, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
嗯，真的有了......對吧？不過事情變化得太突然，我還有點反應不過來。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Now that they've seen it with their own eyes, they think differently. That's good. Now, let's finish what we started, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
他們親眼看到了，想法自然就變了。這很好。現在繼續把事情做完吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes. But first, I think we need to change the design to match this place.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
好。不過首先得調整設計，讓它更適合這裡。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The Adventurer will help you, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
冒險者會幫你的，對吧？

scripts.text: That's... right...

[Maram]
If you need any equipment or tools, let me know in advance and I'll bring them next time.
Joel, let's go get some rest, too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
需要裝置或工具的話提前告訴我，我下次帶來。喬爾，我們也去休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Goodbye, my savior. I'll be back in the near future!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
再見了，我的救命恩人！我很快會回來的！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, thank you so much for your help. This is what I got when I got settled here, and I don't need anything... I'll give it to you, Adventurer, as a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，非常感謝你幫忙。這是我剛在這裡安頓下來時得到的東西，我用不上，就送給你表示謝意吧。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well, until next time, and maybe I'll ask you for a favor, so stop by often!
^4d4dffThis will result in a favorable evaluation of you.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
那就下次見。以後說不定還要麻煩你，記得常來！
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well, until next time, and maybe I'll ask you for a favor, so stop by often!
^4d4dffThis will result in a favorable evaluation of you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
那就下次見。以後說不定還要麻煩你，記得常來！
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ugh, it's hard. Adventurer, what's going on here. The thing you brought me is under construction... It's dangerous if you're here, so come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
唉，真不容易。冒險者，你看這裡，之前帶來的東西正在施工......現在進來很危險，天亮後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Hello, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text: How's the construction going?
scripts.translation: 施工進度怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
It's fine. But we're still short on some things, like Steel and Very Unusual Crystals.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
還不錯，不過還缺一些材料，比如鋼材和特異結晶。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
They use a lot of crystals here, and they're very hard, so they're great to use here and there.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡會用到很多結晶。它們非常堅硬，用在各處都很合適。

scripts.text: I'll get it for you.
scripts.translation: 我幫你弄來。

scripts.text: I'd love to get you one, but...
scripts.translation: 我很想幫你弄來，不過......

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Are you busy? It seemed like that. Even if you are busy, make sure to eat your meals.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你很忙嗎？看起來是這樣。就算忙，也要記得吃飯。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Wow, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
哇，太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I would need 1 Steel and 10 Very Unusual Crystal, and the Very Unusual Crystal can be obtained from the Gray Wolf.
I'll wait!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我需要1個鋼鐵和10個特異結晶，特異結晶可以從灰狼身上取得。我等你！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Thank you, Adventurer, for your efforts. Uh... but we're a little low on quantity, did you forget...?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，辛苦你了，謝謝......不過數量還差一點，你是不是忘了？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I would need 1 Steel and 10 Very Unusual Crystal, and the Very Unusual Crystal can be obtained from the Gray Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我需要1個鋼鐵和10個特異結晶，特異結晶可以從灰狼身上取得。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I'm always grateful. I'll take a break today and see you again after dawn!
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，辛苦了。一直以來都很感謝你。今天我先休息，天亮後再見！
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I'm always grateful. I'll take a break today and see you again after dawn!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，辛苦了。一直以來都很感謝你。今天我先休息，天亮後再見！

scripts.text:
[Old man]
If you have any difficulties in life, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
生活上有什麼困難就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I've got to see the newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我得去看看那些新來的人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The people who came in this time will also have to adapt well.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這次來的人也得好好適應這裡。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll have to take another look.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
看來還得再看看。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
She doesn't like it when I visit too often. You think it's the same as when we were kids?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我去得太勤，她會嫌煩的。你以為我們還是小時候嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Now, if you want to live here from now on, you have to fit in. You have to follow the rules here so we can all live in harmony.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
既然今後想住在這裡，就得融入大家。遵守這裡的規矩，我們才能和睦相處。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Whether it's the same as ours or not, it's always nice to have one more neighbor to talk to. Who doesn't love a friendly neighbor?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不管是不是和我們一樣，多一個能聊天的鄰居總是好事。誰不喜歡友善的鄰居呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Who are you? I don't recognize you.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你是誰？我沒見過你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, you're back again? Wasn't it a while ago? Are you going to be here more often now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦，你又回來了？剛才不是才來過嗎？以後會常來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Welcome, welcome, welcome, and be sure to ask if you have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
歡迎，歡迎。有問題儘管問。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Feel free to ask, not everyone here is bothered by that.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
儘管問吧，不是所有人都會介意的。

scripts.text: I'm here for a clinic matter...
scripts.translation: 我是為了診所的事來的......

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What's that? A clinic? This can't be the clinic they're building, can it?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？診所？他們要建的就是這個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I think I said it well enough for everyone to understand. There is no need to build a clinic, and you should not build one.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想我已經跟大家說得夠清楚了：沒必要建診所，也不該建。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why build a new building, a foreign one even, when you can just do the treatment where you are now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
既然可以在現在住的地方治療，為什麼還要蓋一棟新建築，甚至是外來的建築？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Isn't that how we all live without it?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們不也一直沒靠診所生活下來嗎？

scripts.text: Because medical facilities are important.
scripts.translation: 因為醫療設施很重要。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, what? So you're saying this is because we don't think it's important? Are we not good enough?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？你的意思是我們覺得醫療不重要嗎？難道我們做得還不夠好？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We know it's good, we know it's comfortable, we know how good it is, but you can't get used to it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們知道那樣更好、更舒服，也知道有多方便，可人不能習慣這些。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We get used to the way of life of the foreigners, and eventually we get used to it, and then we can't live without that convenience.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
一旦習慣外來者的生活方式和便利，最後就會離不開它們。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What you have now is enough, but you shouldn't rely on it. That means losing.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你現在有的已經夠了，但不能依賴它。否則終將失去。

scripts.text: But it's a necessary facility.
scripts.translation: 可這是必要的設施。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it hasn't been lacking, because if it had, we wouldn't have survived here for as long as we have.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們並不缺醫療條件，否則也不可能在這裡生活這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Anyway, I think that's the case. Even though I said it in a nice way, you still don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
總之就是這樣。我已經儘量說得委婉了，你還是不明白。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
If you want to live here from now on, you'd better forget all about life over there as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果你打算在這裡生活，最好儘快忘掉那邊的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The sooner you adapt to life here, the better off you will be.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
越早適應這裡的生活，對你越好。

scripts.text: I'm not... I'm not from here...
scripts.translation: 我......我不是這裡的人......

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? You're not even from here? What right do you have to interfere?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？你甚至不是這裡的人？有什麼資格插手？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Calm down. You can do that. Don't be mad at him, he's been helping your kids.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
冷靜點。別生他的氣，他一直在幫你的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll talk about <NAVI>[that tooth]<INFO>wolfvill,171,253,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the clinic later, but I think we should keep the outsiders out of this.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
診所的事稍後再談，包括<NAVI>[那顆牙]<INFO>wolfvill,171,253,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。不過我覺得外人不該摻和。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll talk about <NAVI>[that tooth]<INFO>wolfvill,171,253,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the clinic later, but I think we should keep the outsiders out of this.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
診所的事稍後再談，包括<NAVI>[那顆牙]<INFO>wolfvill,171,253,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。不過我覺得外人不該摻和。

scripts.text:
[Old man]
I'll have to go to the newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我得去看看新來的人。

scripts.text: He is busy sharpening his knife, so I call, but there is no answer.
scripts.translation: 他正忙著磨刀。我叫了他幾聲，但他沒有回應。

scripts.text:
[Larama]
Oh, I'm busy right now. We'll talk later.
scripts.translation:
[拉拉瑪]
哦，我現在正忙，之後再談吧。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...
Hunting non-monster animals in this forest is forbidden for outsiders..
Don't catch any rabbits.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
......外人不得在這片森林裡獵捕非魔物動物。別抓兔子。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...You say an adventurer has arrived.
Are you wandering around, looking for something to do?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
......聽說有冒險者來了。你是閒得沒事，在這裡瞎逛嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
If you don't have anything to do, don't just sit around here and watch the fire that's been lit over there.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
要是沒事做，就別坐在這裡盯著那邊的火堆看。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
I am in charge of livestock and wildlife viewing with the Eruin and their families over there.
It's also my job to maintain knives and other blades.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
我和家人負責照看牲畜，也負責觀察森林裡的野生動物。保養刀具和其他利刃也是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...Tsk tsk.

[Eruin]
If there's one thing I'd leave to an outsider, it's to checking the traps I set this morning.
Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
有件事倒可以交給外人：檢查我今天早上設下的陷阱。你能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: That shouldn't be too hard
scripts.translation: 這應該不難

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
It's good to have a quick answer.
...
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
答得真乾脆。......

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
<NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> If you look around, you'll see a bunch of traps..
If you've got some time, go get five of them.
If you leave the remaining bait alone, something will catch on it again, so you'll just have to wait and see.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
去<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>附近看看，會發現不少陷阱。有空的話，幫我收回五個捕獲物。剩下的誘餌別動，說不定還會有東西上鉤，到時再看吧。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
辛苦了，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
<NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>I'd like you to collect about 5 of the things caught in the trap.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
請從<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的陷阱裡收集五個左右的捕獲物。
