scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...Okay. Good job.
If you're free enough to hang around here tomorrow, can I ask you again?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
......好，幹得不錯。你明天要是還在附近有空的話，我能再拜託你嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I think I'll be busy tomorrow
scripts.translation: 我明天可能會很忙

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Okay. I'm in charge of trapping and grooming, so I'm always working, so if you peek again, I'll know and I'll make you do the work instead of bothering me.
It's no different for an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
好吧。我負責設陷阱和打理動物，一直都有事做。你要是明天再來閒逛，我可就讓你幫忙，別在旁邊礙事。外人也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Go back and rest today.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
今天回去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Are you here? I see you're snooping around again, so it looks like you're free.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
你又來啦？看你在這兒閒逛，應該挺有空的。

scripts.text: Go investigate the trap
scripts.translation: 去檢查陷阱

scripts.text: Chat
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
If you lend a hand, I have a lot of other things to do, so I appreciate it.
While going around the area, collect 5 things caught in the traps I've set up.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
你肯幫忙就太好了，我還有很多事要做。去附近看看，把我設下的陷阱裡捕到的東西收集五個。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Stop fidgeting and sit still. You're restless.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
彆扭來扭去，坐好。真不安分。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
If you leave the remaining bait alone, something else will be caught again, so just wait and see.
Thanks for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
剩下的誘餌先別動，等著看還會不會有東西上鉤。辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Stop fidgeting and sit still. You're restless.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
彆扭來扭去，坐好。真不安分。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Since when have you been setting traps?
Hmm. Since you quit being an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
你什麼時候開始設陷阱了？嗯，是從你不當冒險者之後嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
It would be nice if you could gather about 5 things caught in traps from <NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
麻煩你從<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的陷阱裡收集五個左右的捕獲物。

那就好。他沒有拒絕幫忙，謝謝你。

scripts.translation:

- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:

Let's bring it to <NAVI>[Eruin]<INFO>wolfvill,202,166,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 我今天已經收集到足夠的捕獲物了。帶去給<NAVI>[埃魯因]<INFO>wolfvill,202,166,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text: I didn't get anything...
scripts.translation: 什麼也沒抓到......

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Ah, an outsider...
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
啊，外人......

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Haaam... Huh? Someone I haven't seen before. Are you a new member of the Gray Wolf Village?
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哈欠......咦，沒見過你。你是灰狼村的新成員嗎？唉......

scripts.text: Did you have trouble sleeping last night?
scripts.translation: 昨晚沒睡好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Yes, I couldn't sleep a wink.
Haaam... In the forest of the Gray Wolves, if you lie down to sleep, you hear all sorts of sounds.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
是啊，我一晚上都沒閤眼。哈欠......在灰狼森林裡躺下睡覺，總能聽見各種聲音。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
The sounds of fireflies, the chatter of adults, the sounds of beasts...
The most disturbing sound that disrupts sleep is the cries of various monsters
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
螢火蟲的動靜、大人們的談話聲、野獸的叫聲......最擾人清夢的，還是各種魔物的嚎叫聲。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Huam... Among them, the cries of the {0} are the most frightening.
People even worry that they might bring sparks and burn down the entire village.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
嗚......其中{0}的叫聲最嚇人。大家甚至擔心它們會帶著火星，把整個村子都燒了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
The sight of them crying with sparks in their mouths and the suppressed voices are truly terrifying...
Ugh, just thinking about it makes my body tremble.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
它們嘴裡帶著火星哀嚎，那壓低的叫聲實在可怕......唉，光是想想我就渾身發抖。

scripts.text: I'm an Adventurer, shall I hunt them down for you?
scripts.translation: 我是冒險者，要不要我幫你們討伐它們？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Wow! You're an Adventurer?
In that case, I'll definitely ask for your help!
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哇！你是冒險者啊？那我一定要拜託你幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Would you catch only 30 {0} for us?
If we hunt down a bunch, maybe the {1} will keep quiet for tonight.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
能幫我們抓三十隻{0}嗎？要是除掉一批，也許{1}今晚就會安靜些。

scripts.text: Just leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交給我吧！

scripts.text: Oops, I'm in a bit of a pickle right now.
scripts.translation: 糟了，我現在有點走不開。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Well, I imagine even adventurers like you must be busy, right?
I know you are been busy right now, but have you ever try to close your eyes and sleep well with all these various noises? That's what happened to me recently.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
像你這樣的冒險者肯定也很忙吧？我知道你現在忙，不過你有沒有試過在這些吵鬧聲中閉眼睡覺？我最近就遇到這種事。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Wow, thank you, Adventurer!
It's 30 {0}. I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哇，謝謝你，冒險者！拜託你抓三十隻{0}。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Once you've hunted them all down please let me know by return to me. I'll prepare a small reward for you!
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
抓完之後回來告訴我一聲，我會準備一份小小的謝禮！

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Thank you, Adventurer!
There are 30 {0}. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
謝謝你，冒險者！有三十隻{0}，就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Thank you! The chirping sound of the windstorm kite has definitely been reduced!
I can sleep comfortably tonight.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
謝謝！風暴風箏的叫聲確實小多了！今晚我能睡個好覺了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Okay, it probably won't last long.
It will increase again tomorrow, but I hope you will come again after dawn and catch a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
不過這大概維持不了太久，明天叫聲又會變大。希望你天亮後再來抓一隻{0}。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
This is a thank you for letting me sleep well tonight.
Please accept even a small heart, adventurer.
 
^4d4dff A favorable rating for you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
這是謝你讓我今晚能睡個好覺。冒險者，請收下我這點心意。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000

scripts.translation:

^4d4dff你獲得了好評。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
It looks like the {0} is still lurking.
If you provoke me now, it might be more noisy because of evil.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
看來{0}還在附近徘徊。現在刺激它們的話，今晚可能會鬧得更兇。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Will you come back after dawn and catch a {0}?
I beg you, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
冒險者，拜託你天亮後再來抓一隻{0}，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Sigh, I'm so sleepy again today.
Adventurer, would you mind catching only 30 {0} for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
唉，今天又困得不行。冒險者，能幫我抓三十隻{0}嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
If you hunt in a group, the {0} will probably be silent tonight.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
要是能一次抓一群，{0}今晚大概就會安靜了。

scripts.text: For sure, I will catch them all.
scripts.translation: 好，我會把它們全抓起來。

scripts.text: I'm not interested to catch them.
scripts.translation: 我沒興趣抓它們。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Well, I suppose you're busy too, Adventurer?
You must be tired, so go ahead and get some rest. It might be hard to sleep with all this chipred, though.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
我想你也很忙吧，冒險者？你肯定累了，去休息吧。不過這些嘰嘰喳喳的聲音恐怕會讓人睡不著。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Wow, thank you, Adventurer!
It's 30 {0}s, I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哇，謝謝你，冒險者！三十隻{0}，真是太感謝了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
After you've hunted them all, please come back and let me know. I'll prepare a small reward for you!
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
抓完之後回來告訴我一聲，我會準備一份小小的謝禮！

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Thank you, Adventurer!
There are 30 {0}s. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]

scripts.text:

I can sleep comfortably tonight.
scripts.translation:

謝謝！風暴風箏的叫聲確實小多了！今晚我能睡個好覺了。

不過這大概維持不了太久，明天叫聲又會變大。希望你天亮後再來抓一隻{0}。

This is a thank you for letting me sleep well tonight.

scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
這是謝你讓我今晚能睡個好覺。冒險者，請收下我這點心意。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
...

[Albert]
If you ever decide to go back to Rachel, will you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
如果你哪天回拉赫，能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Albert]
To put it bluntly... I have a friend who worked as a clerk at Rachel's hotel.
If he hasn't come here yet, he's probably still working there.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
簡單說......我有個朋友在拉赫的旅館當職員。如果他還沒來這裡，應該還在那兒工作。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Me and my friend... Horim has lived next door to me since we were kids.
I used to live in Rachel, but I couldn't stand it anymore, so...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
我和朋友霍里姆從小就是鄰居。我以前住在拉赫，但實在待不下去了，所以......

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Their family and my family decided to knit Rachel.
But Horim said he would stay in Rachel.
We couldn't wait any longer, so we left him behind and moved him here.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
我們兩家原本約好一起離開拉赫，可霍里姆說他要留下。我們等不及，只好把他留在那裡，自己搬來了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Rachel is a big city, but right now he's alone.
...
If you don't mind, I was wondering if I could stop by and see how he is doing.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
拉赫是座大城市，可他現在孤身一人......如果你方便的話，我想請你去看看他過得怎麼樣。

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: I'm not going anywhere for a while.
scripts.translation: 我暫時不會去那邊。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
If that's the case, so be it then.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
這樣啊，那就算了。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
thanks.
Just... stop by and take a look. You don't need to report to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
謝謝。只是順道去看看他就好，不用回來向我彙報。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
You don't need to report to me.
All you have to do is check that Horim is doing well.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
不用向我彙報，只要確認霍里姆過得好就行。

scripts.text:
[Alber]
Has he met the boy?
Yes.
...yes.
I said everything I couldn't say when I left.
Now I have no regrets left.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯]
他見到那個孩子了嗎？是啊......我把離開時沒能說出口的話都說了，現在已經沒有遺憾了。

scripts.text:
[Alber]
It feels like a gray forest is shining.
I can't.
All adventurers, thanks to you.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯]
感覺灰狼森林都在閃閃發光。我做不到......各位冒險者，多虧了你們。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Ha~ I wonder what happens when people use such harsh words.
scripts.translation:
[員工]
哈～不知道人們說出這麼嚴厲的話後會怎麼樣呢。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Ackoooo! Welcome! Freyja's favor be with you!
scripts.translation:
[員工]
啊～歡迎光臨！願芙蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Horim]
I've never seen anything like it.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
我從沒見過這樣的景象。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
As an adventurer, you see things like this all the time.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
冒險者，你應該經常見到這種場面吧？

scripts.text:
[Horim]
What does it look like there?
Word on the street is that it's not a very comfortable place to live.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
那邊是什麼樣的？聽說那裡住起來不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
Still...

[Horim]
I like this path.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
我喜歡這條路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This length?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是這段距離嗎？

scripts.text:
[Horim]
There are so many monsters, you can't go alone...
You've traveled so much, aren't you getting a little tired of adventuring?
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
魔物太多，一個人沒法過去......你旅行了這麼久，不會有點厭倦冒險了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Horim]
That's okay, I'm good at this.
After all, this is what I do for a living.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
沒事，我很擅長這個，畢竟這是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
走吧。

scripts.text: Let's head back to the gray wolf forest.
scripts.translation: 回灰狼森林吧。

scripts.text: - This quest is only available for players level 170 and above -
scripts.translation: - 本任務僅限等級170以上的玩家接取 -

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Man, I'm thirsty. Could you get me some water? Your house is the closest.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
哎，我渴了。能幫我拿點水嗎？你家最近。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you have anything to eat at home? If not, could you buy some dried fruit?
Man, you're so kind.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你家有吃的嗎？沒有的話，能幫忙買點果乾嗎？哎呀，你人真好。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
There's... nothing to eat.
I don't have any money....
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
家裡......沒吃的。我也沒錢......

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Hey, where's this house with nothing to eat?
You're just being stingy, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
喂，哪裡有那種什麼都沒有的房子？你就是小氣，不想給吧？

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Disappointing, Naiman.
I thought you were a kind person.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
真讓人失望，奈曼。我還以為你是個好人呢。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Oh, no!
We have water, so I'll go fetch some.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
啊，不是的！我們有水，我這就去拿。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Fine. Water will be wasted. Where's our share?
Even water is bought with money, yet you claim to have none.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
算了，水也是要花錢買的。我們的那份呢？你還說自己沒錢。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Ah, I'm hungry and thirsty from playing.
I wish I could sit somewhere cool and have some iced tea with dried fruit.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
啊，玩得又渴又餓。真想找個涼快的地方坐下，喝杯加了果乾的冰茶。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Why don't you have any money? Doesn't your dad work at Lukshi's pawn shop?
Is it because Lukshi's mom didn't give your dad any money?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你怎麼會沒錢？你爸爸不是在盧克希家的當鋪工作嗎？是不是盧克希的媽媽沒給你爸爸錢？

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Our mom gives money to your dad, but you don't want to buy us a single fruit that's on sale?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我媽媽都付錢給你爸爸了，你連一個打折水果都不肯買給我們？

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Alright, let's stop. It's pitiful~ Let's stop saying we don't have money.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
好了，別說了。真可憐～別再說自己沒錢了。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
No!!! It's not pitiful....
It's not pitiful...!!
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
不！！！我才不可憐......一點也不可憐......！！

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Oh, sorry~ It was a joke.
Why are you getting serious and angry. Scary....
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
哦，對不起～我只是開個玩笑。你怎麼這麼認真，還生氣了？真嚇人......

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
I heard the natives are a bit hot-tempered, but still, isn't it a bit much to get angry one by one?
Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
聽說原住民脾氣比較急，可你們怎麼一個接一個地生氣？這也太過了吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Yeah, that's right. Even if you're angry, you have to know how to endure it to play together.
Be grateful to us for playing with a kid like you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
就是啊。就算生氣，也得學會忍耐才能一起玩。肯跟你這樣的小孩玩，你該感謝我們。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I want to drink sweet tea with lots of ice.
Then it would be even more fun to play!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我想喝加很多冰的甜茶，那樣玩起來才更開心！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's too hot and I'm thirsty right now.
But I don't want to go home either.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
現在又熱又渴，可我也不想回家。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Yes, you should thank us!
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
沒錯，你就該感謝我們！

scripts.text: I can't stand it anymore.
scripts.translation: 我受不了了。

scripts.text: Stop bothering us.
scripts.translation: 別來煩我們。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Hmm? Who are you to interrupt us while we're playing?
You don't seem like you belong here... Why are you meddling?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
嗯？我們正玩著呢，你是誰，憑什麼插嘴？你看起來不像本地人，為什麼多管閒事？

scripts.text: Is that playing?
scripts.translation: 那是在玩嗎？

scripts.text: It's playing, not bothering.
scripts.translation: 這是在玩，不是在欺負人。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
It's inevitable that we're a bit different from you due to our age~
This one is a native here, and we're all immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
我們年紀不同，彼此有些差異也很正常嘛～這位是本地原住民，我們都是移民。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Everyone knows that natives have some shortcomings compared to immigrants, right?
But still, we're all playing together like this.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
大家都知道原住民比移民差一些，對吧？不過我們還是願意一起玩。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
No! Who says that? What's the difference between natives and immigrants!
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
不是！誰這麼說的？原住民和移民有什麼區別？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Shouting again.
You're proving that natives are more hot-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
又喊起來了。你這不正好證明原住民脾氣更急嗎？

scripts.text: You're behaving in a way that makes people angry.
scripts.translation: 你的行為只會惹人生氣。

scripts.text: Of course, people get angry when you speak like that.
scripts.translation: 你那樣說話，別人當然會生氣。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
But it's true, isn't it?
Naiman's dad works at Lukshi's shop, and Lukshi's mom always says that.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
可這就是事實啊？奈曼的爸爸在盧克希家的店裡工作，盧克希媽媽總是這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Natives learn things late and are hot-tempered.
But the aunty who hires such natives and pays them a salary is amazing, right?
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
原住民學得慢，脾氣又急。可那位阿姨願意僱他們、給他們發工資，已經很了不起了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
We have cool drinks and snacks at our house!
But it's too far... Isn't Naiman's house the closest from here?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我家有冰飲和點心！可路太遠了......奈曼家離這裡最近，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Notice]
 - Your inventory is full. Please check the weight and the quantity of items you're carrying, then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[告示]
- 背包已滿。請檢查攜帶物品的重量和數量，再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
......
Why do you hang out with these kids?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼和這些孩子一起玩？

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Yes, yes?
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
嗯，嗯？

scripts.text: Why do you let them treat you like this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼任由他們這樣對你？

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Well... they're my friends.
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have anyone to hang out with.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
嗯......他們是我的朋友。要不是和他們一起玩，我就沒人陪了。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
See? Naiman hangs out with us because he likes it.
If we were really bothering him, he wouldn't hang out with us.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
看吧？奈曼喜歡和我們一起玩。要是我們真的欺負他，他才不會跟我們玩呢。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
I already know that foreigners are busybodies, but....
Don't butt in on things you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我早就知道外地人愛管閒事，不過......別插手你不瞭解的事。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
I... I'm going home to get some water.
And... sorry for getting upset for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
我......我回家拿水。還有......抱歉，我不該無緣無故發脾氣。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Well, things happen when you hang out together, right?
Don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
大家一起玩難免有點摩擦嘛，對吧？別太在意。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Let's go somewhere else and have fun.
Let's leave the busybody foreigner here.
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我們去別的地方玩吧，把這個愛管閒事的外地人留在這兒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Yeah, let's do that.
Goodbye, foreign adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
好啊，就這麼辦。再見啦，外來的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Feels like I've gained some life experience.
It's not exactly a pleasant feeling, but....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
......感覺好像長了點見識。雖然不太愉快......

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
It's hot... I want to go home.
But everyone else wants to play more.....
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
好熱......我想回家。可大家還想繼續玩......

scripts.text:
[Notice]
 - Your inventory is full. Please check the weight and the quantity of items you're carrying, then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[告示]
- 背包已滿。請檢查攜帶物品的重量和數量，再來找我。 -

scripts.text: - This quest is only available for players level 170 and above -
scripts.translation: - 本任務僅限等級170及以上的玩家接取 -

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
They still haven't paid the salary today. It's been three months already...
I'd love to quit this shop right away, but then I wouldn't have any way to get the overdue salary.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
今天還是沒發工資，已經拖了三個月了......我真想馬上辭職，可那樣就更拿不到欠薪了。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
And if rumors spread that I quit like that, as a native, I won't be able to work in other shops either.
Oh, what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
而且要是傳出我這樣辭職的訊息，作為原住民，我恐怕也找不到其他店鋪的工作。唉，我該怎麼辦......

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Oh, were you listening to my story?
Judging by your outfit, you must be an adventurer. How lucky. Living a free life as an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
哦，你聽到我說的話了嗎？看你的打扮，應該是冒險者吧，真羨慕。能像冒險者一樣自由自在地生活......

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Um, excuse my shamelessness, but I have a favor to ask of you.
Although my boss pretends to listen to me, if it's advice from a famous adventurer like yourself, I think he'll pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
冒昧地拜託你一件事。老闆雖然裝作在聽我說話，但像你這樣有名的冒險者去勸他，他或許會聽。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Could you please go to my boss's shop and urge him to pay my salary?
I can't even afford to buy tomorrow's meal like this.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
能去我老闆的店裡催他發工資嗎？再這樣下去，我連明天的飯都買不起了。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我來幫你。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要幫？

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
You don't necessarily have to do that.
I was just curious if you could help a bit.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你不一定非得幫忙。我只是想問問你能不能幫我一點。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Thank you, thank you!
My boss's shop is <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rachel,136,95,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
謝謝你！我老闆的店在<NAVI>[這裡]<INFO>rachel,136,95,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
You came. Do you have some good news?
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你回來了。帶來好訊息了嗎？

scripts.text: Share my story.
scripts.translation: 轉達我的話。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
They'll pay the overdue salary tomorrow! Oh, thank you so much. I'm really grateful.
Now I can buy food and clothes for my children.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
他們說明天會補發欠薪！太謝謝你了，我真的很感激。這樣我就能給孩子們買吃的和衣服了。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
I might get scolded tomorrow, but honestly, I'm happier that I finally got my salary.
Getting scolded is nothing, it's just for a day or two.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
明天我也許會捱罵，不過能拿到工資更讓我開心。被罵一兩天也沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Aren't you angry? Of course, I am.
But what can I do? Being born as a native was my mistake.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你不生氣嗎？當然生氣。可我又能怎麼辦？生為原住民是我的錯。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
I can't even run away anywhere.
I heard rumors about a village where natives who fled to Veins live, but I doubt if such a place really exists.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
我甚至無處可逃。聽說有個村子收留了逃到維納斯的原住民，可真有這樣的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
But even if it does, I don't have the courage to live there. Oh, I've talked too much.
I'm sorry for keeping you busy. Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
就算真有，我也沒有勇氣住在那裡。唉，我說太多了。耽誤你時間了，真的非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Worrying about meals every day, worrying about the children... There's never a day without worry.
Why was I born a native, to suffer unnecessary hardships.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
每天都要擔心吃飯、擔心孩子......沒有一天能安心。為什麼我偏偏生為原住民，要受這些不必要的苦？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Welcome, I am Dahil.
Nice to meet you. Judging by your attire, you must be an adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
歡迎光臨，我叫達希爾。很高興認識你。看你的打扮，應該是冒險者吧！

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I really like adventurers!
I once dreamed of being an adventurer myself. But then I took an arrow to the knee and now I'm stuck in the city.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
我最喜歡冒險者了！我以前也夢想成為冒險者，可後來膝蓋中了一箭，只能待在城裡了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
If you're okay with it, could you browse some items while telling me your adventure stories?
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
你能一邊看看商品，一邊給我講講冒險故事嗎？

scripts.text: I came for a different story.
scripts.translation: 我來是想打聽另一件事。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
A different story?
Hmm, about Amodipin's salary? Did Amodipin ask you to talk about it?
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
另一件事？嗯，是阿莫迪頻的工資嗎？是他請你來談這件事的？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Well, Amodipin may know about it, but the shop's situation isn't good.
I promised to pay it all at once next month, but using my favorite adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
阿莫迪頻應該知道店裡的狀況不太好。我答應下個月一次性付清，不過......

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Is it fair to hide behind someone else's back like that?
You seemed to be good at your job so I hired you, but maybe I should reconsider hiring natives.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
躲在別人背後說這些就公平嗎？我看他做事不錯才僱了他，不過也許我該重新考慮是否僱用原住民。

scripts.text: What do you mean by that?
scripts.translation: 你這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Oh, don't worry about it, adventurer. It's an old ritual problem with the natives.
They're weak and like to hide behind others.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
哦，別在意。原住民就是老樣子，軟弱又愛躲在別人身後。

scripts.text: Still, withholding wages is wrong
scripts.translation: 即使如此，拖欠工資也不對。

scripts.text: Isn't that discrimination?
scripts.translation: 這不是歧視嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Who doesn't know that? Even if you know, if there's no money, what can you do?
Well, Amodipin's salary is the last to be paid. But that can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
誰不知道這點？可就算知道，沒錢又能怎麼辦？好吧，阿莫迪頻的工資最後發，但也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
It's not discrimination against the natives.
It's just that he's the last one to come in, so the order goes like that.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
這不是歧視原住民，只是他最後才來上班，發薪順序自然排在最後。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Ah, why do I have to talk only about this with adventurers?
Tell Amodipin to put the salary in tomorrow and stop this nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
唉，怎麼跟冒險者光談這事？告訴阿莫迪頻，明天來領工資，別再鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I won't discipline you for this incident, but please tell <NAVI>[Amodipin]<INFO>rachel,181,51,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to come to work properly.
I'm not someone who discriminates against natives, but they lack responsibility, so if I scold them, I might just leave it at that.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
這次的事我不追究，但請告訴<NAVI>[阿莫迪頻]<INFO>rachel,181,51,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>以後好好來上班。我不歧視原住民，只是他們責任心不足，我批評幾句也就算了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I am currently running the shop, but I really like adventurers!
I once dreamed of being an adventurer myself. But then I took an arrow to the knee and got stuck in the city.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
我現在經營這家店，不過真的很喜歡冒險者！我以前也夢想成為冒險者，可後來膝蓋中了一箭，只能待在城裡了。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
I hope the situation calms down soon. Let's talk after you've organize some of your belongings.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
希望情況儘快平息。你先整理好隨身物品，之後我們再談。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Hello. It seems you may lack the experience to undertake my request at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
你好。看來你目前經驗不足，還不能接受我的委託。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please come back to me after gaining a bit more training.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
請再多歷練一陣子，再來找我。

scripts.text: - This quest is available for those level 170 and above. -
scripts.translation: - 本任務僅限等級170及以上的玩家接取。 -

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Hello, my name is Priest Junok.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
你好，我是牧師朱諾克。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
This village has been divided into two factions, the natives and the immigrants, for some time now, leading to a state of confrontation.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
這個村莊長期分成原住民和移民兩派，雙方一直處於對立狀態。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Efforts to resolve the conflict between the two factions are ongoing, but clear results have not been achieved.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
雙方一直在努力化解衝突，但至今沒有取得明顯成效。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Therefore, I would like you to approach each of them directly and find out what the issues are.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
所以我想請你分別和他們談談，瞭解各自的問題。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Would you be able to have a conversation with them on my behalf? I find it difficult to leave my post.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
你能代我和他們聊聊嗎？我不方便離開崗位。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 可以。

scripts.text: Next Time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
I'm disappointed that you rejected me. My heart is in so much pain.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
你拒絕了我，我很失望，心裡好難受。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please talk to the specified 3 natives and 3 immigrants, and let me know the results afterward.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
請分別和指定的三名原住民、三名移民談談，然後回來告訴我結果。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
The list of people to talk to can be found in the quest window or mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
交談物件的名單可以在任務視窗或小地圖上檢視。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Today, I have gathered enough information. If you need assistance again, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
今天要收集的資訊已經夠了。如果還需要幫忙，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Sure, I'll check the atmosphere between the indigenous people and the immigrants today. If there's anything specific you need assistance with, feel free to let me know.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
好的，今天我也會了解原住民和移民之間的情況。若有具體需要協助的事，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Then, I'll leave it to you. If you need any assistance, feel free to ask. Have a great day!.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
那就拜託你了。需要幫忙就告訴我，祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please come back after talking to the 3 natives and the 3 immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
請先和三名原住民、三名移民談過再回來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
The list of people to talk to can be found in the quest window or on the mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
交談物件的名單可以在任務視窗或小地圖上檢視。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please have conversations with all 6 citizens and return afterward.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
請和六位村民都談過之後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Is that so...
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
是這樣啊......

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It seems there is still a lot of resentment between them.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
看來雙方之間仍有不少積怨。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It's worse than I expected. Hm... I wonder what can be done about this.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
比我預想的還嚴重。嗯......不知道該怎麼處理才好。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Today, I have gathered enough information. If you need assistance again, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
今天收集到的資訊已經夠了。還需要幫忙的話，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Is that so...
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
是這樣啊......

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It seems there is still a lot of resentment between them.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
看來他們之間仍有不少積怨。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It's worse than I expected. Hm... I wonder what can be done about this.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
比我預想的還嚴重。嗯......不知道該怎麼處理才好。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It was helpful guidance..
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
你的建議很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Thank you for your help. Please come again if you can assist tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[朱諾克]
謝謝你幫忙。明天還能協助的話，請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
There was a big disturbance in the village not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
不久前村裡發生過一場大騷動。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
A speaker was giving a speech on the theme of respecting the dignity of an ideal human, but it seems to have stirred up some of the audience instead.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
有人以尊重理想人格的尊嚴為主題發表演講，結果似乎激怒了部分聽眾。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
I also felt that the speech was not received as favorably as one would hope.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我也覺得那場演講沒有得到預期的認同。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
It was merely an idealistic narrative, detached from reality.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
那不過是脫離現實的理想主義說辭。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
A loud exchange of words occurred, and even physical confrontation seemed imminent, but bystanders managed to prevent it.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
現場爭吵起來，眼看就要動手，幸好旁觀者及時攔住了。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Well, if it doesn't affect me personally, I don't really mind.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
只要沒影響到我，我倒不怎麼在意。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text: - You have completed the conversation with Jarad. -
scripts.translation: - 已與傑拉德談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Quietly...
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
小聲點......

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
I want to live without any trouble..
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我只想過平靜的生活......

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Hello, My name is Rohi.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
你好，我叫羅希。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I was living in poverty without any suitable work until recently...
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
直到最近，我一直過著貧困的生活，也找不到合適的工作......

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Thanks to Dina, I was able work on building management work recently, allowing me to put food on the table.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
多虧了蒂娜，我最近找到了一份建築管理的工作，總算能養活自己了。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
However, from some point onward, the given working hours have increased, but there has been no increase in compensation for that.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
可不知從什麼時候起，工作時間變長了，報酬卻沒有增加。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Why is that happening? Even among immigrants, Dina is considered wealthy, so it doesn't seem like she would lack the funds to pay.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
為什麼會這樣？蒂娜在移民中也算富有，應該不至於沒錢付工資。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I talked directly to Dina about the unfair aspect, but it was in vain.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
我親自找蒂娜談過待遇不公平的事，可沒有用。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Even if they offer a lower salary, many people are willing to take the job, you know...
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
就算工資低，願意接受這份工作的人也很多，你知道的......

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I've decided to wait for now, as Maram and other senior members are currently discussing ways to address this issue and find a solution.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
我決定先等等。瑪拉姆和其他負責人正在商量怎麼處理這個問題。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Thank you, I wish you a peaceful day as well!.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
謝謝，也祝你今天平安順遂！

scripts.text: - You concluded the conversation with Rohi -
scripts.translation: - 已與羅希談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
With so much work given today, I'm not sure if I can finish everything on time..
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
今天安排的工作這麼多，我不確定能不能按時做完......

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Hello, I'm called Jeojin.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
你好，我叫祖真。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
You could say I'm a native, having lived in this area since my ancestors' time.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
我的祖先世代生活在這片土地上，所以我算是本地人。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
These days, there's been some noise due to friction with immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
最近和移民之間有些摩擦，鬧得不太愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Some of them are wealthy, and among them, Dina, in particular, holds significant economic power.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
有些移民很富裕，尤其是蒂娜，經濟實力相當雄厚。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Even among the native, I, who have a considerable amount of property, can't really compare with that person.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
即使在原住民當中，我也算頗有資產，但還是比不上她。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
They've begun to influence the native business district, and policies are being shaped in their favor, making my business gradually more difficult.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
他們開始影響原住民的商業區，政策也越來越偏向他們，我的生意因此日漸難做。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
At that time, Dina proposed to purchase some of the buildings I own. I'm not sure what to do.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
那時蒂娜提議買下我名下的幾棟房產。我不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Well then, have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
那麼，祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text: - You've finished the conversation with Jeojin. -
scripts.translation: - 已與祖真談過。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Hmm... What should I do
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
嗯......該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Hello~~
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
你好～～

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Thank you so much for the job.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
非常感謝你幫我找到工作。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
You don't have to depend on others anymore!
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
我終於不必再依賴別人了！

scripts.text:
[Squain]
If I get paid, I'd like to change the clothes I'm wearing first.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
領到工資後，我想先換掉身上的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
There have been many people's help...
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
一路上有很多人幫過我......

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Now I will become a person who can help others.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
現在我也要成為能幫助別人的人。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Then enter carefully.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
那就請小心進去。

scripts.text: - Finished the conversation with Squain. -
scripts.translation: - 已與斯誇因談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next contact. -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Senado is someone who has trained in martial arts for over 20 years.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我叫塞納多，練武已經二十多年了。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I've been traveling to various villages to test the strength of my accumulated martial arts skills. After breaking many dojos, I settled here in Rachel quite a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我曾遊歷各個村莊，檢驗自己多年修習的武藝。擊敗許多道場的高手後，前些年在拉赫定居下來。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
However, lately, I've sensed that the atmosphere in this village is not quite right.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
不過最近，我覺得村裡的氣氛有些不對。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
It seems that people are divided into two factions and engaged in a confrontation, a conflict between the natives and immigrants...
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
大家似乎分成了兩派，原住民和移民之間正起衝突......

scripts.text:
[Senado]
In a strict sense, I belong to the natives. However, I don't want to be part of this confrontation.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
嚴格來說，我屬於原住民，但我不想捲入這場對立。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I have no interest in their power struggle.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我對他們爭權奪利不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Then let's meet again next time.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
那下次再見。

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Senado. -
scripts.translation: - 已與塞納多談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Whether native or immigrant...
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
無論是原住民還是移民......

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I don't know why they are so divided and arguing.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我不明白他們為什麼要分成兩派，爭吵不休。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Hello, they call me Trader Japer..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
你好，大家都叫我商人賈珀。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I believe I have exceptional business skills compared to anyone else. That's how I've reached my current position.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
我覺得自己的經商才能無人能及，才能有今天的地位。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Certainly, the prosperity of the nation is not possible without dedicated individuals like me fulfilling their roles diligently, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
國家要繁榮，當然少不了像我這樣盡職盡責的人，你說對吧？

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Moreover, by establishing a significant merchants' association, I've been able to provide employment opportunities for many indigenous residents living in Rachel..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
而且我創辦了大型商會，為許多居住在拉赫的原住民提供了工作機會。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I see, it seems that there's currently a lot of tension and conflict between the immigrants and the native, especially with growing dissatisfaction towards me.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
看來移民和原住民之間的緊張與衝突越來越嚴重，尤其是大家對我的不滿也在增加。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
It seems that the current working conditions are not satisfactory, and there's a sense of dissatisfaction, thinking that without me, they might not have had those job opportunities in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
他們似乎對目前的工作條件不滿，還覺得沒有我，他們根本不會有工作機會。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I am trembling because of the native people who are not only ungrateful but also filled with a sense of victimhood
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
那些不知感恩、又總覺得自己受了委屈的原住民，真讓我不寒而慄。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
So, until next time then..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
那就下次見了......

scripts.text: - You've finished talking to Japer -
scripts.translation: - 已與賈珀談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I was able to accumulate wealth by sticking to my own methods
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
我靠自己的經營手段積累了財富。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
They are misunderstanding me.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
他們誤會我了。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I am Japer disciple, Shiroan.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
我是賈珀的追隨者白安。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I have always followed Japer.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
我一直追隨賈珀。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
His excellent business skills are truly something to learn from.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
他的經商才能確實值得學習。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
However, sometimes he forces things too much.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
不過有時他做得太過火了。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
As a result, conflicts with the native he employed increased
scripts.translation:
[白安]
結果，他和僱用的原住民之間衝突越來越多。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
He is so stubborn that he doesn't listen to me... It's worrisome.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
他太固執了，怎麼勸都不聽......真讓人擔心。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
Then I hope you have a peaceful day.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
祝你今天平安順遂。

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Shiroan. -
scripts.translation: - 已與白安談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I hope Japer stops arguing.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
希望賈珀別再和人爭吵了。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Hello, nice to meet you. I'm Isira. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
你好，很高興認識你。我叫伊希拉，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I am a faithful follower of Freyja.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我是芙蕾雅的虔誠信徒。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Is the atmosphere among the believers tense lately?
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
最近信徒之間的氣氛很緊張嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I wasn't aware of it, but it seems that the tension between the native and immigrants has escalated recently, judging by the current situation.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我之前沒注意到，不過看現在的情況，原住民和移民之間的緊張關係似乎加劇了。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
The land, already rugged, was transformed into a fertile field through the grace of the goddess, providing a path for sustenance and life...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
這片土地原本崎嶇荒蕪，卻在女神的恩澤下變成了肥沃的田野，給大家帶來了生計與希望......

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Shouldn't we be grateful instead??
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我們難道不該心懷感激嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Despite that, the recent disturbance that occurred a while ago... sigh...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
儘管如此，之前發生的那場騷亂......唉......

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I'm not sure what exactly is causing the dissatisfaction.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我不太清楚他們具體在不滿什麼。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Then, have a peaceful day.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
祝你今天平安。

scripts.text: - The conversation with Isira has concluded. -
scripts.translation: - 已與伊希拉談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Thanks to the immigrants, the benefits received by the natives must be significant...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
多虧移民，原住民應該也得到了不少好處......

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I don't really understand why they're acting like that.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我實在不明白他們為什麼還要這樣鬧。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Hello, what brings you here??
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
你好，來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Ah~ It seems there are various rumors circulating about me in a negative light, right?
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
啊～最近關於我的負面傳聞不少吧？

scripts.text:
[Dina]
I hope you don't only think about the parts you heard from.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
希望你不要只聽到一點傳聞就下結論。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
To accumulate the wealth I have now, I have always acted strategically and pragmatically.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
我能積累今天的財富，一直靠的是策略和務實。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
It's regrettable to hear various negative stories recently, considering that we have a contractual relationship based on mutual understanding..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
我們明明有互相信任的契約關係，最近卻聽到各種負面傳聞，實在令人遺憾......

scripts.text:
[Dina]
If it's about the building acquisition, I plan to maintain the current position..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
如果你是為了收購建築的事來，我打算維持現在的立場......

scripts.text:
[Dina]
It's a process of rightfully gaining profit. Saying anything against this would be unreasonable..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
這是合理獲利的過程。反對這件事並不合理......

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Wishing you a good day!.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Dina. -
scripts.translation: - 已與蒂娜談過。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Oh well, I don't know why I'm the only one dealing with this.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
唉，不明白為什麼偏偏只有我得處理這些事。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Hello, this is Jafer's wife Hari.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
你好，我是賈菲爾的妻子哈里。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Because of his fiery nature, sometimes when an accident occurs, I take care of the rearrangement.a person who does.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
他脾氣火爆，出了狀況時通常都是我來收拾殘局。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
I suffered a lot because there was no compromise on the wage increase for the natives.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
原住民加薪的事一直談不攏，我為此吃了不少苦頭。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Actually, I didn't think there was any need for a raise, but I hated fighting with my husband more.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
其實我覺得沒必要加薪，只是不想再和丈夫吵架了。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Anyway, I'm glad there seems to be some compromise.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
總之，看來雙方終於有些妥協，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
I want you to be quiet now.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
現在請安靜。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Then just go inside~
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
那就進去吧～

scripts.text: - Conversation with Hari is over. -
scripts.translation: - 與哈里的對話結束。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next contact. -
scripts.translation: - 去找下一個人吧。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 已和六個人都談過了。回去找朱諾克吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Hello, this is Hari.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
你好，我叫哈里。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
She is the stubborn and unyielding lady in front of me.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
她就是我面前這位固執、不肯讓步的女士。

[Camper]
I couldn't find a job, and I kept failing my exams, so I left home in a fit of rage...
Then I stumbled upon a place like this.
I'm planning to stay here for a little while.
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
我找不到工作，考試也總失敗，一氣之下離家出走了......後來偶然發現了這個地方，打算在這裡住一陣子。

scripts.text:
[Camper]
Aren't you scared?
The old timers who asked me when I was going to get a job and everytime I meet them are way scarier.
...
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
你不害怕嗎？那些老傢伙每次見面都問我什麼時候找工作，比什麼都嚇人......

scripts.translation:
[守門人]
哦，聽說你替我說這裡很和平，真是幫了大忙。謝謝！來，我把手頭的東西給你。
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民已接納你成為村裡的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Oh, I heard you said it was peaceful, so you did my favor.
Thank you.
Come on, I'll give you what I have.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
哦，聽說你替我說這裡很和平，真是幫了大忙。謝謝！來，我把手頭的東西給你。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Are you going to the village?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你要去村裡嗎？

scripts.text: To the Grey Wolf Village
scripts.translation: 前往灰狼村

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去了

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Make Grey Wolf Forest safer
scripts.translation: 讓灰狼森林更安全

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Alright. You need to go through the gap between those trees.
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
好，你從那些樹之間的空隙穿過去。跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Okay then. How about hunting some monsters nearby?
They were too noisy when I was trying to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
那去附近討伐些魔物怎麼樣？我睡覺時它們吵得很。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
As you can see, I'm the gate keeper.
I also drive away any unwanted visitors.
Usually, I disguise myself as a vagabond, but I'm not actually one.
Don't you dare think of me as one!
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
如你所見，我是守門人，也負責趕走不速之客。我平時會偽裝成流浪漢，但其實不是。可別把我當流浪漢！

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
No, no. I wouldn't ask for a favor right after meeting you.
The forest may be a bit dangerous, but it's alright.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
不不，剛見面就拜託你做事也太失禮了。森林是有點危險，不過還好。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Um... it'll be fine for a while.
It's been a threat to some extent, so if they think about it, they won't attack.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
嗯......暫時應該沒事。它們多少也會忌憚我們，想清楚的話就不會攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
As you can see, I'm guarding the entrance here.
Sometimes monsters come all the way here and bother me even though I'm tired.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你看，我在這裡守著入口。有時候魔物跑到這裡來，明明我已經很累了還來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Would you clear about thirty monsters in the nearby forest regardless of the type?
I have some beautiful amethyst fragments I found lying around. I'll give them to you.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
能幫我清理附近森林裡大約三十隻魔物嗎？種類不限。我會把撿到的漂亮紫水晶碎片送給你。

scripts.text: Accept the request
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Refuse
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
I see... You're someone who doesn't care about the safety of a poor gatekeeper's life...
Got it. I'll sincerely remember this deep in my heart.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
原來如此......你竟然不在乎我這個可憐守門人的安危......知道了，這份恩情我會牢牢記住。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Thank you!
Now I can relax and unwind a bit!
I'll leave it to you then.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
謝謝！這下我總算能稍微放鬆一下了！就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Anything's fine. Just hunt some monsters nearby.
That way, I can stand guard more safely too, right?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
什麼魔物都行，在附近討伐一些就好。這樣我也能更安心地守門，對吧？

scripts.text: Looks like you can climb using a rope.
scripts.translation: 看起來可以用繩子爬上去。

scripts.text: Use the rope to ascend.
scripts.translation: 用繩子爬上去

scripts.text: Don't use.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text: Looks like you can climb using a rope.
scripts.translation: 看起來可以用繩子爬上去。

scripts.text: Use the rope to ascend.
scripts.translation: 用繩子爬上去

scripts.text: Don't use.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
It seems there's a cave beneath the gap in the rock,
and looks like you can slip through using a rope.
scripts.translation: 巖縫下面似乎有個洞穴，看起來能用繩子滑下去。

scripts.text: Use the rope to descend.
scripts.translation: 用繩子滑下去

scripts.text: Don't use.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
It seems there's a cave beneath the gap in the rock,
and looks like you can slip through using a rope.
scripts.translation: 巖縫下面似乎有個洞穴，看起來能用繩子滑下去。

scripts.text: Use the rope to descend.
scripts.translation: 用繩子滑下去

scripts.text: Don't use.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
Only traces of a broken bridge over the cliff are visible.
This path is not currently in use.
scripts.translation: 懸崖上只剩斷橋的痕跡，這條路現在已經無法通行。

scripts.text:
[Syeil]
I was frustrated and came to this deserted place, and yet, there's still someone here.
scripts.translation:
[西耶爾]
我心煩意亂，才跑到這片荒涼的地方，沒想到這裡還有別人。

scripts.text:
[Seil]
Oh-ho! Welcome to the Grey Wolf Village.
scripts.translation:
[賽爾]
哦吼！歡迎來到灰狼村。

scripts.text:
[Sarana]
We usually plant corn or soybeans here.
You can plant them anywhere and they'll thrive, just make sure you fertilize them well.
scripts.translation:
[薩拉娜]
我們通常在這裡種玉米或大豆，種在哪裡都長得不錯，只要記得施肥就行。

scripts.text:
[Sarana]
Potatoes grow consistently well, but other than that...
Ha... I want to eat something made with wheat flour.
scripts.translation:
[薩拉娜]
土豆倒是一直長得很好，可其他作物......唉，我好想吃用小麥粉做的東西。

scripts.text:
[Oha]
Does this make 35 servings? I'm always boiling it, but I can't get the right amount.
scripts.translation:
[歐哈]
這能做三十五份嗎？我一直在煮，可總是掌握不好分量。

scripts.text:
[Zen]
Just keep it safe so that the primordial fire does not devour this village and forest...
scripts.translation:
[禪]
只要守護好這裡，別讓原初之火吞噬村莊和森林......

scripts.text:
[Cassoulet]
Hiya... What a delicious smell.
I'll wait here until everything is cooked.
scripts.translation:
[卡酥來]
希亞......好香啊。我就在這裡等著，直到全部煮熟。

scripts.text:
[Cassoulet]
Hiya... What a delicious smell.
I'll wait here until everything is cooked.
scripts.translation:
[卡酥來]
希亞......好香啊。我就在這裡等著，直到全部煮熟。

scripts.text:
[Hiyares]
This is a precious fermentation container. Please don't touch it yet, as it's still fermenting.
scripts.translation:
[希亞雷斯]
這是珍貴的發酵容器，還在發酵，請先別碰。

scripts.text:
[Hiyares]
It's a fermented food made with a starter culture passed down since my great-great-grandfather's time.
Honestly, I'm not a big fan because it has a strong smell.
scripts.translation:
[希亞雷斯]
這是用曾曾祖父傳下來的菌種製作的發酵食品。說實話，我不太喜歡，味道很重。

scripts.text:
[Director]
You can't go into the water? Why?
scripts.translation:
[總監]
不能下水嗎？為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Director]
You look so warm and comfortable... I want to play in the water.
If you're playing with the wind, you'll soon be full of ash.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
看起來暖和又舒服......我也想下水玩。跟風玩的話，你很快就會弄得滿身灰。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 你當前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Sir, it's been a while since I've seen you.
Once you get somewhat familiar with the village, come find me.
I'll offer you some conveniences.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
先生，好久不見。等你對村子熟悉一些後，再來找我，我會給你提供一些便利。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
But that's only if you're ^4d4dffgoing to participate in the tournament^000000.
I don't just do favors for anyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
不過，前提是你^4d4dff打算參加錦標賽^000000。我可不會隨便幫任何人。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
If you look closely, there will be places where a helping hand is needed.
By lending a hand, you'll earn some goodwill among the people, I reckon.
Give it your best shot.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
仔細看看就會發現有些地方需要幫忙。伸出援手，應該能贏得村民們的好感。加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Welcome, my wolf-like {0}.
What do you need?
Oh, I've been looking for a better smelting box.
Would you like to exchange it for amethyst?
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
歡迎，像狼一樣的{0}。需要什麼？哦，我正想找更好的熔煉箱。要用紫水晶碎片交換嗎？

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Welcome, Sir.
Would you like to tidy up some things?
Or would you like to browse through some items I have for sale?
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
歡迎，先生。想整理物品，還是看看我這裡賣的東西？

scripts.text: Use the Storage.
scripts.translation: 使用倉庫

scripts.text: Use the store.
scripts.translation: 使用商店

scripts.text:
[Asad]
The Storage fee is 200z.
Which Storage would you like to open?
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
使用倉庫需要200澤尼。要開啟哪個倉庫？

scripts.text: Storage 1
scripts.translation: 倉庫1

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Alright, I'll open the Storage.
Use it well.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
好，我來開啟倉庫。請用吧。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Are you going to sell items?
Are you going to buy what you need?
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
你要賣東西，還是買需要的物品？

scripts.text: Buy items.
scripts.translation: 購買物品

scripts.text: Sell items.
scripts.translation: 出售物品

scripts.text:
[Asad]
I'm not sure if I have everything you need.
But whatever it is, you can count on me.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
我不確定有沒有你需要的東西，不過不管是什麼，都可以問我。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Alright. I'll sell you anything at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
好，我會以合理的價格賣給你。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Do you want to teleport to Rachel for 1 {0} ?
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
要消耗1個{0}傳送到拉赫嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Asad]
You don't have enough material.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
材料不夠。

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Amethyst shop?
You can exchange them for a smelting box..
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
紫水晶商店？可以用紫水晶碎片兌換熔煉箱......

scripts.text:
[Asad]
Amethyst shop?
You can exchange them for a smelting box..
scripts.translation:
[阿薩德]
紫水晶商店？可以用紫水晶碎片兌換熔煉箱......

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
Hello there!
I see you've recently received some <ITEM>[Amethyst Fragment]<INFO>1000405</INFO></ITEM> in the village, right?
I've noticed that people often exchange them, considering them symbols of luck or something.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你好！聽說你最近在村裡獲得了一些<ITEM>[紫水晶碎片]<INFO>1000405</INFO></ITEM>？我注意到大家常用它們交換物品，好像把它們當作幸運符之類的。

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
We're collecting crystals.
Would you mind giving them to me later if you happen to gather a large amount?
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
我們正在收集水晶。如果你之後攢了很多，能拿來給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
Of course, I won't just take the crystal pieces for nothing.
I'll exchange them for equipment or other items that adventurers like yourself might need.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
當然不會白拿水晶碎片。我會用裝備或其他冒險者需要的物品和你交換。

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
When you gather a large amount, please come to me.
You understand, right?
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
攢夠了就來找我，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
Hello.
Do you happen to have <ITEM>[Amethyst Fragment]<INFO>1000405</INFO></ITEM>?
We are collecting crystals.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你好，你有<ITEM>[紫水晶碎片]<INFO>1000405</INFO></ITEM>嗎？我們正在收集水晶。

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
We offer carefully crafted ^4d4dffarmor and enchantments^000000 in exchange for crystals.
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
我們會用精心製作的^4d4dff防具和附魔^000000與你交換水晶。想做什麼？

scripts.text: Exchange Armor
scripts.translation: 兌換防具

scripts.text: Gray Wolf Enchantment
scripts.translation: 灰狼附魔

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
As promised, you've brought many Amethyst Fragment?
Take your time and have a look around.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
照約定，你帶來了不少紫水晶碎片吧？慢慢看看想換什麼。

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
Do you have enough equipment and materials for enchanting?
I mean, the Amethyst Fragment.
Please select the part you want to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你準備好裝備和附魔材料了嗎？我說的是紫水晶碎片。請選擇要附魔的部位。

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Garment
scripts.translation: 披肩

scripts.text: Shoes
scripts.translation: 鞋子

scripts.text: Right(R) Accessory
scripts.translation: 右側飾品

scripts.text: Left(L) Accessory
scripts.translation: 左側飾品

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
You're enchanting the armor, I see.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你要給防具附魔，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
You're enchanting the garment, I see.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你要給披肩附魔，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
You're enchanting the shoes, I see.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你要給鞋子附魔，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
You're enchanting the right accessory, I see.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你要給右側飾品附魔，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
You're enchanting the left accessory, I see.
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
你要給左側飾品附魔，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
I used to be a recognized technician in the past.
Now it's hard to find any work...
But if there ever comes a time when my skills are needed, I'll be ready to help.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
我以前是個頗有名氣的技術人員。現在卻很難找到工作......不過只要有用得上我的本事的地方，我隨時願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
I heard the shrine's villa has changed in a very strange way, right?
It's where the fallen god passed by....
The loot obtained from there must also be filled with false beliefs.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
聽說神殿的別墅發生了很奇怪的變化？那是墮落之神經過的地方......從那裡取得的戰利品，恐怕也沾染了錯誤的信仰。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
If you wish, I can perform a purification ritual to transform them into weapons filled with true faith.
My sorcerous skills will also be put to good use.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
如果你願意，我可以舉行淨化儀式，把它們變成蘊含正確信仰的武器，也能讓我施展術法。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
You have a choice between a basic purification ritual, which significantly reduces refining power, and an advanced purification ritual, which maintains most of the refining power.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
你可以選擇基礎淨化儀式，大幅降低精煉值；也可以選擇高階淨化儀式，保留大部分精煉值。

scripts.text:
You can reform the +9 refined Adulter Pides weapon series into the Vibtus Pides series.
The refining power dropped varies depending on the purification ritual chosen.
scripts.translation: 可以將精煉至+9的墮落裴迪斯系列武器重塑為維布圖斯裴迪斯系列。精煉值降低多少取決於所選的淨化儀式。

scripts.text: Basic Purification Ritual
scripts.translation: 基礎淨化儀式

scripts.text: Advanced Purification Ritual
scripts.translation: 高階淨化儀式

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
May the blessings of the gods be with you.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
願諸神保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
May the blessings of the gods be with you.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
願諸神保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bamdatt]
Hmm? You seem to possess skills comparable to researchers from other countries.
scripts.translation:
[巴姆達特]
嗯？你的本事似乎不遜於其他國家的研究員。
